follow_up: 读者建议：限制可用校准信息后，测试可实际估计的相关先验能恢复多少性能。

papers.title: Initialization masks overcome decoding obstructions in compressed QAOA
papers.abstract: In compressed quantum optimization, a variational state is converted into a classical assignment by decoding noncommuting observables. We show that this step creates structural restrictions that changing the initialization can remove, even when increasing circuit depth cannot. For an explicit infinite family of connected cubic graphs on $n=3r$ vertices, with a fixed Pauli encoding and deterministic sign decoder, every all-plus QAOA circuit has cut at most $2r$, at every finite depth and every real angle sequence. A uniform signed product-state mask at fixed depth-one angles has expected cut $13r/4$, an additive advantage $5n/12$; an infinite subfamily admits an optimal mask. A second construction retains a linear depth-one separation under weak weighted couplings, a bounded cost-angle domain and a specified production-encoder ordering. Noiseless simulations then test classical mask selection before energy optimization. On 1,699 random cubic MaxCut instances, one selected mask achieves mean ratio $0.9100$, versus $0.7067$ for the all-plus $X$ baseline and $0.9125$ for the best of $r^2$ separately optimized random masks. On complete cohorts of weighted MaxCut, sparse Ising, Max-2-XOR and Max-2-SAT, the selected mask also improves on the baseline at every size, but it trails the pool at small sizes and leads it significantly only at the larger MaxCut and Ising sizes. Finite-pool order statistics separate the effect of selection from that of drawing a random mask. The results distinguish decoded expressivity from optimized energy and empirical performance; they do not establish a quantum computational advantage.

analysis.summary: 论文指出 compressed QAOA 的固定 Pauli encoding 与 sign decoder 会造成表达限制，改变初始化可解除而单纯加深电路不能解除。该结果强调 decoded assignment 与变分能量是不同目标。
analysis.problem: 增加深度未必能改善固定读出解码得到的经典答案。
analysis.setting: 显式 connected cubic graph 无限族，n=3r；固定编码与确定性 sign decoder。
main_results: 所有 all-plus QAOA 在任意有限深度、任意实 angles 下 cut≤2r；固定 depth-one angles 加随机 signed product-state mask 的期望为13r/4，差5n/12。
1699个随机 cubic MaxCut 实例中，选择一个 mask 的均值比为0.9100，对照 all-plus为0.7067，而 r²个分别优化 random masks 的最佳值为0.9125。
techniques: 结构性解码障碍；初始化 masks；有限候选池统计比较。
assumptions: 第二构造还限制 weighted coupling、angle domain 和 encoder ordering。
limitations: 仅依据官方摘要；未核查正文证明及摘要未说明的假设。
证明未审；并未建立 quantum computational advantage，也不能推广为任意编码读出下的深度下界。
本条分析仅依据论文摘要，未核查正文证明和摘要中未说明的假设。
relevance: 与浅线路、固定 measurement access 和资源比较有具体联系。
follow_up: 读者建议：比较总经典 mask-selection 和多次优化成本，并检查改变 decoder 后分离是否保留。

papers.title: Beyond the Mean Gap: What Transferred-Angle QAOA Retains on a Superconducting Processor
papers.abstract: Hardware executions of the quantum approximate optimization algorithm (QAOA) are often validated by comparing the device's mean cost with a simulation, a check that can miss what matters for optimization. Under global depolarization, the mean normalized gap and the floor-corrected probability of every set of bitstrings, the optimum included, retain the same fraction of their noiseless improvement over uniform sampling. We test this prediction with depth-2, transferred-angle QAOA circuits for binary subproblems of an alternating-direction decomposition on the IBM Heron processor \texttt{ibm\_marrakesh}, with and without dynamical decoupling and twirling. At 12 qubits, the main-family circuits retained 29\% to 46\% of their mean-gap improvement but only 5\% to 15\% of their probability of the optimum, lower on at least nine of ten instances per run. Near-optimal bitstrings were lost about as much as the optimum, whereas the avoidance of poor bitstrings was retained best. In the first submission, a device-matched noise model reproduced the pattern but overestimated the retention of the optimum five- to eightfold. On a rugged planted family, the device found the optimum in 62\% of 768-shot blocks (noiseless: 98\%), within the range of local heuristics. Validations of optimization circuits should report retention of the optimum and of near-optimal sets.

analysis.summary: 研究指出以平均目标值验证 QAOA 可能遗漏最优解事件的失真。全局 depolarization 预测各种事件在扣除均匀底线后保留相同的无噪优势，但设备数据不符合这一预测。
analysis.problem: 平均 cost 的改善能否代表优化所需的最优或近优样本？
analysis.setting: IBM Heron 的12-qubit、深度2 transferred-angle QAOA；比较带或不带 decoupling 和 twirling 的运行。
main_results: 主实例族保留29%–46%的 mean-gap 改善，但只保留5%–15%的最优事件改善，每轮至少9/10实例出现这一差异。
设备匹配噪声模型复现趋势，但对最优事件保留高估5–8倍。
另一 planted 族在768-shot块中找到最优的比例为62%，无噪98%，仍在局部启发式的表现范围内。
techniques: 用均匀采样作对照；分别统计最优、近优及差解集合。
assumptions: 保留比例针对相对 uniform baseline 的改善，和原始成功概率不同。
limitations: 仅依据正式摘要；未审阅正文证明及摘要未说明的假设。
只涉及所测电路和实例，不是通用 gate certification 或 QAOA 优势；768是每块 shots，不是线路深度。
本条分析仅依据论文摘要，未核查正文证明和摘要中未说明的假设。
relevance: 提供检验噪声模型与任务相关输出的具体 benchmark。
follow_up: 读者建议：在固定 shots 下比较分布尾部与均值指标的置信区间。

papers.title: A trace costs one quantifier: the exact complexity of perfect play in nonlocal games
papers.abstract: Given a finite nonlocal game, can the players win with certainty? We prove that the existence of a perfect normal spatial strategy is $Σ^0_2$-complete, even when restricted to games of value one, so it cannot be decided even with an oracle for the halting problem. This is strictly harder than perfect play in the finite-dimensional and commuting-operator models, which are $Σ^0_1$-complete and $Π^0_1$-complete. Within the commuting model, the existence of a perfect normal strategy with a finite or semifinite von Neumann host is $Σ^0_2$-complete, whereas for every fixed type $\mathrm{III}_λ$ subtype it has the same $Π^0_1$-complete language as unrestricted commuting play. A trace thus costs one existential number quantifier: the hardness constructions force every perfect strategy to choose a finite clock period or a finite tree depth. Spatial $Σ^0_2$-completeness also holds when finite entanglement entropy is required, and both forms are formally verified in Lean. For every computable $0<α<1$, perfect spatial play with $\mathrm{Tr}\,h^α<\infty$ for the reduced density $h$ is $Σ^0_2$-complete as well; these conditions form a strict ladder between finite rank and finite entropy. We also prove $Σ^0_2$-completeness for one-shot zero-error communication with normal entanglement, and construct a finite channel with zero-error codes of a given size each of which needs infinite entanglement entropy.

analysis.summary: 论文精确区分非局域游戏在不同测量代数和纠缠访问模型下是否能必胜。有限维、normal spatial 与 commuting-operator 的完美策略存在性分别落在不同的算术层级。
analysis.problem: 即便游戏值为1，是否真的存在实现概率1的策略，且这个判定依赖哪些资源限制？
analysis.setting: 有限 nonlocal game；对比有限维、normal spatial、commuting 及指定 von Neumann host。
main_results: normal spatial 完美策略存在性为 Σ⁰₂-complete，即便承诺值为1；有限维为 Σ⁰₁-complete，commuting 为 Π⁰₁-complete。
有限或半有限 commuting host 仍为 Σ⁰₂-complete；固定 IIIλ 型保留 unrestricted commuting 的语言。
有限纠缠熵限制仍为 Σ⁰₂-complete，作者报告两种 spatial 结论的 Lean 验证；normal entanglement 的一次零误通信也给出 Σ⁰₂-completeness。
techniques: 以有限时钟周期或树深度编码存在量词，比较迹结构。
assumptions: 区分值的上确界、可达的完美策略和有限维可达性。
limitations: 仅依据正式摘要；未审阅正文证明及摘要未说明的假设。
这是判定问题复杂度，不给有限尺寸实验所需的纠缠或测量成本。
本条分析仅依据论文摘要，未核查正文证明和摘要中未说明的假设。
relevance: 精确展示信息访问及纠缠限制如何改变任务。
follow_up: 读者建议：对照固定误差容差下的判定问题是否保留这些分离。

papers.title: Regev's Reduction Reaches Reconstruction
papers.abstract: Regev's reduction uses a quantum Fourier transform to carry out reductions between various problems related to lattices and codes. We apply it to the problem of sampling from Gibbs distributions of certain classical spin glass Hamiltonians, which can equivalently be thought of as cost functions for average-case instances of an optimization problem called $D$-regular max-$k$-LINSAT. This problem becomes hard at low temperature. Here, we use a quantum decoding algorithm called Belief Propagation with Quantum Messages (BPQM) to solve the decoding problem arising from Regev's reduction. Our main contribution is a proof that the minimum temperature reachable using Regev+BPQM is exactly equal to the reconstruction threshold temperature for noisy channels transmitting signals on a tree network. This equality can be understood via Renes' duality between classical and quantum channels, which we use to show that quantum decoding is possible exactly when classical reconstruction on the dual problem is impossible. M{é}zard and Montanari identified this reconstruction temperature with a dynamical glass transition predicted by the one-step replica-symmetry breaking (1RSB) cavity equation. It is conjectured that local samplers such as Metropolis Monte Carlo and Glauber dynamics cannot equilibrate efficiently below this reconstruction temperature but may do so above it; our large numerical experiments show close agreement with this prediction across hundreds of different problem parameters. Therefore, our results rigorously show that Regev+BPQM reaches a temperature for which, to our knowledge, there is no matching classical guarantee, and brings Regev+BPQM to the conjectured limit of efficient Gibbs sampling by classical local dynamics.

analysis.summary: 作者用 Regev reduction 将一类经典 spin-glass Gibbs sampling 归约到量子解码，再用 Belief Propagation with Quantum Messages（BPQM）求解。可达的最低温度等于树上经典重构阈值。
analysis.problem: 量子采样方法的低温边界是否有可证明的解释？
analysis.setting: D-regular max-k-LINSAT 平均情形；树网络上的噪声通道。
main_results: 通过 classical–quantum channel duality，把量子解码可行性对应到对偶问题上经典重构不可行。
可达温度等于所述 reconstruction threshold；局部经典采样器在更低温不能高效平衡仍是猜想，数值结果支持其温度边界。
techniques: 量子 Fourier transform 归约、BPQM、Renes 对偶。
assumptions: 结论针对该分布族及量子算法；经典对照是局部动力学。
limitations: 仅依据正式摘要；未审阅正文证明及摘要未说明的假设。
没有证明相对所有经典算法的分离；摘要未给电路开销、误差范数或总 samples。
本条分析仅依据论文摘要，未核查正文证明和摘要中未说明的假设。
relevance: 具体展示量子消息访问和 Gibbs sampling 保证的联系。
follow_up: 读者建议：核对树近似与有限图的适用条件，再单列查询和采样总成本。

papers.title: Experimental visual quantum state discrimination
papers.abstract: Almost all solutions to vision tasks $\unicode{x2014}$ offered by nature and technology alike $\unicode{x2014}$ rely on capturing an image using a lens or a similar optical instrument, followed by computational analysis by neurons of a brain or a digital computer. This approach is inherently suboptimal in photon-limited and noisy conditions, where critical information is irreversibly lost at the measurement stage. We address this gap by introducing AI-driven optimization of quantum measurements on the incoming photons, learning how to extract the maximum possible information for a given computer vision task from each incoming photon. The trained measurement consists of a diffractive optical neural network (DONN) followed by a detector array. We train the DONN with a quantum information-theoretic objective that maximizes the rate at which the discrimination error decays as photons accumulate. The resulting measurement achieves exponentially lower error than both direct imaging and a DONN optimized for single-photon discrimination. We validate the advantage in a noiseless setting as well as a photon-counting experiment with an electron-multiplying CCD with the noise corresponding to $10^4$ photons per single signal photon, where the measurement also learns to mitigate the detector noise.

analysis.summary: 作者把优化对象从拍下图像后的分类器移到光子测量本身：训练 diffractive optical neural network 加探测阵列，使判别错误随累积光子数衰减的速率最大化。
analysis.problem: 在光子受限条件下，成像先丢掉的信息能否由任务定制的测量保留？
analysis.setting: 入射光子上的衍射网络和探测阵列；与直接成像、针对单光子判别优化的 DONN 比较。
main_results: 作者报告相对两基线的判别错误呈指数改善，并在无噪条件及 photon-counting EMCCD 实验核验；实验噪声量级对应每信号光子10⁴个光子。
techniques: 用量子信息判别目标训练测量；在探测前进行光学变换。
assumptions: 结论限所选视觉判别任务和探测模型；指数说的是错误随累积光子的比较。
limitations: 仅依据正式摘要；未审阅正文证明及摘要未说明的假设。
摘要不支持任意视觉任务或集体测量优势；具体指数和噪声定义未审。
本条分析仅依据论文摘要，未核查正文证明和摘要中未说明的假设。
relevance: 是具体的 quantum-data measurement access 比较，非仅训练经典分类器。
follow_up: 读者建议：在相同入射光子数、损失和误判率下复算误差指数。

papers.title: Scalable Unitary State-Encoding for Generic Large Data
papers.abstract: Efficient encoding of data into quantum states remains a fundamental bottleneck in many quantum computing protocols, which would otherwise offer advantages over their classical counterparts. Here, we introduce deterministic and scalable amplitude-encoding methods with low two-qubit gate costs and tunable trade-offs between circuit depth and encoding fidelity. Our approaches require no amplitude amplification or mid-circuit measurement and are capable of encoding arbitrary complex data or queryable functions by using tensor-networks to go beyond what can be held in classical memory. Our principle contributions are two complementary algorithms for simplifying fully controlled multiplexer circuits to one- and two-qubit gates. In the first, we formally map the elimination of redundant gate controls to a Boolean logic minimization problem, while in the second we utilize a single ancilla qubit to map the multi-controlled rotation gates to a sequence of one- and two-qubit operations via the Walsh-Hadamard spectrum of the gate angles. We benchmark these methods across a broad range of function classes, characterizing their total depth in an all-to-all connectivity graph against system size and target fidelity. Hybridizing our methods gives up to orders of magnitude improvement in circuit depth at equivalent state fidelity compared to the default state-preparation method in the Qiskit package. We furthermore demonstrate our method on IQM hardware with a square lattice connectivity, finding excellent fidelity, even with minimal noise mitigation. By significantly reducing gate depth for encoding, this work enables the experimental execution of applications on current and near-term hardware which would otherwise be reduced to noise before the first calculation step, shortening the time horizon to robust quantum utility.

analysis.summary: 作者提出确定性 amplitude encoding，将多控制 multiplexer 简化为一、二比特门，在深度与保真度间调节。两条路线分别使用 Boolean control minimization 和单 ancilla 的 Walsh–Hadamard 角谱分解；不需 amplitude amplification 或 mid-circuit measurement。
analysis.problem: 数据加载成本可能吞没后续算法优势，需要把输入制备深度本身计入资源。
analysis.setting: 任意复数据或可查询函数，以 tensor networks 压缩表示；数值深度基准采用 all-to-all 连通性。
main_results: 混合方法相对 Qiskit 默认制备法，在相同态保真度下报告最高数量级的深度改善。
在方格连通性的 IQM 硬件演示，并使用少量 noise mitigation。
techniques: 删除冗余控制的 Boolean 化；Walsh–Hadamard spectrum 合成；tensor-network 表示。
assumptions: 压缩表示及函数结构影响可扩展性；第二条路线使用一个 ancilla。
limitations: 仅读取官方摘要，未审阅正文证明及摘要未说明的假设。
摘要无统一最坏情形深度界或完整预处理成本，不能推出任意数据均有端到端加速。
all-to-all 数值深度与方格硬件路由成本应分开。
本条分析仅依据论文摘要，未核查正文证明和摘要中未说明的假设。
relevance: 直接涉及深度、ancilla 与制备误差的权衡。
follow_up: 读者建议：逐项计入经典压缩、路由和任意旋转的容错合成成本。

papers.title: Quantum subsets discrimination and key sifting with success probability one
papers.abstract: Non-distinguishability of non-orthogonal quantum states is the essential feature of quantum mechanics. In particular, one cannot deterministically orthogonalize the set of quantum states, while probabilistic orthogonalization is possible, including unambiguous state discrimination and discrimination between the subsets. Here, we propose a method for error-free subsets discrimination with significantly increased success probability, which may reach one even for non-orthogonal and linearly dependent input states. This method may be applied in quantum cryptography: An alternative basis reconciliation procedure is described, which may provide unit sifting probability even for a large number of bases and for non-orthogonal states within each basis.

analysis.summary: 本文允许测量输出随机决定所区分的 partition，因而在某些非正交态集合上实现总成功率一的无误 subset discrimination。它并非确定辨识每个非正交输入态。
analysis.problem: 固定 partition 的无误区分成功率通常小于一；放宽问题的输出类型能否保留有用信息？
analysis.setting: 已知纯态 ensemble，通过 Gram matrix 分解实现不同 subset divisions 的量子操作。
main_results: 摘要提出用于 basis reconciliation 的替代 key-sifting 思路，可在特定态集合和多 bases 设置达到 unit sifting probability。
正文三态例中不同 partition 的成功分支共同覆盖全部事件，但不能预先指定哪一种 partition 成功。
techniques: Gram matrix convex decomposition；将失败分支继续用于其他 filtering。
assumptions: 接受 partition 的随机性；并非固定目标的确定性 USD。
limitations: 仅读摘要及正文的 Gram 分解和三态例片段，未审后续推广、附录 Kraus 构造或密码安全证明。
sifting probability 一不自动意味着 secret-key rate 一或安全性。
relevance: 直接关联测量输出允许什么信息、以及访问任务变化产生的优势。
follow_up: 读者建议：在固定 partition 与随机 partition 的同一输入 ensemble 下分列成功率与可得信息。

papers.title: Magic Can Superactivate Quantum Capacity
papers.abstract: Environmental magic can enable two channels with zero quantum capacity to transmit quantum information jointly. We establish this superactivation within a family of discrete quantum convolution channels with fixed Clifford interactions. For the couplings considered, stabilizer-mixture environments induce entanglement-breaking channels. We construct a mixed magic environment whose induced channel has positive private capacity and a Choi state with positive partial transpose, hence zero quantum capacity. A half-erasure auxiliary activates this channel through the Smith--Yard mechanism. Finite-block encoding and decoding over a self-complementary convolution auxiliary then realize a higher-dimensional erasure channel that still permits activation. We also bound the activated capacity by the modified relative entropy of magic of the main environment. Replacing either environment of the convolution pair by any stabilizer mixture makes the joint quantum capacity vanish, identifying environmental magic as a necessary resource on both sides for this realization.

analysis.summary: 作者在固定 Clifford interactions 的离散 quantum convolution channels 中，将 environmental magic 与 quantum-capacity superactivation 联系起来：两个单独量子容量为零的 channel 联用后可传量子信息。
analysis.problem: 需要区分造成联合通信能力的资源与单通道本身的容量。
analysis.setting: 所选 convolution couplings；mixed magic environment；half-erasure 及 self-complementary convolution auxiliary。
main_results: 构造主通道具正 private capacity、PPT Choi state，因而 quantum capacity 为零。
half-erasure 经 Smith–Yard mechanism 激活；有限 block 编码/解码让 convolution auxiliary 也实现可激活的高维 erasure channel。
activated capacity 由主环境的 modified relative entropy of magic 上界；所述通道对任一侧换成 stabilizer mixture 后联合容量归零。
techniques: 离散 quantum convolution；PPT 与 private information；有限 block 转换。
assumptions: magic 必要性限于该实现及固定相互作用，不能推广为所有 superactivation 的必要条件。
limitations: 仅读取官方摘要，未审阅正文证明及摘要未说明的假设。
HTML 摘要已读，构造、容量界与证明未审；不提供未见的数值速率。
非零 private capacity 不能等同单通道 quantum capacity 为正。
本条分析仅依据论文摘要，未核查正文证明和摘要中未说明的假设。
relevance: 直接给出 magic 与通信任务 operational advantage 的联系。
follow_up: 读者建议：核对激活所需的 block length、辅助系统维度及界的归一化。

papers.title: Twisted Compactification, Quotient Quantum Codes and Logical Gates
papers.abstract: Many quantum codes, including balanced-product, bivariate-bicycle and genon codes and the five-qubit code, are quotient codes: a larger code folded onto itself by identifying each check with its image under a deck transformation composed with a symmetry. We show that this is the lattice form of twisted compactification, in which a theory on $X\times F$ carries a symmetry background along $F$, and we use the correspondence in both directions. For monomial quotients of Pauli stabilizer codes, a transfer theorem gives the logical qudits, logical operators and distance bounds from those of the parent, with a Tate cohomology group counting the logical operators that are new. For higher-form and cup-product symmetries the twist is an entangling diagonal circuit; when a finite cover trivializes the background, the code is a dressed quotient, so abelian Pauli codes give non-abelian topological order such as $D(D_4)$. The dressings have Clifford level at most one less than the degree of the twist, and for cubic twists the code dimension is a count of solutions of quadratic equations in cup products, which certifies that the code is not a Pauli stabilizer code when it is not a power of two; on tori and slabs the distance is linear in the size. Twists also create logical gates: three toric codes on $S^3$ have no logical qubits, but on $\mathbb{RP}^3$ the same circuit is a logical $CCZ$. A quarter-turn twist of the 3D fermionic toric code gives codes of linear distance, from $[[768,2,9]]$ up, whose $p+ip$ pump is an explicit finite-time quasi-local evolution that preserves the code space exactly; using the spin-topological response formula of Barkeshli, Hsin and Kobayashi, we identify its logical action as $T$ up to Clifford factors. Finally, twisting abelian gauge theories reach only the quantum doubles $D(G)$ with $[G,G]$ central.

analysis.summary: 论文把 quotient quantum codes 解释为 twisted compactification：将母码按 deck transformation 与对称性折叠，联系逻辑自由度、距离及逻辑门。该视角覆盖 balanced-product、bivariate-bicycle、genon 等码。
analysis.problem: 需要系统理解商构造中新增逻辑算符以及扭曲背景如何产生非 Clifford 逻辑操作。
analysis.setting: Pauli stabilizer 母码的 monomial quotient，以及 higher-form/cup-product symmetry 的对角纠缠 dressing。
main_results: transfer theorem 从母码给出逻辑 qudit、算符与距离界，Tate cohomology 计数新增逻辑算符。
摘要给出 RP³ 上的逻辑 CCZ 例子，以及从 [[768,2,9]] 起的线性距离码；其 p+ip pump 的逻辑作用为 T，允许 Clifford 因子。
techniques: twisted compactification；有限覆盖；cohomology 与拓扑响应。
assumptions: dressed quotient 要求有限覆盖消去背景；T 门识别依赖所述 spin-topological response。
limitations: 仅读取官方摘要，未审阅正文证明及摘要未说明的假设。
76 页正文和证明未审；线性距离不自动给出阈值、低开销或可实施的有限深度门。
finite-time quasi-local evolution 与严格局部门电路须区分。
本条分析仅依据论文摘要，未核查正文证明和摘要中未说明的假设。
relevance: 连接 QEC、逻辑门及非 Clifford 资源。
follow_up: 读者建议：检查 locality、系统尺寸与门时间之间的精确关系。

papers.title: Tomography of approximately Gaussian mixed states
papers.abstract: Moment-based tomography efficiently reconstructs Gaussian states, but stochastic phase noise generally produces mixed, non-Gaussian outputs. For approximately Gaussian outputs, we formulate reconstruction as a problem in quantum learning theory under model misspecification. Our trace-distance guarantee separates the intrinsic Gaussian approximation error from statistical errors in estimating the first moments and covariance matrix. Using recent Gaussian trace-distance bounds, we obtain linear dependence of the statistical contribution on moment errors when the covariance inverses remain bounded, improving on the square-root dependence on covariance error in earlier guarantees. A Fock-space truncation procedure provides certified, convergent lower and upper bounds on the intrinsic error. Under an explicit sub-Gaussian condition on the heterodyne outcomes, the sufficient sample count scales inversely with the square of the allowed statistical error remaining after accounting for the approximation error. We verify the statistical condition for stochastic phase rotations and heralded unitary-averaged states with bounded input squeezing. We apply the framework to probabilistic unitary averaging for phase noise reduction, quantifying reconstruction error and accounting for heralding overhead in the total number of estimation attempts.

analysis.summary: 作者将近 Gaussian 混态 tomography 视为模型失配下的学习：trace-distance 保证分开不可消除的 Gaussian 近似误差和矩估计的统计误差，避免把全部误差归于有限样本。
analysis.problem: 随机相位噪声可将 Gaussian 输入变成非 Gaussian 混态，仅估计均值和 covariance 并不保证重构真实输出。
analysis.setting: 用一阶矩与 covariance 重建；heterodyne 观测满足显式 sub-Gaussian 条件。
main_results: covariance inverse 有界时，统计项对矩误差线性依赖，改进早期 covariance 误差平方根依赖。
Fock 截断给出内在近似误差的可收敛上下界。
所需样本对扣除近似误差后剩余统计容差呈平方反比，并计入 heralding 的估计尝试开销。
techniques: Gaussian trace-distance bounds；Fock-space truncation；heterodyne concentration。
assumptions: 有界 covariance inverse；sub-Gaussian 尾条件；所验证例子有界输入 squeezing。
limitations: 仅读取官方摘要，未审阅正文证明及摘要未说明的假设。
不能把总容差直接代入平方反比而忽略模型偏差。
摘要未给出所有维数、能量和成功概率因子；证明未审。
本条分析仅依据论文摘要，未核查正文证明和摘要中未说明的假设。
relevance: 直接关联 quantum-data learning、测量样本与访问资源。
follow_up: 读者建议：核对总尝试数与成功 heralded copies 的换算，并测试接近统计尾条件失效的情形。

papers.title: From spectroscopy to quantum dynamics: assessing reduced models of a NaCs molecular gate
papers.abstract: We investigate how spectroscopic calibration and basis selection affect predictions for a dipolar-exchange gate between two optically trapped $^{23}$Na$^{133}$Cs molecules. We construct a 128-state molecular Hamiltonian restricted to the $N=0,1$ rotational manifold, fit two effective optical parameters to three bright microwave transitions, and compare the resulting spectrum with four additional lines. In the coherent pair model, changing the optical polarization angle by $+0.1^\circ$ reduces the calculated gate fidelity from 94.64\% to 1.09\% at fixed carrier frequencies. Retuning the carriers and restoring the target Rabi frequencies recovers 89.31\%. The remaining sensitivity reflects changes in the multilevel pair dynamics that are not removed by target-frequency and target-Rabi recalibration. Enlarging the molecular basis produces nonmonotonic changes in fidelity, although the 11-state and 25-state calculations give closely agreeing logical maps after phase alignment. Two controls with isolated transfer probabilities near 98.45\% yield complete-gate fidelities differing by more than 11 percentage points. We relate these comparisons to a sufficient bound on the error of a projected propagator. The numerical tests quantify agreement among selected bases for a specified coherent Hamiltonian.

analysis.summary: 论文检验 NaCs 双分子 dipolar-exchange gate 的光谱校准与模型截断是否足以预测完整门。重要警示是单跃迁的高转移率不能替代完整 logical map 的一致性。
analysis.problem: 以少数光谱和有效基底校准得到的模型，可能掩盖多能级动力学误差。
analysis.setting: 在 N=0,1 转动流形构建 128 态分子 Hamiltonian，用三条亮 microwave 跃迁拟合两个光学参数，并与另四条线比较。
main_results: 光偏振角增加 0.1°，固定载频的计算 fidelity 从 94.64% 降至 1.09%；重新调谐载频和目标 Rabi 后恢复至 89.31%。
两个孤立 transfer probability 约 98.45% 的控制，其完整门 fidelity 相差超过 11 个百分点；11 与25态模型相位对齐后的 logical map 接近。
techniques: 多基底比较；projected propagator 误差的充分界。
assumptions: 结论针对指定 coherent Hamiltonian，而非完整噪声实验。
limitations: 仅读取官方摘要，未审阅正文证明及摘要未说明的假设。
扩大基底的 fidelity 变化非单调；摘要没有误差界具体形式，未审其证明。
本条分析仅依据论文摘要，未核查正文证明和摘要中未说明的假设。
relevance: 与门表征中 baseline 选择和模型误差有具体联系。
follow_up: 读者建议：把实验可测的 transfer data 与完整过程误差之间的缺口单独量化。

papers.title: Features of Non-Local Quantum Correlations in Nuclei
papers.abstract: Classical simulation of quantum many-body systems is challenged by the combined effects of entanglement and non-stabilizerness (magic). Non-local magic, $M^{\mathrm{NL}}_α$, quantifies the component of non-stabilizerness that cannot be removed by local unitary transformations and provides a measure of quantum complexity beyond entanglement alone. It is bounded from below by the antiflatness of the entanglement spectrum, ${F}_A$. We calculate stabilizer Rényi entropies, non-local magic, entanglement-spectrum antiflatness, and entanglement entropy in shell-model ground states of more than 260 even-even, odd-even, and odd-odd nuclei, using a bipartition into proton and neutron sectors. We find that the previously established bound $4{F}_A\leq{M}^{\mathrm{NL}}_{\mathrm{lin}}$ holds for every nucleus studied and approaches saturation in the limit of separable states. Odd-odd nuclei exhibit markedly different patterns of entanglement and magic compared with even-even and odd-even systems, revealing distinctive signatures of proton-neutron quantum correlations and providing new insight into the complexity generated by nuclear interactions.

analysis.summary: 论文对260多个核的 shell-model 基态计算非局域 magic、stabilizer Rényi entropy、纠缠与谱 antiflatness。虽然应用是核结构，比较的具体问题是局部酉不能消除的非稳定子性如何受谱下界约束。
analysis.problem: 已有 antiflatness 下界在大量物理态上有多紧？
analysis.setting: 质子与中子二分，含 even–even、odd–even 和 odd–odd 核。
main_results: 在所算各核中观察到已有不等式 4F_A≤M_lin^NL，趋近可分态时接近饱和。
odd–odd 核在纠缠与 magic 的联合分布中呈现不同模式。
techniques: shell-model 基态计算和多种资源量对照。
assumptions: 数值覆盖指定核和分区；所检查的下界不是本文新定理。
limitations: 仅依据正式摘要；未审阅正文证明及摘要未说明的假设。
没有给出态制备、蒸馏或测量副本成本；不能将 magic 数值直接换成模拟开销。
本条分析仅依据论文摘要，未核查正文证明和摘要中未说明的假设。
relevance: 提供已知 magic 下界在具体多体态上的紧致性对照。
follow_up: 读者建议：在匹配纠缠熵的态之间再比较 antiflatness 与非局域 magic。

papers.title: Random encoders and expurgation improve 1,873 entries of the Grassl qubit code tables
papers.abstract: I report 192 explicit binary stabilizer codes $[[n,k,d]]$ with $53\le n\le 254$ and $5\le d\le 13$ whose minimum distance exceeds the lower bound listed in Grassl's code tables at the same $(n,k)$: 161 codes by one and 31 by two. Through the standard propagation rules they raise 1,873 entries of the table. For 190 of the codes, a random Clifford encoder is followed by expurgation: every logical operator of weight below the target distance is enumerated, and a few logical operators are promoted to stabilizers so that each low-weight one anticommutes with at least one of them. The other two are obtained by puncturing a code from the table and repairing it in the same way. All 192 distances are exact: the lower bound is certified by exhaustive meet-in-the-middle enumeration of up to $4\times10^{13}$ Pauli operators, and the upper bound by an explicit logical operator of weight $d$. A first-moment count explains the results. Expurgated random codes have about eight more logical qubits than a typical random code of the same length and distance, so they beat the table wherever its best known codes are no better than random. The largest gains, up to nine logical qubits, are at $d\ge9$ and $n\gtrsim170$, where the table often gives a lower bound without an explicit code. The same count predicts improvements at 619 further pairs $(n,d)$. The search was run by AI agents. The codes, their certificates and an independent checker are public.

analysis.summary: 作者报告 192 个显式 binary stabilizer codes，经标准 propagation rules 改进 Grassl 表 1,873 项。核心机制是随机 Clifford 编码后 expurgation：将少量逻辑算符升为 stabilizers，排除低权逻辑算符。
analysis.problem: 有限长度量子码表的已有下界未必由最佳显式构造达到。
analysis.setting: 码长 53≤n≤254、距离 5≤d≤13；比较相同 (n,k) 的表中距离下界。
main_results: 161 个码提高距离1，31个提高2；190个由随机编码和 expurgation 得到，2个由 puncturing 后修复。
作者以最多约 4×10¹³ 个 Pauli 的 meet-in-the-middle 穷举证下界，并以权重 d 的逻辑算符证上界，声称全部距离精确。
techniques: random Clifford encoder；expurgation；first-moment count；显式证书。
assumptions: 穷举与证书针对所列具体码。
limitations: 仅读取官方摘要，未审阅正文证明及摘要未说明的假设。
独立 checker 和证书未运行；摘要的精确距离仍是作者主张。
距离改进不意味着高效解码、局部校验或更好逻辑阈值。
本条分析仅依据论文摘要，未核查正文证明和摘要中未说明的假设。
relevance: 具体结合随机编码、stabilizer 结构和有限长度 QEC。
follow_up: 读者建议：核验代表性证书，再比较校验权重与解码复杂度。

papers.title: What are local complementations, really?
papers.abstract: A local complementation at a vertex $v$ of a graph $G$ replaces the induced neighborhood of $v$ with its complement. Local complementations are, at face value, peculiar operations. Yet they famously show up when describing the local Clifford equivalence among graph states, and, because of this, have become a fundamental notion in the study of graph states. Following Bouchet, we show here how local complementations on graphs are more naturally thought of in terms of switchings of (matroid) bases of stabilizer states. Bases and switchings reveal structural properties of stabilizer states that are harder to glean from the graph-theoretic description alone, such as vertex-minors and statistics of local Pauli measurements. Bases also simplify prior proofs about graphs up to local complementations, of which we give several examples. Bases are foundational in the study of (multi)matroids; as such this paper serves as a gentle introduction to the applications of multimatroids to quantum information theory.

analysis.summary: 本文以 stabilizer states 的 matroid bases 及其 switchings 重述 graph local complementation，解释 local Clifford 等价中的图操作，并讨论 vertex-minors 与 local Pauli measurement statistics。
analysis.problem: 纯图描述中的邻域取补不易直接显示 stabilizer 结构和测量含义。
analysis.setting: graph states、local Clifford equivalence 与 multimatroids 的结构性介绍。
main_results: bases/switchings 可揭示 vertex-minors 和 Pauli 测量统计，并简化若干已有证明。
techniques: matroid basis switching；图与 stabilizer 表示转换。
assumptions: 对象限于所讨论的 stabilizer/graph-state 结构。
limitations: 仅读取官方摘要，未审阅正文证明及摘要未说明的假设。
摘要未声称新的量子优势、样本界或复杂度改善；未审证明实例。
本条分析仅依据论文摘要，未核查正文证明和摘要中未说明的假设。
relevance: 有助于 stabilizer 计算及测量资源分析，但主要价值为结构统一。
follow_up: 读者建议：用一个小 graph-state Pauli 测量例子核对两种表示的转换。

papers.title: Magic Is in the Eye of the Measure
papers.abstract: Magic, or nonstabilizerness, is the quantum resource behind universal quantum computation. Its applications in high-energy and nuclear physics rely almost exclusively on the stabilizer Rényi entropy (SRE), although magic has no unique measure. For two qubits, we compare the SRE with three measures defined through optimizations over stabilizer states: the min- and max-relative entropies of magic and the logarithmic free robustness. We determine the maximal-magic states of all four measures, with exact proofs, and find that they depend on the measure. In the determination of the weak mixing angle from minimal magic in Møller scattering, the min-relative entropy gives an energy-dependent value that differs from that of the SRE, whereas the max-relative entropy and the logarithmic free robustness give $\sin^2θ_W=1/4$ at all energies. We trace this difference to the non-analytic structure of the optimization-based measures. Physical conclusions drawn from extremizing magic can thus depend on the measure.

analysis.summary: 作者在两 qubits 上比较 SRE、min/max-relative entropy of magic 和 logarithmic free robustness，指出最大 magic 态及由极值导出的物理结论依赖度量选择。
analysis.problem: 高能和核物理应用常只用 SRE，然而 nonstabilizerness 没有唯一度量。
analysis.setting: 四种 magic measures，以及 Møller scattering 中由最小 magic 推断弱混合角的做法。
main_results: 作者声称精确确定四种度量的最大 magic 态，且结果不同。
min-relative entropy 给出能量依赖的角；max-relative entropy 与 logarithmic free robustness 给出各能量下 sin²θW=1/4。
techniques: 对 stabilizer states 的优化；非解析结构比较。
assumptions: 结论在所研究两比特体系和散射设置内。
limitations: 仅读取官方摘要，未审阅正文证明及摘要未说明的假设。
精确证明未审；极值所得角不是实验测量结论。
不能把某度量数值直接换成 T-count 或蒸馏成本。
本条分析仅依据论文摘要，未核查正文证明和摘要中未说明的假设。
relevance: 直接提醒 magic operational resource 与度量选择的区别。
follow_up: 读者建议：比较各度量对应的资源操作和任务单调性，再解读其物理极值。

papers.title: Provable circuit-level thresholds for non-abelian topological phases
papers.abstract: We provide an explicit scheme to realize a quantum memory in any 2D non-chiral topological order. For this, we construct syndrome extraction circuits based on the Turaev-Viro path integral as well as a classical algorithm for decoding on the fly. We prove that our scheme has a threshold under a local stochastic circuit-level noise model and discuss how to generalize it to implement topological logical gates.

analysis.summary: 构造一般二维非手征拓扑序的 syndrome extraction 与在线恢复，给出 circuit-level threshold。
analysis.problem: 一般非 Abelian 相缺少从微观操作到解码的完整容错论证。
analysis.setting: Turaev–Viro/string-net 型非手征二维 bosonic topological orders；local stochastic circuit noise。
main_results: 作者构造局域量子 channels 的测量/修正线路与多项式时间 classical decoder。
引言声称噪声低于常数量级阈值时，逻辑信息可保存 quasi-stretched-exponentially long；经典处理假定足够快速。
techniques: 时空 path integral；聚类 anyon worldlines；逐步移动到 cluster base point。
assumptions: 限定非手征体系及 local stochastic 噪声。
limitations: 只读摘要与引言片段；未审阅完整阈值证明、常数及 logical-gate 扩展。
relevance: 直接连接 syndrome extraction、在线自适应纠错与 non-Clifford 实现路线。
follow_up: 读者建议：比较 syndrome-history 时间窗与经典解码 latency。

papers.title: Polynomial-time classical simulation of boson and fermion sampling under thermal loss
papers.abstract: Sampling experiments are a leading approach to demonstrating quantum computational advantage, yet their robustness to experimental noise is not completely understood. We develop a common framework for classical simulation of boson and fermion sampling under thermal loss, including pure loss. For Fock-state boson sampling, Gaussian boson sampling with fixed uniform squeezing, and fermion sampling with magic inputs, we obtain polynomial-time sampling at inverse-polynomial total variation error, for any fixed nonzero overall loss rate, and with high probability over Haar-random interferometers. A milder flatness assumption on the ideal output distribution suffices for quasipolynomial-time simulation without Haar randomness. With constant thermal loss per layer, the same flatness assumption gives polynomial-time simulation at logarithmic depth. Our bounds for Fock-state boson sampling cover both dilute and saturated regimes and become stronger near full input filling: when only a bounded number of input modes are empty, the noisy output for Haar-random interferometers converges, as the number of modes grows, to a distribution independent of the interferometer.

analysis.summary: 热损耗下 boson/fermion sampling 可在明确分布条件下被高精度经典模拟。
analysis.problem: sampling quantum advantage 对固定损耗是否稳健？
analysis.setting: Fock、固定均匀 squeezing 的 Gaussian boson sampling，以及 magic-input fermion sampling。
main_results: 固定非零总损耗率下，对 Haar interferometers 高概率存在 inverse-polynomial TV error 的多项式采样。
用较弱 flatness 假设替代 Haar 时得到准多项式算法；逐层固定热损耗加 logarithmic depth 时为多项式。
techniques: 统一热损耗模拟框架；输出平坦性。
assumptions: 保证依赖特定模型、Haar 典型性或 flatness。
limitations: 仅依据官方摘要；未审阅正文证明和摘要未说明的假设。
不是任意 BQP simulation，TV error 不等于相对误差；总体损耗与每层损耗须区分。
本条分析仅依据论文摘要，未核查正文证明和摘要中未说明的假设。
relevance: 联系 magic、噪声与量子优势的可模拟边界。
follow_up: 读者建议：核查 fermionic magic-input 类及 flatness 的验证成本。

papers.title: Recovery gates as a resource in repetition-code process tomography: exhaustive gate-optimal designs for three, five and seven qubits
papers.abstract: Process tomography built on stabilizer codes compares the logical channel of a repetition code with a reference channel, and the decoder that produces that channel is almost always fixed to the standard minimum-weight one. We ask how many physical single-qubit Pauli gates the decoder actually needs when the measurement basis is fixed---the constraint under which the count is a resource rather than a bookkeeping artefact. Exhaustive enumeration of every recovery design for $n=3$, $5$ and $7$ qubits, with rank decided by exact modular arithmetic at two primes, gives minimal counts of $0$, $1$ and $5$ gates, against $6$, $10$ and $14$ for first-order decoding and $6$, $50$ and $308$ for full minimum-weight decoding. The count depends only on how many sites are corrected and never on which, so the two halves of the design problem separate. Correcting more sites is not monotonically better: at $n=7$ full decoding loses three dimensions of rank, and under a calibration-residual floor the precision curve at $n=3$ is U-shaped. The three-gate design is $9.5$ times more precise than the standard six-gate decoder at the median of $40$ sampled working points, and more precise at every one of them ($1.8$ to $88$ times); the size of that factor belongs to the working point, the ordering does not. Reaching a $10$\,mrad rms error then costs $1.2\times10^{7}$ shots in $65$\,s on a current superconducting device at a well-conditioned point, while $n\ge5$ stays out of reach for conditioning reasons rather than gate-count reasons. Finally, the optimal designs are not covariant under chain reversal: they separate the mirror pair of arXiv:2610.19779 by $1.3\times10^{-3}$ while leaving the Jacobian at full rank.

analysis.summary: 固定测量基时，recovery gates 的选取会同时影响 process tomography 的可辨识性和精度。
analysis.problem: 标准 minimum-weight decoder 不一定最适于逻辑信道层析。
analysis.setting: 3、5、7 qubit repetition codes；固定测量基、Pauli recovery。
main_results: 穷举及双素数 modular rank 给出最小门计数 0、1、5；对应一阶解码计数 6、10、14。
作者报告 7 qubit 全解码会丢失三个 rank 维度；3 qubit 的精度与门数可呈 U 形。
特定良态点达到 10 mrad rms 需 1.2×10^7 shots；该估计不可推广为统一样本复杂度。
techniques: exhaustive recovery enumeration；exact rank。
assumptions: 固定基约束是门计数作为真实资源的前提。
limitations: 仅依据官方摘要；未审阅正文证明和摘要未说明的假设。
未核查 SPAM、漂移与硬件时间估算；并非一般门认证最优性定理。
本条分析仅依据论文摘要，未核查正文证明和摘要中未说明的假设。
relevance: 直接对应 logical tomography 的恢复选择与 shot 资源。
follow_up: 读者建议：核查可辨识 rank 与最小奇异值的区别。

papers.title: Certifying quantum code and circuit distances at scale
papers.abstract: Code and circuit distances characterize how strongly quantum error correction suppresses logical errors and guide code comparisons, schedule choices and resource estimates. Yet many published distances are only upper bounds from heuristic searches. Here, we express both distances as tropical partition functions and evaluate them with rank-based dynamic programming and weight-bounded search. Circuit reductions and relaxations shrink the problems, and proved lower bounds with explicit logical errors of matching weight certify exact values. On two benchmarks, our method certifies more instances than all other tested exact solvers combined. We certify distances for codes with up to 31,200 qubits, such as Google's modular hyperbolic codes, and for memory circuits with up to $8\times10^5$ fault mechanisms, such as those of high-rate Cornucopia codes. Our audit of 26 recent papers identifies overestimated distances and non-tight upper bounds in 10 papers, with a maximum discrepancy of at least eight. Certified distances also guide circuit design and show which defective chips remain usable. In particular, we certify circuit distance 16 for IBM's two-gross memory circuits with the standard schedule, not the assumed 18, whereas redesigned schedules reach 18 at one noisy cycle, at the cost of one more timestep per cycle. At 99.98% junction yield, keeping gross-code memory blocks with dead checks that are certified at distance 10 or more raises the estimated usable share from 53% for perfect blocks alone to 94% with an improved schedule.

analysis.summary: 同时给出下界及等重逻辑故障证据，严格认证 code/circuit distance。
analysis.problem: 启发式发现的低重错误只是上界，容易被误当精确距离。
analysis.setting: 大规模 stabilizer codes 与 quantum-memory circuit fault mechanisms。
main_results: 作者将距离写成 tropical partition functions，以动态规划和 bounded-weight search 计算。
报告认证至 31,200 qubit codes 和 8×10^5 fault mechanisms；审计 26 篇中 10 篇存在距离高估或不紧上界。
特定 two-gross standard schedule 的 circuit distance 被报告为 16 而非假定 18；改排程以额外 timestep 换回 18。
techniques: rank-based DP；relaxation；匹配上下界。
assumptions: 精确认证针对被列出的 codes、circuits、fault models。
limitations: 仅依据官方摘要；未审阅正文证明和摘要未说明的假设。
未独立复算证书；码距不直接决定某一噪声率下逻辑保真度。
本条分析仅依据论文摘要，未核查正文证明和摘要中未说明的假设。
relevance: 直接支持逻辑性能评估、syndrome schedule 与资源核算。
follow_up: 读者建议：检查证书是否涵盖测量故障和时间边界。

papers.title: Uniform Three-Fold Product Expansion of Algebraic-Geometry Codes over a Fixed Field
papers.abstract: A collection of classical codes $C_1,\dots,C_m$ has product expansion if every low-weight word in the sum of their extensions to the product space can be written as a sum of words supported on few lines, each line being a codeword of the corresponding $C_i$. For $m=2$ product expansion is equivalent to robust testability of the tensor code, while for $m\ge 3$ it is strictly stronger; it is the hypothesis on the local codes behind recent constructions of good quantum LDPC codes, good quantum locally testable codes, and quantum codes with transversal non-Clifford gates. No explicit family over a fixed field was previously known to achieve constant rate, linear distance for both the code and its dual, and 3-fold product expansion at growing length. We prove that for the one-point evaluation codes $C_i$ of length $N_i=728\cdot27^{\,i-1}$ and pole order $\lfloor N_i/5\rfloor$ on the Garcia--Stichtenoth tower over $\mathbb{F}_{729}$, the triple $(C_i,C_i,C_i)$ has product expansion with a constant independent of $i$. The dual codes $C_i^\perp$ then form an explicit fixed-field family of rate tending to $109/130$ and relative distance at least $8/65$. The proof is geometric: we view the words of the sum code as arrays on the product of three copies of the $i$-th curve of the tower, where the parity checks are sections of a line bundle. An exact generation theorem describes the sum-code words supported on the grid footprint of a suitable divisor. A support-localisation argument then shows that every low-weight array lies on such a divisor, after deleting a small number of coordinates. We also give a sufficient criterion for three-fold product expansion in terms of degree and genus ratios, yielding explicit families over every non-prime finite field of order at least $512$. The principal conclusions have been formally verified in Lean 4.

analysis.summary: 固定有限域上的显式代数几何码族满足统一 three-fold product expansion。
analysis.problem: 好 qLDPC、QLTC 与 transversal non-Clifford 构造需要比 robust testability 更强的局部码性质。
analysis.setting: Garcia–Stichtenoth tower 上 F_729 的 one-point evaluation codes。
main_results: 作者对 N_i=728·27^(i−1)、pole order floor(N_i/5) 的三重码证明与 i 无关的 expansion constant。
其 dual family 的 rate 趋于 109/130，relative distance 至少 8/65。
给出 degree/genus 充分条件并扩展到阶数至少 512 的非素有限域。
techniques: 曲线三重积；line bundle；support localization。
assumptions: 这些数值是 classical constituent codes 参数。
limitations: 仅依据官方摘要；未审阅正文证明和摘要未说明的假设。
不能直接宣称由此得到同样参数的 quantum code；Lean 验证未独立检查。
本条分析仅依据论文摘要，未核查正文证明和摘要中未说明的假设。
relevance: 为 qLDPC 和 transversal magic gate 构造提供关键假设。
follow_up: 读者建议：追踪代入量子构造后 locality 与常数损失。

papers.title: Non-Unitary Quantum Butterfly Effect: Theory and Experiment
papers.abstract: We present a generalization of the out of time order correlator (OTOC) for non-unitary systems. For a Haar-random brickwork qudit-circuit, peppered with local, projective measurement, we calculate the infinite-temperature, ensemble-average OTOC. Utilizing transfer matrix machinery, we find that the OTOC asymptotically decays exponentially and that the decay depends on the rate of measurement. In the thermodynamic limit, with sparse measurement, the OTOC approximately exhibits a Gaussian shape. Phenomenologically, this corresponds to the development of a causal scrambling front where unlike the unitary case, the signal decays in the bulk of the causal cone. We develop a Monte Carlo framework to compute the OTOC. We then estimate the OTOC directly via quantum simulation and on Quantinuum's trapped-ion quantum computer. We resolve the unitary and non-unitary OTOC phenomenology despite the presence of hardware noise. Our analytic results characterize how local nonunitary channels affect OTOC decay, providing a quantitative benchmark for the cumulative effects of a broad class of hardware noise on many-body dynamics.

analysis.summary: 非 unitary OTOC 将测量导致的信号衰减与 scrambling front 区分。
analysis.problem: 含局域测量时，传统 unitary butterfly 诊断如何改变？
analysis.setting: Haar-random brickwork qudit circuits；局部投影测量；infinite-temperature ensemble average。
main_results: transfer matrix 分析得到依赖测量率的渐近指数衰减；热力学极限稀疏测量下近似 Gaussian。
Monte Carlo、量子模拟和 trapped-ion 实验区分 unitary/nonunitary 行为。
techniques: transfer matrices；OTOC estimation。
assumptions: 解析保证是特定 ensemble 平均和温度条件。
limitations: 仅依据官方摘要；未审阅正文证明和摘要未说明的假设。
不是一般噪声门保真度的 SPAM-robust estimator；摘要未给 shot 开销。
本条分析仅依据论文摘要，未核查正文证明和摘要中未说明的假设。
relevance: 直接连接 random circuits、scrambling 与 noise diagnostics。
follow_up: 读者建议：核查非unitary 归一化及 measurement backaction 的访问方式。

papers.title: Efficient Pauli Truncation from Operator Stabilizer Rényi Entropy
papers.abstract: Operator stabilizer Rényi entropy (OSE) quantifies the magic of Heisenberg operators and serves as a diagnostic of their compressibility in the Pauli basis. We establish rigorous bounds showing when an operator can be efficiently approximated by Pauli truncation in terms of the scaling of its OSE. Specifically, we prove that volume-law scaling of OSE for $α\geq1$ prevents efficient Pauli truncation from reproducing expectation values for all states at sufficiently small fixed error. On the other hand, logarithmic growth of OSE for $0<α<1/2$ guarantees efficient Pauli truncation approximability uniformly over all states. A counterexample shows that this sufficient range cannot be extended on the basis of OSE scaling alone. If we restrict to correlations over suitable low-average state ensembles, then the sufficient range extends to $0<α<1$. We further derive cumulative error bounds for iterative Pauli propagation and approximation guarantees for fixed-order out-of-time-ordered correlators. Moreover, under an independent-sign assumption, we show that logarithmic OSE for $0<α<1$ guarantees efficient Pauli truncation with the prescribed accuracy for all input states with high probability. Our results provide a theoretical framework for understanding when operator magic constrains or enables efficient Pauli truncation and for guiding the development of classical simulation methods.

analysis.summary: operator magic 的 Rényi 指数决定 Top-χ Pauli 截断能否对所有输入态控制期望值误差。
analysis.problem: Hilbert–Schmidt tail 小不必意味着 spectral-norm error 小。
analysis.setting: Hermitian Heisenberg operators，2^-N tr(O²)=1；保留绝对值最大的 χ 个 Pauli 系数。
main_results: 作者给出 logarithmic OSE 在 0<α<1/2 下保证 uniform efficient approximability，而 α≥1/2 存在反例。
适当 low-average ensembles 可把充分区间扩展到 0<α<1；独立随机符号下另有高概率 spectral-norm 结论。
volume-law 高阶 OSE 阻碍固定误差的高效截断；文章区分紧凑表示与寻找系数的计算问题。
techniques: Pauli coefficient tails；不同误差范数；Top-χ approximation。
assumptions: uniform-over-states、ensemble-average 与 random-sign 三种保证不可混用。
limitations: 本轮仅读摘要、引言和定义片段；未逐项核查证明、iterative error accumulation 或符号独立假设的物理适用性。
relevance: 直接联系 magic、Pauli simulation、信息访问与近似精度标准。
follow_up: 读者建议：检查研究中的物理 ensemble 是否有 random-sign 假设，不能把可压缩性当完整模拟算法。

papers.title: Extensions of the Haldane gap proof: higher dimensions, near degeneracy, fermions and tensor-network states
papers.abstract: A recent remarkable paper by OpenAI showed that the spin-one Heisenberg chain with periodic boundary conditions has a spectral gap in the thermodynamic limit. The proof elegantly deduces this gap from the Hamiltonian's spectrum on a finite system. This basic idea is an inequality involving the purity of the original Gibbs state and a dual Gibbs state that is defined via space-time rotation. Here we consider a few generalizations of this purity bootstrap argument. We first extend it to arbitrary spatial dimensions. Our main result uses the space-time duality between symmetry generators and symmetry twists to obtain upper bounds on the splitting of nearly degenerate low-energy states, together with a nonzero gap above them, from finite-system information. As applications, we show that finite-system calculations for the 2+1-D toric code in a field and the 2+1-D transverse-field Ising model establish parameter regimes with four and two low-lying states whose splittings are bounded from above by $e^{-cL}$ and $e^{-cL^2}$ respectively for arbitrarily large system size $L$, while the gap above these states remains nonzero in the thermodynamic limit. Next, we extend it to fermionic systems and use a finite calculation to establish a symmetric mass generation phase in a $2+1$-D fermionic model. Finally, we apply the bootstrap to tensor-network states and establish exponential decay of connected correlations of all local operators in the symmetric square-lattice spin-one state introduced by Jian and Zaletel.

analysis.summary: purity bootstrap 把有限系统谱信息提升为大系统近简并分裂与谱隙控制。
analysis.problem: 有限尺寸证据怎样约束热力学极限的低能结构？
analysis.setting: space-time dual Gibbs states；高维 spin/fermionic systems。
main_results: 作者将 symmetry generator/twist 的时空对偶用于近简并态。

papers.title: Quantum Gibbs Sampling Through the Detectability Lemma
authors: Di Fang, Jianfeng Lu, Yu Tong, and Chu Zhao
papers.abstract: Gibbs state preparation is an important subroutine in quantum computing. In this work we use the detectability lemma to improve Gibbs state preparation. Specifically, we design new Gibbs state preparation methods that do not rely on simulating Lindbladian evolution, thus avoiding the overhead from it. For local Lindbladians consisting of M terms, this approach reduces the cost by a factor of O ( M ) . We also combine the detectability lemma operator and quantum singular value transformation to implement ground state projection operators of frustration-free Hamiltonians, resulting in a quadratic speedup in the spectral gap dependence. Applying this method to Lindbladians for the Gibbs state of local commuting Hamiltonians, we achieve quadratically better dependence on the Lindbladian spectral gap.

analysis.summary: 用 detectability lemma 的局域更新替代完整 Lindbladian simulation，降低 Gibbs preparation 的算法成本。
analysis.problem: 准备热态的代价不仅取决于 relaxation gap，也包含实现整个耗散演化的开销。
analysis.setting: 由 M 个局域项构成的 Lindbladians；另讨论 frustration-free ground-state projection 和局域 commuting Hamiltonians。
main_results: 作者主张绕开 Lindbladian simulation 可减少 O(M) 因子的成本。
detectability-lemma operator 与 QSVT 结合，对 frustration-free projection 的 gap dependence 得到平方加速；在局域 commuting Gibbs sampler 上得到 Lindbladian gap 的平方改善。

papers.title: Dithered Belief Propagation for Real-Time Quantum Memory Decoding
papers.abstract: We introduce dithered belief-propagation decoding for circuit-level quantum memory to mitigate the oscillations and trapping behavior that limit standard belief-propagation (BP) decoders for qLDPC codes. Our approach combines a quantum-adapted sign-flip mechanism with chained randomized prior perturbation. Evaluated under circuit-level noise on the distance-11 rotated surface code and the distance-12 bivariate-bicycle code, the proposed dithered decoder significantly outperforms BP and BP+OSD+CS-10. The proposed decoder achieves accuracy comparable to or better than state-of-the-art Relay-BP, especially at higher physical error rates, while trading a moderate increase in additions for about 98% fewer multiplications on average and eliminating node-level RNGs. These results suggest that dithering is a promising approach toward real-time decoding of quantum memories.

analysis.summary: dithered BP 针对 qLDPC circuit-level decoding 的振荡和 trapping。
analysis.problem: 普通 BP 可能不收敛或陷入错误候选。
analysis.setting: distance-11 rotated surface code 与 distance-12 bivariate-bicycle code 的 circuit-level noise。
main_results: 结合 quantum-adapted sign flips 与随机 prior perturbations，作者报告优于 BP/BP+OSD+CS-10，并在部分区间匹敌或超过 Relay-BP。
平均乘法数减少约 98%，代价是适度增加加法；消除 node-level RNG。
techniques: dithering；chained prior perturbation。

papers.title: Field-aligned measurement removes the anisotropy barrier of sample-based quantum subspace solvers for magnetized-plasma heat conduction
papers.abstract: Sample-based quantum subspace methods construct a small subspace from measured basis states and solve the target problem classically within it. We study these methods for heat conduction in magnetized plasmas, where the anisotropy $χ_\parallel/χ_\perp$ reaches $10^8$ to $10^{10}$. We prove two results for the energy-norm Galerkin solution. First, if the measurement basis is aligned with the flux surfaces and the subspace contains the poloidal-mode-zero block, the error is bounded by $\|r_0\|_{L^+}(χ_\parallel-χ_\perp)^{-1/2}$, where the numerator does not depend on $χ_\parallel$. The bound is sharp, so the accuracy improves as the anisotropy grows. Second, in the computational basis, a subspace that misses a single node of a flux surface suppresses the flux-function component there as $χ_\parallel^{-1/2}$, which gives an error floor when the limiting solution is nonzero on that surface. We verify both results on a shaped cross-section and on a KSTAR-like Miller equilibrium with ten qubits. At $χ_\parallel/χ_\perp=10^9$, the computational basis gives an error of order unity for every shot budget, whereas a quantum Fourier transform on the poloidal register gives $1.3\times10^{-5}$. The same barrier limits sample-based quantum diagonalization. The aligned measurement needs no time evolution, so the circuit is only state preparation and a five-qubit quantum Fourier transform. On a ten-qubit superconducting processor, the aligned basis gives a median error of $7.0\times10^{-6}$ with 768 shots, whereas the computational basis gives errors above 0.94 up to $1.2\times10^4$ shots. A trapped-ion processor shows the same behavior.

analysis.summary: measurement basis 的结构匹配可消除 sample-based subspace solver 的系统误差底。
analysis.problem: 增大 shots 无法补救测量得到的子空间缺失关键结构。
analysis.setting: 磁化等离子体热传导的 energy-norm Galerkin solution；field-aligned basis。
main_results: 作者证明包含 poloidal-mode-zero block 的对齐子空间误差受与 anisotropy 差值平方根成反比的界控制。
computational basis 缺失 flux-surface 节点时产生非消失误差底；所报告十 qubit 实验中对齐测量 768 shots 的 median error 为 7.0×10^-6。
techniques: 结构化基变换；Galerkin error bounds；QFT readout。
assumptions: 依赖 PDE 结构、子空间包含条件和指定误差范数。
limitations: 仅依据官方摘要；未审阅正文证明和摘要未说明的假设。

papers.title: Logically Augmented Quantum LDPC Codes: Construction and Hierarchical Decoding
papers.abstract: We propose a joint framework for constructing and decoding Logically Augmented (LA) quantum low-density parity-check (QLDPC) codes. This is motivated by the need for flexible coding rates and adaptive error protection while preserving block length and code structure. On the construction side, we use an auxiliary \textit{Logical Protection Code (LPC)} to impose additional stabilizer constraints on selected logical qubits of a \textit{primary} code. On the decoding side, the proposed decoder uses the LPC syndrome to generate logical error hypotheses and condition belief propagation (BP) on each hypothesis. The proposed \textit{Hierarchical Logical List Decoder (HLLD)} is invoked only when the initial BP decoder for primary code fails to converge. It then selects the correction with the smallest Hamming weight among the syndrome-consistent candidates produced by hypothesis-conditioned BP runs. For numerical evaluation, we focus on short repetition LPCs, which provide a flexible means of trading rate for additional error protection. Each LPC syndrome admits exactly two logical error hypotheses, irrespective of repetition length, which enables HLLD to explore both possibilities without relying on a single logical estimate. Numerical results show that varying the repetition length provides a tunable trade-off between rate and error-correction performance across a wide range of primary code constructions and their operating regimes. On the decoding side, with the overall LA code held fixed, HLLD reduces the logical error rate by up to 81\%, 75\%, and 69\% for LA codes based on mitten, lifted-product, and bivariate bicycle codes, respectively, compared with conventional BP decoding of the same LA codes.

analysis.summary: 额外逻辑 stabilizer constraints 与分层解码实现 rate/protection tradeoff。
analysis.problem: 固定 block length 下如何灵活保护部分逻辑 qubits？
analysis.setting: primary qLDPC code 加 Logical Protection Code；BP 失败后启用 HLLD。
main_results: LPC syndrome 生成候选逻辑错误，再条件化 BP；选择 syndrome-consistent candidates 中最低 Hamming weight。
短 repetition LPC 每个 syndrome 有两个假设；同一 LA code 上相对普通 BP 的 LER 改善最高为 81%、75%、69%，分别对应三个被测 code families。
techniques: logical constraints；hypothesis-conditioned BP。
assumptions: 数值使用短 repetition LPC；比较 decoder 时总码保持相同。
limitations: 仅依据官方摘要；未审阅正文证明和摘要未说明的假设。

papers.title: Single-shot ground-state preparation via strongly coupled baths
papers.abstract: Preparing ground and thermal states of quantum many-body systems is a central task in quantum simulation. Dissipative protocols have emerged as a promising solution for both near-term and fault-tolerant hardware, but most constructions rely on weak system-bath coupling, leading to slow cooling. Here, we construct cooling protocols at strong system-bath coupling, and demonstrate accurate state preparation within even a single cooling cycle. Our protocols combine dynamically ramped ancilla energy levels with time-dependent couplings to optimize the trade-off between cooling error and physical time. For a general class of free-fermion systems, we reduce the dynamics exactly to a two-level scattering problem: ground-state cooling becomes a control problem of maximizing resonant excitation transfer while suppressing non-adiabatic heating. We then construct a family of ``Möbius-Ingham'' protocols, which reach optimal error scaling for gapless spectra and almost-exponential suppression of the leading heating error for gapped spectra, as a function of the cycle period. In our free-fermion benchmarks, Möbius-Ingham cooling lies on the Pareto frontier between steady-state error and cooling time among the controls tested. We further demonstrate its effectiveness in interacting Ising and $t$-$V$ chains and the two-dimensional Fermi-Hubbard model. Finally, we extend our construction to Gibbs state preparation, showing how free-fermion thermal states can be prepared in a single cycle.

analysis.summary: 强 system-bath coupling 可用单个冷却周期准备自由费米基态及热态。
analysis.problem: 弱耦合制备慢，需在 transfer 与非绝热 heating 间取舍。
analysis.setting: 可调 ancilla 能级和时变耦合；free fermions 的 two-level scattering reduction。
main_results: 作者构造 Möbius–Ingham protocols，主张无隙体系最优 error scaling、有隙体系 leading heating error 近指数压低。
单周期 thermal-state preparation 的构造针对 free fermions；另有 interacting systems 数值演示。
techniques: 二能级散射；time-dependent cooling control。
assumptions: ancilla 与动态控制不是免费资源。
limitations: 仅依据官方摘要；未审阅正文证明和摘要未说明的假设。
single-shot 指单周期，不代表单次 measurement shot；摘要未给精确误差表达式和所有实现资源。
本条分析仅依据论文摘要，未核查正文证明和摘要中未说明的假设。

papers.title: Threshold-Free Symmetry-Enriched Topological Quantum Memory
papers.abstract: We show that non-Abelian symmetry enrichment can protect a toric code memory against incoherent electric noise at any bond error probability $p\in[0,1]$. For a toric code on the honeycomb lattice coupled to $Sp(N)$ rotors, with electric anyons carrying the fundamental representation, we construct an efficient minimum-weight decoder whose logical error probability decays exponentially with system size for $N\ge40$, a conservative sufficient bound. The same decoder also rules out strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking in the fundamental channel of $Sp(N)$ under the corresponding local decoherence in two dimensions. The construction extends to other symmetries, including $SU(N)$.

analysis.summary: symmetry enrichment 可在特定电噪声模型下实现无阈值 toric-code memory。
analysis.problem: 可否利用非 Abelian 对称性给 anyon 额外保护？
analysis.setting: honeycomb toric code 耦合 Sp(N) rotors；electric anyons 携带 fundamental representation。
main_results: 作者构造 efficient minimum-weight decoder；N≥40 是保守充分条件，对任意 bond error probability p∈[0,1]，logical error 随尺寸指数下降。
构造还讨论 SU(N) 等其他对称性。
techniques: non-Abelian symmetry enrichment；minimum-weight decoding。
assumptions: 特定 incoherent electric noise，不是任意 Pauli/circuit-level noise。
limitations: 仅依据官方摘要；未审阅正文证明和摘要未说明的假设。

papers.title: Nonlocal magic of fermions is bounded by entanglement fluctuations and is logarithmic for free fermions
papers.abstract: Free-fermion states are classically simulable, yet, written as qubits, they typically carry extensive magic, the quantum resource that stabilizer circuits lack. Part of this magic is nonlocal: local unitaries acting separately on two parts of the system cannot remove it. If these local unitaries are restricted to Gaussian ones, the nonlocal magic grows linearly with the number $m$ of partially entangled fermion pairs. We show that this growth is an artifact of the Gaussian restriction: local Gaussian unitaries minimize the nonlocal stabilizer Rényi entropy for up to three pairs, but not from four pairs on. General local non-Gaussian unitaries that respect fermion parity take $m$ free-fermion pairs to fermionic Bell pairs with a fidelity that decays at most as $1/\sqrt m$ compared to exponential decay with Gaussian unitaries, so the nonlocal magic drops from linear to logarithmic in $m$. The reason is statistical --- Bell pairs have equal Schmidt weights, that is, a fully degenerate entanglement spectrum, and a state can stay far from them only if its Schmidt weights are spread over many orders of magnitude. This spread is measured by the capacity of entanglement $C_E$, the variance of the entanglement Hamiltonian, and the nonlocal magic of any fermionic state grows at most logarithmically with $C_E$. Free-fermion pairs add to $C_E$ independently, so $C_E$ grows only linearly in $m$, and this leads to the stabilizer fidelity decreasing at most as $1/\sqrt m$. Almost all the magic of free fermions, including Hartree--Fock and BCS mean-field states, is therefore local.

analysis.summary: 允许 parity-preserving 非 Gaussian 局域幺正后，自由费米态的 nonlocal magic 可从线性降到对数；这并不减少被忽略的局域操作自身的 magic 成本。
analysis.problem: Gaussian 态可高效经典模拟却在 qubit 表示下有 extensive magic，需分清总资源与跨分区不可局域消除的资源。
analysis.setting: v1 的摘要、引言及定义片段；双分区 definite-parity pure fermionic states。nonlocal measure 对各侧 parity-even unitaries 优化，包括非 Gaussian 操作。
main_results: 作者比较 Gaussian restriction 与完整 parity-preserving local-unitary optimization：至多三个 BCS pairs 时 Gaussian 操作已最优，从四对起不再总成立。
文中将 Bell-pair overlap 写成 Schmidt spectrum 的选择问题；最优化的 fidelity 是平方 overlap。一般态可达到至少 0.478/√(C_E+5)，C_E 为纠缠 Hamiltonian 的方差。
free-fermion pairs 的 C_E 可加、每对至多约 0.44，因而得到至少 1/√m 量级的 stabilizer fidelity。对远离 product/Bell 极限的 partially entangled pairs，作者讨论从 extensive 到 logarithmic 的 scaling。
techniques: parity-resolved Schmidt spectrum；BCS normal form；Fock-state permutations；entanglement capacity。
assumptions: 局域操作只指不跨 A/B，允许各侧内部的非 Gaussian、多模操作；它们不保证浅层或低 T-count。
partially entangled pairs 的 occupations 需与 0、1/2、1 保持固定间隔，才能作相应 extensive 比较。
limitations: 仅读正文前部，未审阅后续定理证明、Supplemental Material 和全部 finite-size constants；没有检查构造局域幺正的算法复杂度。
不能把 nonlocal magic 的对数界解释为原始态总 T-count 或 stabilizer rank 的对数/多项式上界；该资源定义优化掉了局域成本。
relevance: 直接涉及 fermionic resources、magic 的操作依赖性及与 classical simulability 的区别。
follow_up: 读者建议：比较 Gaussian-only、parity-even unrestricted 和几何局域浅层控制三种操作集。
读者建议：检验要用于 design 的资源成本是否包含这些局域非 Gaussian 幺正。

papers.title: Arithmetic Depth, Minimal Gate Alphabets, and Exact Program-State Resources for Single-Qubit Dyadic Programs
papers.abstract: Resource analyses for quantum programs commonly provide safe upper bounds on qubits, gates, or non-Clifford operations. We study a single-qubit dyadic fragment in which the deepest exact resource layer can instead be inferred exactly. Starting from the normalized-midpoint misty-state syntax, we define dyadic program states and the real cyclotomic tower $K_D=\mathbb Q(2\cos(π/2^D))$. For the projective single-qubit Clifford-cyclotomic tower $\widehat G_D\subseteq SO(3)$, we prove the relative intersection law $\widehat G_D\cap SO(3,K_d)=\widehat G_d$ for $d\le D$. Combining this descent theorem with an arithmetic-closure invariant for adaptive stabilizer processing yields $\mathrm{Fdepth}(U)=\mathrm{Adepth}(U)=\mathrm{Rdepth}(U)$: the smallest real cyclotomic field containing the Bloch matrix of an exactly synthesizable channel, the shallowest dyadic gate alphabet realizing it up to global phase, and the shallowest dyadic program-state layer sufficient for exact stabilizer-assisted implementation coincide. At that common minimum, known fixed-alphabet synthesis gives minimum primitive-rotation count. We package the result as an exact static resource effect and outline a certificate-producing compiler.

analysis.summary: 作者在可精确合成的单比特 dyadic Clifford–cyclotomic 模型中，把三种资源层级联系起来：Bloch 矩阵所需的最小实分圆域、实现该信道的最浅门字母表，以及 stabilizer 辅助实现所需的最深 dyadic program-state 层级。这里的“depth”指代数资源层级，不能当作线路并行深度或 magic-state 数量。
analysis.problem: 精确合成通常先固定门集，再优化门数；本文先问目标信道究竟必须使用多精细的旋转角或资源态，能否通过自适应 Pauli 测量把所需资源层级降低。
analysis.setting: 目标是属于 dyadic Clifford–cyclotomic 并集的单比特幺正信道，忽略全局相位。免费操作包含 Clifford、stabilizer ancilla、Pauli 测量、经典 feed-forward 和丢弃；资源态可以任意有限次使用，且只来自声明的 dyadic 层级。
main_results: 作者证明相对交定理：在已知可合成的门群内，Bloch 矩阵落入较浅实分圆域，等价于该信道可用较浅门字母表精确合成。
对该并集中的非 Clifford 信道，作者得到 Fdepth(U)=Adepth(U)=Rdepth(U)。在最小字母表确定后，已有固定门集最优合成给出最少 primitive rotation 数。
techniques: 以 Pauli 期望值生成的域作为不变量：Clifford 只置换并改变符号，Pauli 测量产生 dyadic 线性组合，分支归一化只取商，因此有限自适应 stabilizer 处理不能添加该域之外的代数数。
用 Bloch/Pauli-transfer 表示消除全局相位，并把已有 canonical form 的分母指数信息与实分圆域逐层下降结合；资源态注入及倍角纠正给出匹配实现。
assumptions: 这是 exact synthesis 的结论，目标预先属于指定可合成并集；仅有域包含关系并不刻画所有 SO(3,K_D) 矩阵。
不允许免费提供含有额外代数参数的外部控制；协议必须是有限的。
limitations: 本条阅读了自动提取的 arXiv HTML，公式和图像可能有抽取损失，未独立核验全部证明。
最小资源层级不同于最小 magic 数量；本文不能直接给出一般多比特线路的 T-count 下界，也没有误差容忍的近似版本。
relevance: 与 magic、stabilizer 和 ancilla/adaptivity 的资源关系直接相关，提供了标量 magic monotone 之外的代数障碍。
follow_up: 读者建议：检查相同域不变量在有催化资源与小但非零实现误差时是否还能转化为定量界；近似情形不能直接沿用 exact 障碍。

papers.title: Discovering correlated error mechanisms: data-driven augmentation of detector error models improving decoding
papers.abstract: Accurate decoder priors are essential for high-performance quantum error correction. Theoretical noise models inevitably omit physically relevant error mechanisms, most notably correlated errors, which appear consistently in experimental error budgets yet are absent from standard models. We introduce a data-driven method for augmenting detector error models (DEMs) by discovering entirely new error mechanisms directly from experimental detector-firing statistics, going beyond most existing approaches that merely refine the probabilities of already-known mechanisms. Our method generates candidates by combining pairs of existing mechanisms as building blocks, then filters and validates them using pairwise and higher-order detector correlations. Crucially, this construction provides each newly discovered mechanism with a well-defined logical effect derived from the constituent error mechanisms, enabling its direct use in decoding. Furthermore, each mechanism is accompanied by a natural decomposition into lower-order components, preserving compatibility with the original decoder. This is particularly valuable in settings that rely on correlated graph-based decoders such as correlated matching. We evaluate the method on surface-code simulations with correlated noise and correlated-matching decoding, demonstrating that, in a realistic near-term noise scenario, DEM augmentation increases the Lambda parameter by 20% across code distances 7-15 and reduces the logical error rate by 75% at code distance 15 relative to the unaugmented DEM. On experimental data from Google's superconducting device, the augmented DEM increases the Lambda parameter by 9% across code distances 5-7 and yields a reduction of 14% in logical error rate over the baseline for distance 7. To our knowledge, this is the first data-driven DEM augmentation method that produces decomposed hyperedges with assigned logical effects.

analysis.summary: 本文从 syndrome detector 的统计数据中发现原始 detector error model（DEM）缺失的相关错误机制，再把新机制及其 logical effect 接回现有 decoder。关键变化是扩充模型支持的错误类型，而非仅调优已有边的概率。

papers.title: Universally Certifying Partially Self-Correcting Quantum Memories in 3D Translation-Invariant Stabilizer Codes
papers.abstract: Achieving passive protection of quantum information at finite temperature is a central problem at the intersection of quantum information and quantum many-body physics. Yet a general, computable criterion for determining self-correcting behavior directly from the form of local interactions remains elusive. Here we develop a unified algebraic-geometric framework for certifying partial self-correction in three-dimensional translation-invariant local stabilizer codes, encompassing the cubic code as a special case. From the algebraic curves defined by the codes' defining polynomials, we construct valuation matrices on the boundaries of their normalized projective closures and derive a computable rank criterion. Together with a polynomial-time decoder, this criterion guarantees super-Arrhenius memory lifetimes for code families satisfying it under the specified local Davies dynamics. We apply the framework to certify several classes of partially self-correcting quantum memories, including nearest-neighbor models with stabilizer weight as low as six and long memory lifetimes at modest system sizes. These results establish an algebraic-geometric connection between local stabilizer structure and the recoverability of quantum information at finite temperature, providing a systematic approach to certifying and designing passive quantum memories.

analysis.summary: 作者把一类三维平移不变局域 stabilizer code 的部分自纠错性质，归结为可从生成多项式计算的代数几何条件。机制是用曲线边界处的 valuation 限制带电激发的移动，进而建立 no-strings 性质、对数能垒及低温寿命保证。
analysis.problem: 已有自纠错分析经常需要逐个模型验证 topological order 和 no-strings 条件。本文希望直接由局域稳定子相互作用的多项式表示得到可计算的充分判据。
analysis.setting: 主要对象是用二元 Laurent 多项式 f,g 指定的三维 trivariate bicycle 码族，采用周期边界，系统含 2L^3 个物理比特；热噪声模型为指定的局域 Pauli Davies dynamics。
main_results: 作者给出充分条件：生成理想适当、gcd(f,g)=1，并且每个相关不可约分支的 valuation matrix 具有列满秩 3。结合有效恢复，可推出部分自纠错。
证明路线得到逻辑能垒 Omega(log L)，并找到包括近邻、稳定子权重低至 6 的实例。部分自纠错指温度依赖的有限尺寸窗口及适当选择尺寸时的低温 super-Arrhenius 寿命。

满秩把边界阶数约束转回空间位移约束，从而证明 uniform no-strings condition；再结合局域 topological order 与可多项式时间运行的恢复程序获得寿命结论。

papers.title: Bridging Pulse and Circuit Levels: A Geometric Framework for Deterministic Error Suppression
papers.abstract: Quantum errors in noisy environments remain a major obstacle to advancing quantum information technology. Standard quantum error correction requires massive ancillary qubit overhead, motivating the need for hardware-efficient mitigation strategies. In this work, we propose a framework for dynamical quantum error correction at the circuit level, requiring no logical encoding or ancillary qubits. By extending a geometric framework (originally developed for creating dynamical error-correcting gates at the control pulse level) to the discrete dynamics of digital circuits, we map the accumulation of coherent errors to trajectories in a high-dimensional error space. We demonstrate that inserting deterministically optimized twirling gate sequences actively shapes these trajectories, utilizing destructive interference to keep the accumulated error bounded with error scaling $\mathcal{O}(1)$. This deterministic path-shaping suppresses circuit errors fundamentally differently than the stochastic random-walk behavior of standard randomized compiling with error scaling $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{N})$. Furthermore, we show that this circuit-level dynamical correction synergizes with pulse-level robust control, providing an analytical bridge between continuous noise dynamics and discrete quantum compilation. This research illuminates pathways to achieving highly noise-resistant quantum circuits prior to the era of fault tolerance.

analysis.summary: 本文把 coherent error 的累积写成广义 Pauli 空间中的向量轨迹，通过确定性选择 twirling 序列来诱导误差抵消。它连接连续脉冲控制和离散 randomized compiling，但正文展示的优化与示例不能读成任意长线路、任意噪声下的恒定误差保证。

papers.title: Connection of surface code patches based on entanglement distillation without postselection
papers.abstract: Distributed quantum computing is a promising approach for overcoming the scalability limitations of fault-tolerant quantum computing. Entanglement distillation, a process that extracts higher-fidelity entangled states from noisy ones, plays a key role in distributed quantum computing. However, simple distillation protocols typically rely on postselection, which poses practical challenges for implementation. Here, we propose a scheme for distributed surface-code quantum computing that benefits from entanglement distillation even without postselection. Numerical simulations show that the logical error rates in the proposed scheme are lower than those in the setting without distillation. Additionally, we demonstrate that the logical error rates can be suppressed further by exploiting the asymmetry between spacelike and timelike errors in the surface code. The proposed scheme offers a practical and simple approach to distributed quantum computing with surface codes.

analysis.summary: 作者将最简单的 2-to-1 entanglement-distillation 测量结果作为后续 surface-code 解码的 soft information，使“失败”输出也能保留使用。收益来自条件错误概率被 decoder 利用，而非声称不后选择即可提高输出 Bell 对的平均 fidelity。

papers.title: Statistical mechanics and hierarchy of learnability in quantum codes: From generalized symmetries to non-Abelian topological orders
papers.abstract: Local weak measurements provide noisy information about observables encoded in a quantum code. We formulate the corresponding Bayesian inference problem for a broad class of topological stabilizer codes by mapping it to classical spin models with generalized symmetries. When the wavefunction deformation and Gaussian measurement strengths coincide, the replicated model acquires an enlarged symmetry. We use this symmetry to derive exact identities among correlators averaged over measurement records that quantify the learnability of nonlocal observables associated with fractionalized excitations. Together with correlation inequalities in the associated clean ferromagnetic models, these identities establish hierarchies of learnability: if two observables remain learnable at long distances, their product must also remain learnable. We demonstrate these relations in the rank-2 toric code and the X-cube model, whose classical descriptions exhibit modulated and subsystem symmetries, respectively. We further extend the analysis to finite group quantum double models, including non-Abelian ones. We derive exact relations between learnability and correlations in the corresponding classical models, and show that the representation structure and fusion rules of anyons impose further constraints under suitable positivity conditions. These results constrain which types of nonlocal information can be learned simultaneously, providing a guide to learning phase diagrams in quantum codes under local weak measurements.

analysis.summary: 把量子码中局域弱测量产生的非局域信息推断问题映射到经典自旋模型，利用对称性与关联不等式约束哪些逻辑信息可以同时被学习。

analysis.setting: 考虑拓扑 stabilizer codes 和有限群 quantum double models 的弱测量 Bayesian inference。波函数形变强度与 Gaussian 测量强度匹配时，复制模型出现增强对称性。

papers.title: Classical Clifford+T Sampling without Computing Marginals
papers.abstract: We introduce a new exact classical sampling algorithm for Clifford+T circuits, called T-by-T sampling. For a circuit with T-count t, it reduces sampling to evaluating 2t amplitudes of circuits with successively increasing T-counts 1,2,...,t, without the need to compute costly marginal probabilities. Crucially, the number of amplitude evaluations is completely independent of the surrounding Clifford structure. This makes T-by-T sampling well suited for use together with low-rank stabiliser decompositions, which enable efficient amplitude evaluations as long as the T-count is not too high. In that sense, T-by-T sampling is an improvement over the gate-by-gate sampling technique introduced by Bravyi, Gosset, and Liu (Phys. Rev. Lett. 128, 2022), where the number of amplitudes instead scales with the number of non-monomial operations such as Hadamard gates, which can remain large even in circuits with low stabiliser rank. Concretely, T-by-T sampling offers significant speedups in regimes where T gates are embedded within large Clifford computations. This makes it well suited for applications such as simulating quantum error correction experiments, which typically have lower T complexity but involve extensive Clifford operations and measurements. In particular, we show how T-by-T sampling allows us to take samples from recent end-to-end magic state cultivation circuits with escape up to distance 19 in a couple of seconds.

analysis.summary: T-by-T sampling 把 Clifford+T 电路的精确采样归约为按 T-count 逐步增加的振幅计算，减少大量 Clifford 门带来的额外振幅求值。
analysis.problem: 已有逐门采样中的振幅求值次数可随 Hadamard 等非单项式门数量增长，即使真正的非 Clifford 资源很少，也可能需要许多调用。

摘要报告在 magic-state cultivation 电路上可于数秒内生成样本，演示中 escape 达到 distance 19。

papers.title: Shadow bootstrapping: Nearly minimal-setting pure-state tomography with shallow Clifford measurements
papers.abstract: We present a pure-state tomography algorithm that uses a nearly minimal number of measurement settings while achieving optimal sample complexity with nonadaptive single-copy shallow Clifford measurements. For an arbitrary $n$-qubit pure state $|ψ\rangle \in \mathbb{C}^{d}$, where $d=2^n$, the algorithm uses $O(d/ε)$ copies and $\widetilde{O}(1)$ measurement settings to output a state vector $|\hatψ\rangle$ satisfying $1-|\langleψ|\hatψ\rangle|^2\leε$ with high probability. Each measurement is implemented by a Clifford circuit of depth $O(\log n)$. Reusing each measurement setting allows the data to be stored compactly as per-basis outcome histograms. Given these histograms, classical post-processing runs in $\widetilde{O}(d)$ time. Our key technique, \textit{shadow bootstrapping}, uses the current estimate to reduce the variance of subsequent residual estimation, enabling progressively more accurate reconstruction with only a constant number of new measurement settings per stage.

analysis.summary: 提出非自适应单拷贝浅层 Clifford tomography：同时控制样本数、不同测量设置数与经典后处理成本。
analysis.problem: Tomography 的 copies 开销与切换测量设置的开销不同；目标是在浅电路测量下保留最优纯态样本标度，同时显著复用设置。
analysis.setting: 任意 n 比特纯态，d=2^n；误差为 infidelity 1−|⟨ψ|ψ̂⟩|²≤ε，高概率成功，测量逐 copy 进行且非自适应。
main_results: 作者声称 copies 为 O(d/ε)，设置数为 Õ(1)，每个 Clifford 测量电路深度为 O(log n)。
按测量基保存结果直方图，给定直方图后的 classical post-processing 为 Õ(d)。
techniques: Shadow bootstrapping 用当前估计降低后续 residual estimation 方差；每阶段仅需常数个新设置，以逐阶段提高重建精度。
assumptions: 结论针对纯态；摘要中 nonadaptive 指的是量子测量设置，迭代使用当前估计属于后处理。
limitations: Õ 记号隐藏的对数参数、失败概率和电路连接几何在摘要中未说明，不能据此声称一维最近邻深度界。
设置数少并未消除 O(d/ε) 的 copies 成本；对一般 n 比特纯态仍随 n 指数增长。
