papers.title: Efficiently tracking errors and outcomes in universal quantum circuits
authors: Julio C. Magdalena de la Fuente
papers.abstract: We present a method for efficient simulation of error propagation and decoding in universal fault-tolerant quantum circuits under stochastic Pauli noise, requiring only that the circuit has a high fault distance and that all logical non-Clifford operations are implemented by physical T, CS and CCZ gates. This is achieved using modified Pauli frame-based error tracking in which the frame contains no logical information. Decoding success is identified by verifying that the Pauli frame is still logically trivial after decoding. Using the results of Ref. [1] and the observation that the distribution of non-logical measurement outcomes in the circuit is independent of the logical state, we show that we can accurately sample all detector outcomes. Our approach can also simulate circuits containing adaptive operations conditioned on logical measurements, provided these measurements have a known outcome distribution. This applies to the majority of adaptive operations such as state teleportation and preparation by measurement. Our method only detects decoding failures and so is consistent with complexity-theoretic expectations as it cannot be used to sample from the noiseless outcome distribution of the logical circuit.

analysis.summary: 通过不携带逻辑态信息的修正 Pauli frame，模拟通用容错电路中的误差传播、detector outcomes 与译码是否失败，避开完整逻辑输出采样。
analysis.problem: 非 Clifford 门使传统误差跟踪更复杂；评估容错性能却未必需要知道理想逻辑计算的输出分布。
analysis.setting: 随机 Pauli 噪声、高 fault distance 的容错电路；逻辑 non-Clifford operations 通过物理 T、CS、CCZ 实现。
main_results: 作者声称可高效跟踪错误并准确采样所有 detector outcomes；译码后检查 Pauli frame 是否仍逻辑平凡以判定成功。
允许部分由逻辑测量控制的自适应操作，但相应逻辑测量的结果分布必须已知。
techniques: 将错误 frame 与逻辑计算信息解耦，并利用非逻辑测量分布独立于逻辑态这一性质构造采样。
assumptions: 要求随机 Pauli 噪声、指定非 Clifford 实现及高 fault distance；不能略去自适应结果分布已知这一条件。
limitations: 摘要未给出各参数的运行时标度，也未说明一般相干或相关噪声是否可覆盖。
此方法检测 decoding failures，不能采样无噪声逻辑电路输出，不能解释为普遍高效模拟 universal quantum computation。

papers.title: Structural Lower Bounds for Quantum Property Estimation with Persistent Memory
papers.abstract: In quantum property estimation, an experimenter estimates $\operatorname{Tr}(Oρ)$ for a family of observables from independent copies of an unknown state $ρ$ simultaneously to additive error $ε$. While quantum memory can dramatically reduce sample complexity, understanding the power of a modest register that remains coherent throughout an adaptive experiment has remained an open challenge because existing frameworks require optimizing over the infinite space of measurement trees. We overcome this barrier by developing a backward-induction framework based on operator resolvents. Rather than tracking path-dependent memory states across rounds, resolvent regularization cancels internal memory trajectories exactly, reducing the lower bound to an algebraic certificate computed directly from the target observables with sharp $Ω(1/ε^2)$ scaling. Our structural rule charges only the retained dimension $K$ under arbitrary adaptive instruments and unrestricted memory lifetime. Via symmetry reductions, it yields polynomial-size linear programs that establish the optimal linear $Ω(D/(Kε^2))$ trade-off for the $D^2-1$ Paulis, eliminating the cubic loss in prior bounds. For growing weight-$w$ Pauli strings ($w=\lceil\log_2 n\rceil$) and quadratic Majorana cross-correlations, it proves lower bounds of $Ω(3^w/ε^2)$ and $Ω(n^2/(ε^2(1+\ln n)^2))$ against an indefinitely persistent memory of dimension $K=\lfloor\sqrt n\rfloor$. These bounds match memoryless or commuting estimators within polylogarithmic factors, demonstrating that rank constraints on the persistent register fundamentally throttle observable overlap and prevent a modest coherent memory from overcoming the sample complexity barrier.

analysis.summary: 用 resolvent 形式的后向归纳处理跨轮持续存在的量子记忆，给出 adaptive quantum property estimation 的样本数与保留维数权衡。
analysis.problem: 跨轮量子记忆和自适应测量产生大量依赖路径的状态；直接优化测量树很难获得只依赖记忆规模的下界。
analysis.setting: 从未知态的独立 copies 同时估计一族 Tr(Oρ)，加性精度 ε；允许任意自适应 instruments 和无限制 memory lifetime，成本参数为保留维数 K。
main_results: 作者借对称化线性规划声称，对 D²−1 个 Paulis 得到 Ω(D/(Kε²)) 权衡。
当 K=⌊√n⌋ 时，对 w=⌈log₂n⌉ 权重 Pauli strings 和二次 Majorana cross-correlations 分别得到 Ω(3^w/ε²) 与 Ω(n²/[ε²(1+ln n)²])。
techniques: Resolvent regularization 消去内部 memory trajectories，把下界转为由目标 observables 计算的代数 certificate；对称性进一步降为多项式大小 LP。
assumptions: 下界针对给定可观测量族与 persistent memory 维数约束，不是任意量子任务的统一结论。
limitations: 摘要未列出完整成功概率、可观测量归一化与各界适用区间，需正文确认。
维数 K 与记忆 qubit 数 log₂K 不同；“与无记忆估计器近似匹配”也依赖具体 observable family。

papers.title: SPAM-robust learnability of quantum dynamics
papers.abstract: Accurate characterization of quantum dynamics is essential for the calibration and control of quantum devices. Unknown state preparation and measurement (SPAM) errors, however, introduce gauge ambiguities that limit what can be learned. A central question is therefore which properties are learnable despite SPAM errors, and whether physical structure in the dynamics can restrict these ambiguities and expand the set of learnable properties. In this work, we address both questions within a unified framework for quantum channels and continuous-time evolution. First, for general quantum channels and Lindbladian dynamics, we use the cycle structure of a generalized pattern-transfer graph to fully characterize all learnable parameter combinations and show achievability by constructing explicit SPAM-robust learning protocols, establishing a baseline where continuous gauge freedom prevents many individual parameters from being identified. Second, we show that coherent structure drastically restricts this gauge ambiguity, reducing continuous gauge freedom to discrete or even trivial choices. This restriction manifests across both discrete- and continuous-time settings, including purely Hamiltonian evolution, noisy quantum channels close to a target unitary, and Lindbladian dynamics close to a target Hamiltonian. In particular, when the dynamics preserves or remains close to a coherent Hamiltonian form, all coherent coefficients and broad classes of dissipative error parameters become individually learnable. These results establish a systematic route to exploiting physical structure for SPAM-robust characterization, providing a foundation for the reliable calibration and control of quantum devices.

analysis.summary: 研究 SPAM gauge 如何限制量子动力学学习，并利用相干结构缩小不可辨识性。
analysis.problem: 未知制备和测量会使不同动力学参数产生相同数据。
analysis.setting: 一般 channels、Lindbladian，以及保持或接近相干形式的动力学。
main_results: 作者用 generalized pattern-transfer graph 的环结构刻画可学习参数组合，并构造 SPAM-robust 协议。
相干结构可把连续 gauge 压缩为离散甚至平凡选择；相应条件下相干系数及多类耗散参数可逐个学习。
techniques: 图的环结构；物理结构对 gauge 的约束。
assumptions: 逐参数结论依赖相干或近相干模型。

papers.title: Quantum error correcting codes from quiver moduli: Grassmannians, cyclic monodromy, and argyle collision divisors
papers.abstract: Building on aspects of a recent diagrammatic field-theory programme for quantum error correction put forward by the first-named author (arXiv:2607.08911), we construct exact finite-dimensional codes from twisted cyclic and argyle quiver moduli on the projective line. A regular fibre of the node-labelled cyclic Hitchin map records the ways to distribute simple spectral zeroes among the arrows with prescribed degrees. The Hilbert space spanned by these allocations is a Young permutation module. Root monodromy acts on its Specht factors and leaves their multiplicity spaces noiseless. Resetting the Specht factor therefore recovers the encoded state for every channel in the monodromy noise model. We prove that the largest Kostka multiplicity is the optimal dimension of a subspace code correcting the full monodromy algebra, even among codes spanning several isotypic blocks. Quantizing an argyle master space recovers the cyclic sheet space as a weight sector of a tensor power, with the identification preserving monodromy. For the balanced three-cycle with $t$ zeroes per arrow, the multiplicity of a partition $(a,b,c)$ of $3t$ is $1+\min(a-b,b-c)$. The optimal logical dimension is thus $t+1$, attained uniquely by the block indexed by $(2t,t)$. At $t=1$ we give explicit codewords for a qubit on six sheets. The commuting right action generates its full logical algebra, yielding errors outside the monodromy model that leave the measured footprint statistics unchanged yet require different recoveries. We also compute collision-parity ranks, give a higher-rank Grassmannian example, and derive a conditional criterion for recovery across splitting types.

analysis.summary: 将表示论重数空间用作精确纠错编码，最优维数由 Kostka multiplicity 决定。
analysis.problem: 指定噪声代数下，哪些空间能够无损承载逻辑信息？
analysis.setting: projective line 上 cyclic/argyle quiver moduli 导出的有限维系统及 monodromy 噪声。
main_results: 噪声作用于 Specht 因子，重置该因子可恢复重数空间中的编码态。
平衡三环每条边含 t 个零点时，最优逻辑维数为 t+1；t=1 给出六 sheets 上的 qubit。
techniques: Young permutation modules；Specht 分解。
assumptions: 纠错保证针对完整 monodromy algebra。
limitations: 仅审阅官方摘要；未核查正文证明和摘要未说明的假设。
模型外噪声可能保持测量统计却要求不同恢复；不是一般局域物理噪声的阈值结论。
本条分析仅依据论文摘要，未核查正文证明和摘要中未说明的假设。

papers.title: Bounded decoding complexity in transversal circuits with magic state injection
papers.abstract: We characterize the complexity of space-time correlated decoding for fault-tolerant quantum computing architectures that implement Clifford gates transversally and realize non-Clifford gates via magic state injection. In this approach, decoding graphs for logical measurements are constructed by backpropagating measurement operators through the circuit, which causes them to grow with circuit volume. However, the decoding volume can be substantially reduced by decoding measurements sequentially, committing corrections, and excluding syndrome data that have already been processed for earlier measurements. For random circuits, we find that the resulting decoding volume associated with mid-circuit measurements approaches a stationary average that is determined by the density of magic state injections. Large decoding instances are exponentially suppressed. We further find that the decoding complexity is remarkably insensitive to different choices of measurement products to be decoded, and that the same qualitative behavior persists across different circuit connectivities and Clifford gate ensembles. These results suggest that scalable space-time correlated decoding of large-scale fault-tolerant quantum algorithms is achievable since the magic states that make transversal architectures universal also keep them decodable.

analysis.summary: magic injection 在 transversal 架构中也能限制时空相关解码的典型体积。
analysis.problem: 反向传播逻辑测量会让解码图随线路体积增长。
analysis.setting: transversal Clifford 门加 magic-state injection 的随机容错线路。
main_results: 逐次解码、提交修正并移除已处理 syndrome 后，中途测量的平均解码体积趋于由 injection 密度决定的稳态。
作者报告大解码实例指数受抑，且不同连接与 Clifford ensemble 中有类似行为。
techniques: 测量反向传播；顺序解码与 syndrome 复用控制。
assumptions: 典型行为基于研究的随机线路 ensembles。
limitations: 仅审阅官方摘要；未核查正文证明和摘要未说明的假设。
摘要未提供指数常数和最坏情形时间；不能等同所有算法的常数解码复杂度。

papers.title: Stabiliser codes over prime fields as weighted graphs and as quantum sets of lines
papers.abstract: We further develop the theory of quantum stabiliser codes and its links with graph theory and finite geometry. We prove that an [[n,k,d]]_p stabiliser code over a finite field with p elements, p prime, gives rise to a graph on n-k vertices together with two disjoint independent sets of size k. Its edges are weighted with elements of a finite field of size p. If k=0, such codes are known as graph states. Second, we view stabiliser codes as so-called quantum sets of lines in projective space, allowing us to determined their minimum distance geometrically. We describe two geometrical operations to obtain new quantum sets of lines from given quantum sets of lines. As an application, we list the number of stabiliser codes up to equivalence, for given small parameters.

analysis.summary: 以加权图和射影几何描述素数维 stabilizer codes。
analysis.problem: 把 stabilizer 代数转换为可构造、可计算距离的几何对象。
analysis.setting: [[n,k,d]]_p codes，p 为素数。
main_results: 构造含 n-k 个顶点及两个不相交 k 元独立集的加权图。
用 quantum sets of lines 几何刻画最小距离，并给出两种构造操作及小参数等价类计数。
techniques: 有限域加权图；射影空间中的线集。
assumptions: 素数维 qudits。
limitations: 仅审阅官方摘要；未核查正文证明和摘要未说明的假设。

papers.title: Fermionic Porter-Thomas statistics and their emergence in random matchgate circuits
papers.abstract: For Haar-random quantum states, measurement probabilities follow the universal Porter--Thomas distribution. This implies anticoncentration, i.e.\ the spreading of probability over exponentially many outcomes, a key property underlying random-circuit-sampling experiments. We derive the exact analogue of the Porter--Thomas law for random fermionic Gaussian states, both with and without particle-number conservation. We also consider Clifford Gaussian states, for which the problem maps onto a simple model of arcs and loops. For large systems the probabilities become log-normally distributed, with moments growing polynomially in system size. Free-fermion states thus anticoncentrate only up to polynomial factors. We then show how this fermionic Porter--Thomas law emerges in random one-dimensional brickwork matchgate circuits. A simple single-arc approximation accurately describes the full distribution of probabilities, revealing an early diffusive regime followed by a slow relaxation on times scaling as the square of the system size. We rigorously prove that depths growing almost quadratically with system size are required for the collision probability to converge. Finally, we show that ideal free-fermion sampling yields large linear cross-entropy scores, and propose a log-based benchmark with an exact fermionic normalization.

analysis.summary: fermionic Gaussian states 的输出统计与 Haar 态不同，碰撞概率收敛需要近二次深度。
analysis.problem: 普通 Porter–Thomas 或线性 XEB 能否正确评估自由费米线路？
analysis.setting: 有/无粒子数守恒的随机 Gaussian states、Clifford Gaussian states 与 1D brickwork matchgates。
main_results: 作者导出 fermionic Porter–Thomas 类比；大系统概率呈 log-normal，反集中带多项式损失。
collision probability 的收敛深度被严格证明需近二次增长；单弧近似显示扩散后慢弛豫。
理想自由费米采样也可有较大 linear XEB，作者提出具有精确费米归一化的 log-based benchmark。
techniques: arcs/loops 映射；单弧近似；碰撞概率分析。
assumptions: Gaussian/matchgate 限制不可删去。
limitations: 仅审阅官方摘要；未核查正文证明和摘要未说明的假设。
摘要未给出精确深度定理及精度参数；不自动推出高阶 design 或 shadows 总样本优势。
本条分析仅依据论文摘要，未核查正文证明和摘要中未说明的假设。

follow_up: 读者建议：核查碰撞矩收敛能否导出单拷贝估计方差界。

papers.title: Quantum Error Correction in Nearly Critical Toric Codes
papers.abstract: We investigate quantum error correction protocols for topological codes deformed away from their stabilizer limits, particularly as they are pushed towards quantum phase transitions into trivial phases. Our focus is primarily on quantum information stored within the ground-state manifold of the transverse-field toric code (TFTC), subjected to independent bit-flip and phase-flip decoherence. Although the transverse field induces strong quantum fluctuations of $m$ anyons in the ground states, we show that projective measurements of the "bare" toric code stabilizers can nevertheless be used to construct an efficient decoding algorithm which exhibits a finite threshold to both types of decoherence, even when the transverse field is tuned infinitesimally close to the quantum critical point. Our construction of the optimal postmeasurement decoders---that is, the optimal decoders assuming that the stabilizers are first measured---crucially relies on the stoquastic nature of the TFTC Hamiltonian, which affords a description of its ground states in terms of a classical lattice gauge theory. Using stoquasticity, we first prove that stabilizer measurements act unitarily on the undecohered TFTC ground states to excellent approximation, and that the optimal postmeasurement decoder can be efficiently implemented via Monte Carlo simulation of a constrained lattice gauge theory. We then construct the optimal postmeasurement decoder for the TFTC states under bit-flip and phase-flip decoherence, where we numerically demonstrate a finite threshold close to the quantum critical point. We provide theoretical evidence (without a rigorous proof) that stabilizer measurements constitute an optimal decoding strategy in this setting. For phase-flip decoherence, we further prove that the optimal postmeasurement decoding threshold is independent of the transverse field strength throughout the topological phase.

analysis.summary: 研究远离 stabilizer 极限、接近相变的 toric code ground space 是否仍可用裸 stabilizer 测量纠错。
analysis.problem: 强量子涨落下，标准 syndrome 读出是否破坏可恢复信息？
analysis.setting: 横场 toric code；独立 bit-flip 与 phase-flip decoherence。
main_results: 作者构造测量后最优解码，并数值观察接近临界点仍有有限阈值。
phase-flip 情形中，测量后最优阈值在整个拓扑相内不依赖横场。
techniques: 利用 stoquasticity 映射到受约束经典 lattice gauge theory，再做 Monte Carlo。
assumptions: 最优性限定为先测量 stabilizers 的策略类。
limitations: 仅审阅官方摘要；未核查正文证明和摘要未说明的假设。
所有策略中的全局最优性只有理论证据，作者明确没有严格证明；摘要未给阈值数值。
本条分析仅依据论文摘要，未核查正文证明和摘要中未说明的假设。

follow_up: 读者建议：区分 postmeasurement optimum 与任意 recovery 的最优保真度。

papers.title: Dynamically modulated light-matter interactions for ancilla-tolerant bosonic control
papers.abstract: Strong light-matter interactions are central to state-of-the-art quantum technologies, spanning platforms as diverse as Rydberg atoms, trapped ions, and superconducting circuits. In superconducting circuits, the strong dispersive coupling between microwave photons (light) and ancillary qubits (matter) has enabled universal bosonic control and quantum error correction. However, this always-on dispersive interaction propagates errors from the ancillary qubits to the bosonic systems both while idling and when performing operations, introducing a trade-off between control strength and fidelity. We break this trade-off by introducing a parametrically activated hybridization between the bosonic modes and ancilla qubits, keeping both elements decoupled when not active. When activated, this hybridization mediates a dynamic light-matter coupling with non-trivial engineered symmetries, permitting resilience to ancilla decay and dephasing. This dynamic coupling functions as a new control primitive that offers a route to bosonic processors whose performance is set by the oscillator, rather than the ancilla.

analysis.summary: 通过可开关的参数调制耦合，降低 bosonic control 中 ancilla 错误传播。
analysis.problem: 常开 dispersive interaction 同时带来强控制和噪声传播。
analysis.setting: 超导 bosonic modes 与辅助 qubits。
main_results: 闲置时解耦，工作时激活具有设计对称性的 hybridization。
作者主张该控制原语可抵抗 ancilla decay 与 dephasing。
techniques: 参数激活；耦合对称性设计。
assumptions: 依赖特定 light-matter 控制实现。
limitations: 仅审阅官方摘要；未核查正文证明和摘要未说明的假设。
摘要没有给逻辑错误率、容错阈值或门认证保证；也没有可泛化的 ancilla 资源定理。
本条分析仅依据论文摘要，未核查正文证明和摘要中未说明的假设。

follow_up: 读者建议：检查噪声传播信道及单次 ancilla fault 的剩余效应。

papers.title: Quantum Advantage has Few Complexity Implications
papers.abstract: We consider the complexity implications of proofs of quantumness and (quantum verifier) oblivious state preparation. We show that both of these objects can coexist with the easiness of nondeterministic computation. That is, we give evidence that proofs of quantumness can exist when $\mathsf{P} = \mathsf{NP}$ and that (quantum verifier) oblivious state preparation can exist when $\mathsf{BQP} = \mathsf{QCMA}$. In particular, we give a classical oracle relative to which (1) $\mathsf{P}^\mathcal{O} = \mathsf{NP}^\mathcal{O}$ (2) $\mathsf{BQP}^\mathcal{O} = \mathsf{PSPACE}^\mathcal{O}$ (3) Proofs of quantumness exist. In particular, there exists a language in $\mathsf{IP}^\mathcal{O} \subseteq \mathsf{BQP}^\mathcal{O}$ which is hard on average against $\mathsf{P}^\mathcal{O}/poly$. We give a unitary oracle such that (1) $\mathsf{BQP}^\mathcal{O} = \mathsf{QCMA}^\mathcal{O}$ (2) Quantum verifier oblivious state preparation exists. These oracle separations directly imply a number of related consequences. For example, our first result implies that proofs of quantumness cannot be used to construct classical or quantum cryptography with a relativizing proof. Our second result implies that quantum computation/classical communication oblivious transfer cannot be used to construct post-quantum one-way functions with a relativizing proof.

analysis.summary: oracle 结果限制了从 proofs of quantumness 推出经典复杂性或密码学困难性的论证。
analysis.problem: 某些量子优势原语是否必然蕴含经典 NP 困难或单向函数？
analysis.setting: 分别使用 classical oracle 和 unitary oracle 的相对化模型。
main_results: 作者给出 P=NP、BQP=PSPACE 且 proofs of quantumness 存在的 classical-oracle 世界。
另有 BQP=QCMA 而 quantum-verifier oblivious state preparation 存在的 unitary-oracle 世界。
techniques: oracle separations。
assumptions: 结论是相对化障碍。
limitations: 仅审阅官方摘要；未核查正文证明和摘要未说明的假设。
不是无 oracle 世界中的复杂性塌缩；不提供一般 BQP 的 subexponential simulation。

follow_up: 读者建议：检查拟用的 reduction 是否 relativizing。

papers.title: DynaMite: Dynamic Measurement Scheduling To Accelerate Fault-Tolerant Quantum Programs
papers.abstract: Fault-tolerant quantum computers run millions of logical cycles to perform quantum error correction (QEC). As logical operations span entire logical cycles, the logical cycle time (LCT) dictates program runtime. Qubit measurements, critical to extract parity information for QEC, are the slowest operations and account for 43-86% of LCT. Measurement latencies impact fidelity: fast measurements lower our ability to correctly classify quantum states, whereas slow measurements increase the likelihood of decoherence. Hardware providers thus calibrate measurement latencies that maximize readout fidelity per qubit and use them to schedule all measurements during program execution. However, calibrated latencies are sub-optimal for logical performance because logical cycles span multiple QEC rounds, during which data qubits are not measured. This increases LCT and logical error rates (LERs) due to decoherence at the logical level. We propose DynaMite, a lightweight real-time measurement latency selection policy built on two key insights. First, logical cycles must use a measurement latency that is fast enough to reduce both LCT and LER for the QEC code, instead of the calibrated latency that only maximizes readout fidelity. Second, not all logical cycles are equal; many do not fully utilize the error budget of the QEC code, i.e., the number of failed parity checks it can tolerate without compromising LER. These cycles could use even faster measurements but do not, because latencies are chosen statically, whereas error information is only available at runtime. DynaMite exploits the fact that a logical cycle comprises multiple QEC rounds and selects the fastest latency for an upcoming round based on the error budget left and rounds remaining. Our evaluations show that DynaMite reduces LCT by 1.69x on average and up to 2.29x, and reduces LER to 0.46x on average and up to 0.13x of baseline.

analysis.summary: 动态选择测量时长可同时降低 logical cycle time 和 logical error rate。
analysis.problem: 最优单 qubit readout fidelity 的时长不一定最优于整个纠错周期。
analysis.setting: 多轮 QEC 组成的 logical cycles，利用实时剩余错误预算。
main_results: 作者按剩余轮数与错误预算选下一轮测量延迟。
评估中 LCT 平均缩短 1.69 倍、最多 2.29 倍；LER 平均为基线 0.46 倍、最好 0.13 倍。
techniques: 实时 latency scheduling。
assumptions: 结果依赖被评估的码、噪声与测量延迟模型。
limitations: 仅审阅官方摘要；未核查正文证明和摘要未说明的假设。
不把实验评估提升成一般阈值或无条件容错保证；摘要未列所有基线配置。
本条分析仅依据论文摘要，未核查正文证明和摘要中未说明的假设。
relevance: 具体连接自适应 syndrome 访问与 logical performance。
follow_up: 读者建议：核查模型漂移和经典控制延迟是否计入。

papers.title: QECert: Formal Foundations for Quantum Error-Correction Theory in Lean
papers.abstract: Quantum error correction provides the mathematical basis for protecting quantum information against noise. Existing formalizations have established foundations for stabilizer codes and code verification. However, a systematic formal treatment of the asymptotic constructions and fundamental limitations that underpin scalable quantum error correction is still needed. We present QECert, a Lean library providing reusable formal foundations for these theoretical questions. It connects quantum error-correction criteria, stabilizer and Calderbank-Shor-Steane codes, and algebraic and homological constructions within a common framework. Asymptotically good quantum low density parity check codes provide the principal case study. We formalize constructions and asymptotic parameter theorems spanning hypergraph products, balanced products, lifted products, and quantum Tanner codes. Further developments cover Bravyi-Poulin-Terhal bounds and related locality restrictions, constant overhead magic state distillation, and energy barriers and storage errors for quantum memories. QECert establishes a reusable formal foundation for studying the capabilities, resource requirements, and fundamental limitations of quantum error correction, supporting systematic verification and further development of its theory.

analysis.summary: 用 Lean 统一 QEC 的代数构造、渐近参数与限制定理的形式化基础。
analysis.problem: 已有 code verification 与渐近 QEC 理论之间缺少系统的形式化衔接。
analysis.setting: 稳定子/CSS codes、乘积构造及 quantum Tanner codes。
main_results: 作者报告形式化多个好 qLDPC 构造及参数定理，并覆盖 locality bounds、magic distillation 和存储误差。
techniques: Lean 形式化；代数与同调框架。
assumptions: 保证范围由实际形式化的定义和依赖决定。
limitations: 仅审阅官方摘要；未核查正文证明和摘要未说明的假设。
未检查代码或公理依赖；不是新 rate-distance 或 magic overhead 定理的证据。
本条分析仅依据论文摘要，未核查正文证明和摘要中未说明的假设。

follow_up: 读者建议：核查关键渐近定理的形式化陈述与物理噪声定义。

papers.title: Recoverability of Gravitational Entanglement under Decoherence
papers.abstract: Decoherence can make gravitationally generated entanglement arbitrarily small, or even vanishing, without necessarily rendering the effective matter dynamics separable. We ask whether this hidden non-separability can be revealed using strictly local quantum error correction. For Newtonian gravity supplemented by physically relevant localization noise, including environmental noise, and noise from collapse models such as GRW, CSL, and Diósi--Penrose, we analyze when the underlying entangling resource is locally recoverable. For GRW- and CSL-type noise, we analytically establish that strictly local quantum error correction can make the ratio of the effective gravitational interaction strength to the residual decoherence rate arbitrarily large for any parametrization of the collapse model, even in regimes where the unencoded entanglement signal approaches zero. By contrast, the Diósi--Penrose model does not exhibit the same enhancement under bipartite protocol considered here, revealing a qualitative difference. These results show that the loss of detectable entanglement is not equivalent to the loss of a recoverable non-separable resource, and open a route toward practical recovery protocols.

analysis.summary: 局域纠错可揭示被退相干掩盖的引力纠缠资源。
analysis.problem: 可见纠缠信号消失是否等于动力学不再有可恢复的非可分资源？
analysis.setting: Newtonian gravity 加 localization noise，包括 GRW、CSL 与 Diósi–Penrose 模型。
main_results: 作者解析主张：GRW/CSL 型噪声下，局域 QEC 可把有效相互作用与残余退相干之比任意增大。
所研究双体协议中 Diósi–Penrose 噪声没有同类增强。
techniques: 比较编码后有效相互作用与噪声。
assumptions: 依赖具体 localization noise 结构和局域编码协议。
limitations: 仅审阅官方摘要；未核查正文证明和摘要未说明的假设。
不是一般噪声下无开销恢复，摘要未给有限资源伸缩。
本条分析仅依据论文摘要，未核查正文证明和摘要中未说明的假设。
relevance: 以操作性可恢复性区分可见纠缠与存活的量子资源。
follow_up: 读者建议：核查无限增强对应的编码维数及恢复频率成本。

papers.title: Substantially Improved Rate and Distance for Addressable Transversal Phase Gates
papers.abstract: An important ingredient in fault-tolerant quantum computation is asymptotically good codes with fully addressable transversal non-Clifford gates. Existing constructions, however, provide only small explicit guarantees for rate and relative distance. Here, we substantially improve these guarantees for fully addressable transversal phase gates at every fixed level $h\ge3$ of the Clifford hierarchy, using a cyclic encoding beyond the binary CSS framework. The encoding separates logical phase control from the joint design of rate and distance, enabling two constructions with different computational costs. A deterministic polynomial-time algebraic-geometric construction gives a common asymptotic lower bound of $52/(675h)$ on both quantities. A counting argument gives an exponential-time construction with exact verification, improving this bound by a factor of approximately $2.86$. We further establish a universal upper bound for codes supporting fully addressable transversal single-qubit phase gates. Within our cyclic encoding framework, we obtain a stronger upper bound that is approximately $1.28$ times the lower bound achieved by our exponential-time construction. As concrete examples, we construct codes with $48$ and $90$ physical qubits supporting fully addressable transversal $T$ gates. These results narrow the gap between achievable code parameters and addressability bounds, providing quantitative targets for further improvements in efficient code constructions.

analysis.summary: cyclic encoding 改进可寻址 transversal phase gates 的码率与相对距离保证。
analysis.problem: 已有渐近好码的显式常数偏小。
analysis.setting: 固定 Clifford-hierarchy 层数 h≥3，超出 binary CSS 框架。
main_results: 确定性多项式时间代数几何构造同时保证 rate、relative distance 至少 52/(675h)。
指数时间、可精确验证的构造把该下界提高约 2.86 倍；框架内上界约为其下界 1.28 倍。
给出 48 与 90 physical qubits、支持 fully addressable transversal T gates 的实例。
techniques: 逻辑相位控制与 rate-distance 设计解耦；代数几何与计数。
assumptions: h 固定；两种构造计算成本不同。
limitations: 仅审阅官方摘要；未核查正文证明和摘要未说明的假设。
框架内上界不可视为一般架构最优；摘要未列额外 fault-tolerant gadget 成本。
本条分析仅依据论文摘要，未核查正文证明和摘要中未说明的假设。
relevance: 直接关联 transversal non-Clifford gates 与 magic 资源。
follow_up: 读者建议：检查可寻址性是否可帮助减少设计构造的在线 magic 使用。

papers.title: Fast verification of fault tolerant magic state preparation circuits with the CNOT + T gate set
papers.abstract: Magic state preparation is often among the most expensive operations in a fault tolerant quantum computation. One obstacle to coming up with better magic state preparation circuits lies in verifying their fault tolerance properties, as it is difficult to verify either by hand or in software that a very large number of combinations of faults do not give rise to high-weight or logical errors, especially in a non-Clifford circuit. In this work, we propose the use of the CNOT + T gate set to fault-tolerantly prepare a large class of magic states. We consider the propagation of Pauli faults within CNOT + T circuits and derive properties similar to those of Pauli faults within Clifford circuits, with a view to verifying fault tolerance as efficiently as possible. We present Comb, a library that can verify the fault tolerance of CNOT + T magic state preparation circuits, and demonstrate its use in verifying the fault tolerance of distance three and distance five magic state preparation circuits in minutes on a laptop. We present a distance five magic state preparation circuit that was discovered using Comb. As an independent confirmation of Comb's correctness we compare its findings to circuit-level noisy simulations for several magic state preparation circuits.

analysis.summary: 利用 CNOT+T 中 Pauli fault 的结构，加速 magic preparation 的容错验证。
analysis.problem: 非 Clifford 线路中穷举组合故障很昂贵。
analysis.setting: CNOT+T magic-state preparation circuits。
main_results: Comb 对 distance-3 与 distance-5 线路可在笔记本上数分钟完成验证，并用于发现 distance-5 线路。
作者以 circuit-level noisy simulation 作独立交叉检查。
techniques: Pauli fault propagation 的结构性质。
assumptions: 适用门集和被验证的故障模型需保持。
limitations: 仅审阅官方摘要；未核查正文证明和摘要未说明的假设。
不是任意 non-Clifford 电路的高效容错判定；模拟一致不代替通用证明。
本条分析仅依据论文摘要，未核查正文证明和摘要中未说明的假设。
relevance: 直接对应 magic 制备的资源与可认证性。
follow_up: 读者建议：核查可处理的相关故障、测量和 feedforward 范围。

papers.title: Autonomous cooling of Kerr-cat qubits to minutes-long bit-flip times
papers.abstract: Quantum error correction becomes more hardware efficient when physical noise is strongly biased towards one error channel. Cat qubits realize such a bias by encoding information in two opposite coherent states of a superconducting oscillator, so that bit flips are exponentially suppressed with photon number while phase-flip rates increase only linearly. In Kerr-cat qubits, a driven double-well potential confines these states and enables fast coherent control, but excitations can induce interwell switching, limiting bit-flip times to milliseconds. Here we show that the nonlinear interaction generating the confinement can also cool these excitations. When an intra-well transition becomes resonant with a lossy readout mode, excitations are transferred out of the qubit and dissipated, as established by spectroscopy and relaxation measurements. We observe the predicted exponential scaling of Kerr-cat bit-flip times with photon number, reaching 450 s, over five orders of magnitude beyond previous demonstrations. Phase-flip rates remain consistent with intrinsic photon loss at operating points with seconds-long bit-flip times. We further demonstrate fast Z gates without measurable degradation of bit-flip protection and single-shot readout with a bit-flip probability below $10^{-6}$ per measurement. Autonomous cooling thus brings minutes-long bit-flip protection to Kerr-cat qubits while retaining fast coherent control, without additional cooling drives or circuit elements.

analysis.summary: 自主冷却压低 Kerr-cat 的 interwell switching，增强噪声偏置。
analysis.problem: 受激态跳转使既有 Kerr-cat bit-flip protection 受限。
analysis.setting: 超导振子、非线性双阱约束与有损 readout mode。
main_results: 作者报告 bit-flip time 达 450 s，并观测随 photon number 的指数伸缩。
另报告快速 Z 门和每次单次读出小于 10^-6 的 bit-flip 概率。
techniques: 共振转移激发并耗散的 autonomous cooling。
assumptions: 特定工作点；phase-flip 仍须单独考虑。
limitations: 仅审阅官方摘要；未核查正文证明和摘要未说明的假设。
bit-flip time 与读出诱发翻转概率不是完整逻辑保真度或 QEC 阈值。
本条分析仅依据论文摘要，未核查正文证明和摘要中未说明的假设。
relevance: 有明确 biased-noise QEC 联系，作为物理噪声模型条目收录。
follow_up: 读者建议：比较相位错误、控制时长与纠错开销的联合变化。

papers.title: On Random Purifications of Isometries and Channels
papers.abstract: Acorn tricks turn weak quantum resources into stronger "randomized" ones. A recent example is the random purification channel, which turns $t$ copies of a mixed state into $t$ copies of a random purification. We ask whether analogous techniques can turn queries to an isometry into queries to a random unitary completion, or queries to a quantum channel into queries to a random isometry dilation. For an isometry from dimension $N$ to dimension $M$, we give an efficient, stateful simulator for $T$ sequential, forward queries to a fixed Haar random unitary completion. It uses at most one forward isometry query per simulated call, with total trace-distance error $O(T\sqrt{N/(M-T)})$. This lifts isometry query lower bounds to arbitrary unitary completions, and copy complexity lower bounds to forward access to state preparation unitaries, with dimension-dependent loss that can be made arbitrarily small for most applications. Conversely, we construct two distributions on quantum channels distinguishable exactly with two queries to an arbitrary dilation, but requiring exponentially many channel queries for nonnegligible advantage. This rules out efficient simulation of random channel dilations. Our technique also shows that approximating the quantum switch to any constant error below $1/2$ requires exponentially many channel queries, even for identical channels, giving an exponential query advantage for indefinite causal order and improving on Bavaresco et al. (2025). Finally, we show how to "decontrol" controlled forward access to an isometry: any algorithm making controlled queries to $φV$ for a random phase $φ$ can be transformed into one using the same number of uncontrolled forward queries to $V$, generalizing the analogous result for unitaries.

analysis.summary: isometry 的随机 unitary completion 可被前向模拟，但一般 channel dilation 存在指数访问分离。
analysis.problem: 前向 isometry/channel 访问是否等价于其更强的相干扩张访问？
analysis.setting: N→M isometry，T 次顺序 forward queries。
main_results: 作者构造有状态 simulator，每次至多调用一次 isometry，总 trace-distance error 为 O(T√(N/(M−T)))。
另构造两次 dilation queries 可精确区分、但 channel queries 需指数多次的分布。
quantum switch 在常数误差小于 1/2 下也需指数 channel queries。
techniques: 随机 completion 的有状态模拟；查询下界转移。
assumptions: 维数依赖与 forward-only 模型不可省略，表达式要求 M>T。
limitations: 仅审阅官方摘要；未核查正文证明和摘要未说明的假设。
不等价于 diamond/relative-design 保证；不同扩张访问模型须分开。
本条分析仅依据论文摘要，未核查正文证明和摘要中未说明的假设。
relevance: 直接对应 information access、随机化与 quantum learning 下界。
follow_up: 读者建议：检查单次抽取且固定 completion 的保证是否适用于自适应 design-query 比较。

papers.title: On the Hardness of Approximate Quantum Circuit Membership and Optimization
papers.abstract: Quantum circuit optimization is an indispensable component of the quantum software stack, used to reduce noise, maximize performance, alleviate costs of quantum error correction, or target specific hardware. A related problem is approximate membership: for a fixed set of unitaries $S$, decide whether a given circuit $C$ is within distance $\varepsilon$ of a unitary in $S$ under some metric $m$. Membership is a special case of optimization, where $S$ is a set of unitaries implementable at no cost (e.g., with noise-minimal circuits, or without magic states). Janzing, Wocjan, and Beth (Int. J. Quantum Inf., 2005) showed that, for the operator metric, the case $S=\{I\}$ (approximate identity) is QMA-complete when $C$ is promised to be either close to the identity or far from it. We generalize this setting in three directions: (i) promise-free inputs, (ii) besides $S=\{I\}$, sets $S$ containing only Clifford unitaries, or only generalized permutation matrices (i.e., no superposition), and (iii) the trace-based, spectral, and operator metrics. We show that, in all cases, approximate membership is PP-hard for wide ranges of $\varepsilon$, provided $C$'s gate-set can implement Clifford+T, as the gate-sets of standard hardware do. If $S=\{I\}$, or if $S$ contains only generalized permutation matrices, $I\in S$, and $m$ is a trace-based distance, PP-hardness holds for all non-trivial $\varepsilon$. If $S=\{I\}$ and $m$ is a trace-based distance, PP-hardness holds even for circuits over classical-reversible gate-sets. Our results indicate that approximate membership is harder over promise-free inputs than the QMA-complete promise version, and that this hardness persists across quantum resources (any gates, non-Clifford, superposition) and distance metrics. They directly imply PP-hardness of circuit optimization when minimizing total, non-Clifford, or superposition gate depth or count.

analysis.summary: promise-free approximate circuit membership 对多种距离和免费操作集呈 PP-hard。
analysis.problem: 知道接近免费操作是否易于求最小 gate/magic 成本？
analysis.setting: 输入门集可实现 Clifford+T；S 为 identity、Clifford-only 或 generalized permutation 的相关集合。
main_results: 作者在宽误差区间建立 PP-hardness；部分 trace-based 情形覆盖所有非平凡 ε。
由 membership 推得 total、non-Clifford 或 superposition gate count/depth 优化的 PP-hardness。
techniques: complexity reductions；promise-free membership。
assumptions: 各 S、metric、ε 的域不同，不能混为统一定理。
limitations: 仅依据官方摘要；未审阅正文证明和摘要未说明的假设。
不直接给每个线路的 magic 下界；不排除特定设计架构的显式高效构造。
本条分析仅依据论文摘要，未核查正文证明和摘要中未说明的假设。
relevance: 与 magic minimization、编译和资源下界的算法困难性直接相关。
follow_up: 读者建议：核查近似 metric 与相对 design 保证是否匹配。

papers.title: Hardware-Efficient Reinforcement-Learned Scheduling for Quantum LDPC Decoders
papers.abstract: Quantum low-density parity-check (QLDPC) codes are promising for fault-tolerant quantum computing, but their decoding algorithms present significant hardware implementation challenges. Reinforcement-learned sequential belief propagation (RL-S) improves the error-correction performance of conventional belief propagation (BP) through adaptive variable-node scheduling. However, its heap-based priority management introduces substantial hardware overhead. This paper presents hardware implementations of BP, RL-S, and bucket-based reinforcement-learned BP (BRL-S) for the [[288,12,18]] bivariate bicycle QLDPC code. The BRL-S architectures employ quantized priorities and first-in, first-out (FIFO) buckets to simplify scheduling. Three configurations with two, four, and eight priority levels are evaluated. FPGA synthesis results demonstrate that BRL-S reduces lookup-table utilization by approximately 68--72% compared with RL-S. ASIC synthesis further shows reductions of 63--67% in area and 64--69% in estimated power consumption. These results demonstrate that bucket-based scheduling substantially improves the hardware efficiency of reinforcement-learned QLDPC decoders.

analysis.summary: 用量化优先级与 FIFO buckets 降低 reinforcement-learned qLDPC decoder 的调度硬件成本。
analysis.problem: heap-based RL-S 调度会带来额外硬件开销。
analysis.setting: [[288,12,18]] bivariate-bicycle code；BP、RL-S 与 BRL-S 的综合比较。
main_results: 2/4/8 priority levels 的设计中，作者报告 FPGA LUT 降约 68–72%。
ASIC synthesis 的面积降约 63–67%，estimated power 降约 64–69%。
techniques: bucket scheduling；quantized priorities。
assumptions: 报告的是指定 decoder 实现和综合条件。
limitations: 仅依据官方摘要；未审阅正文证明和摘要未说明的假设。
面积和估计功耗并非容错阈值或实际端到端 latency；摘要未列精度保持范围。
本条分析仅依据论文摘要，未核查正文证明和摘要中未说明的假设。
relevance: 有明确实时 QEC 解码联系，作为实现成本参考条目收录。
follow_up: 读者建议：检查相同 LER 下吞吐与最坏 latency，避免只比较综合面积。

papers.title: Long-range entangled criticality from coherent errors
papers.abstract: We find that coherent error can induce a phase transition from the clean surface code phase into an extended long-range entangled critical regime with diverging Markov length. To demonstrate this, we establish two general results of independent interest. The first relates topology and quantum information to mixed-state entanglement: we show that when a noise channel acting on a topological code preserves a higher-form symmetry and nonzero coherent information, the noisy state for generic logical input is long-range entangled. The second generalizes the local recovery construction based on finite Markov length to any locally parameterized family, thus encompassing local Lindbladian evolution, coherent errors followed by syndrome dephasing, and thermal states. We apply these results to the honeycomb surface code, in which we find an extended long-range entangled critical regime that is a quasi-long-ranged counterpart of 1-form strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking. As a byproduct of these studies, we relate the conditional mutual information to conductance in a Majorana network model.

analysis.summary: coherent errors 可把 surface-code 态推向 Markov length 发散的长程纠缠临界区。
analysis.problem: 噪声后的量子信息存活与局部可恢复性如何由混态结构刻画？
analysis.setting: topological codes、higher-form symmetry、honeycomb surface code。
main_results: 作者证明保持 higher-form symmetry 与非零 coherent information 时，generic logical input 的 noisy state 长程纠缠。
将有限 Markov length 的 local recovery 推广到 locally parameterized families，涵盖 Lindbladian、coherent error 加 syndrome dephasing 和 thermal states。
把 CMI 与 Majorana network conductance 相联系。
techniques: coherent information；Markov length；local recovery。
assumptions: 对称性、generic logical inputs 与 locally parameterized family 条件需保留。
limitations: 仅依据官方摘要；未审阅正文证明和摘要未说明的假设。
仅摘要，未核查相边界、恢复误差和复杂度；长程纠缠不自动等于可高效纠错。

follow_up: 读者建议：核查 Markov length 发散是否阻碍目标局域 recovery。

papers.title: On the Failure Probability of Quantum Leftover Hashing with Bad Seeds
papers.abstract: We study hashing against quantum adversaries, as used in cryptographic applications, and provide bounds on the probability of failure in practical settings where seeds might be reused and might be non-ideal. Randomness extraction and privacy amplification are key components of quantum cryptographic protocols, such as quantum randomness generation or key distribution, that allow the compression of partially secure raw data into shorter output with high security. To ensure the security of any cryptographic construction that integrates them, it is desirable to establish composable security. This can be done by using methods based on universal hashing and leveraging the general leftover hash lemma, which allows extraction of near-uniform random numbers from an imperfect entropy source by sampling from an almost two-universal family of hash functions using a seed. This approach is taken in many practical implementations, commonly using Toeplitz hashing. The lemma provides an upper bound $\varepsilon$ on the distance of the output to uniform randomness, which holds on average over the choice of seeds. It makes no claim that any particular seed yields near-uniform random numbers. This poses a problem for practical applications where a seed is sampled once and reused for many rounds (blockwise hashing). Here, we study the subset of \textit{bad} seeds yielding far-from-uniform outputs. We show that randomness extraction against quantum side information is guaranteed to produce $δ$-close-to-uniform random numbers except with failure probability $\left(\frac{\varepsilon}δ\right)^2$. This result is generalised to blockwise hashing providing a guarantee of the security of $k$ rounds except with failure probability $\big(\frac{(2k-1)\varepsilon}δ\big)^2$. Moreover, we extend the general leftover hash lemma to blockwise hashing and relax the assumption of almost two-universality.

analysis.summary: 把 leftover hashing 的 seed 平均安全界转成坏 seed 的失败概率控制。
analysis.problem: 一次抽取后复用 seed 时，平均保证不足以说明每个固定 seed 都安全。
analysis.setting: almost two-universal hashing，对手持 quantum side information；blockwise reuse。
main_results: 作者主张单轮输出 δ-close-to-uniform 的失败概率至多 (ε/δ)^2。
k 轮 blockwise guarantee 的失败概率界为 ((2k−1)ε/δ)^2，并讨论非理想 hash families。
techniques: quantum leftover hashing；bad-seed tail bounds。
assumptions: ε 是相应 leftover-hash 平均界，δ 是目标安全距离；不能当无条件任意 seed 保证。
limitations: 仅依据官方摘要；未审阅正文证明和摘要未说明的假设。
只读官方 HTML 摘要；未审阅 seed/source 独立性、跨轮依赖和非理想家族扩展的完整条件。
本条分析仅依据论文摘要，未核查正文证明和摘要中未说明的假设。
relevance: 与 quantum side information 和固定随机选择的操作保证有关。
follow_up: 读者建议：核查与单次抽取 design 的概率保证相比，是否采用相同平均/条件化口径。

papers.title: Exceptional Points and Optimized Encoding in Qubit Stabilizer Codes
papers.abstract: Continuous blind stabilizer measurements turn stabilizer codes into a Liouvillian spectral problem in which Hamiltonian terms compete with dissipative error channels. We show that this competition generically enables Liouvillian exceptional points, whose occurrence at weak error rates is constrained by the code distance. Exceptional points are detrimental in this regime of error correction as they maximize the decay rate of encoded coherences. We then optimize the encoding of the logical qubit using the eigenmodes of the Lindblad operator. This phase-optimized encoding cancels the linear short-time decay of logical qubit coherences. We apply this encoding to the [[5,1,3]] code and demonstrate that it outperforms naive encoding methods near the exceptional point, improves the fidelity of a logical $π$ rotation and remains effective in the presence of additional weak error channels.

analysis.summary: 连续 blind stabilizer measurements 中，Lindbladian eigenmode encoding 可避免短时相干性的线性衰减。
analysis.problem: Hamiltonian 与 dissipative errors 竞争会产生不利于逻辑相干性的 exceptional points。
analysis.setting: queued v2；continuous stabilizer measurement；[[5,1,3]] code 实例。
main_results: 作者主张弱错误率区间 exceptional points 的出现受 code distance 约束。
通过相位优化编码取消 logical coherence 的 linear short-time decay，并在 exceptional point 附近改善 logical π-rotation fidelity。
techniques: Liouvillian spectral analysis；eigenmode-based encoding。
assumptions: 短时消线性项不等于所有时间最优；额外错误通道限定为弱噪声。
limitations: 仅依据官方摘要；未审阅正文证明和摘要未说明的假设。
仅读 v2 摘要；未审阅测量强度、误差类别、代码距离限制的精确定理和完整恢复成本。
本条分析仅依据论文摘要，未核查正文证明和摘要中未说明的假设。
relevance: 直接连接 logical encoding、连续测量与噪声依赖性能。
follow_up: 读者建议：核查该编码是否优化完整 logical channel fidelity，而非单个 coherence 分量。

papers.title: Efficient thermalization of one-dimensional noncommuting Hamiltonians via system-bath interactions with $Θ(n)$ ancilla qubits
papers.abstract: We prove rapid convergence of a system-bath interaction algorithm for preparing Gibbs states of one-dimensional noncommuting Hamiltonians at every fixed positive temperature. For a chain of $n$ qudits of local dimension $2^q$ with bounded nearest-neighbor interactions, the algorithm prepares the Gibbs state from any initial state to trace-norm error $0<\varepsilon\le1/2$ in expected total Hamiltonian evolution time $\widetilde{O}(n/\varepsilon)$. This improves the previously proved $\widetilde{O}(n^6/\varepsilon)$ bound for single-ancilla system-bath Gibbs samplers, up to logarithmic factors. The proposed algorithm couples $4^q-1$ resettable bath qubits to each site in parallel and randomizes the interaction time. Our analysis bounds both the one-round approximation error and the stationarity defect of an approximate stationary state in Gibbs-weighted $L^2$ norms, with only linear dependence on the system size. It also uses the dephasing induced by randomized evolution to control the extensive Lamb shift without treating it as a small perturbation of the dissipative dynamics.

analysis.summary: 并行 resettable bath ancillas 把 1D 非对易 Gibbs preparation 的已证演化时间降到近线性 n。
analysis.problem: 单 ancilla system-bath sampler 的既有证明有较高系统规模开销。
analysis.setting: 局域维数 2^q、bounded nearest-neighbor interactions；任意固定正温度、任意初态。
main_results: 作者给出 trace-norm error 0<ε≤1/2 下，expected total Hamiltonian evolution time 为 Õ(n/ε)。
比较基线为 single-ancilla 算法的 Õ(n^6/ε)；新算法每个 site 并行耦合 4^q−1 个可重置 bath qubits。
Gibbs-weighted L² bounds 同时控制单轮误差和 stationarity defect；随机演化产生的 dephasing 用于处理 extensive Lamb shift。
techniques: parallel system-bath interactions；randomized evolution。
assumptions: 温度和局域维数固定时，总辅助 qubits 为 Θ(n)。
limitations: 仅依据官方摘要；未审阅正文证明和摘要未说明的假设。
expected Hamiltonian evolution time 不是 gates、depth 或最坏情形执行时间；摘要未给温度依赖常数及 reset costs。
本条分析仅依据论文摘要，未核查正文证明和摘要中未说明的假设。
relevance: 具体展示 ancilla 与 thermalization time 的资源取舍。
follow_up: 读者建议：将 Hamiltonian evolution、reset 与控制访问成本统一核算。

papers.title: Agentic Pipelines for Mapping Topological Codes to Quantum Hardware
papers.abstract: Mapping a prescribed many-body Hamiltonian to a particular quantum hardware is generally an approximate process, resulting in both intended and unwanted quantum dynamics. We introduce an AI-agent-assisted workflow that uses Lean to establish whether an effective device Hamiltonian retains the intended low-energy subspace of the target many-body Hamiltonian. We demonstrate this approach with topological quantum error correction (QEC), providing, to our knowledge, the first Lean-verified pipeline connecting a code space to low-energy states of a device model. Starting from qubits and parity checks, the pipeline constructs the ideal Hamiltonian whose lowest energy states form the intended code space, and determines the excitation gap that protects that code space. It then tests if the device retains the required number of isolated low-energy states and quantifies how closely their subspace matches the intended code space. We compare three bounds on unwanted energy shifts obtained by: summing the interaction strengths, grouping the anticommuting Pauli interactions, and diagonalizing the Hamiltonian. Pauli grouping yields a bound that is tighter than the conventional sum and closer to the diagonalization result, avoiding overly conservative compensation requirements. The workflow also identifies the strongest unwanted interactions and the qubits they affect, providing specific targets for improving device couplings and controls. We demonstrate our framework using an eight-qubit toric-code array on a superconducting device, where the same driven device generates both the required four-qubit interactions as well as unwanted dynamics. An AI agent identifies viable device parameters within a prescribed leakage budget, and Lean verifies four isolated low-energy states close to the ideal code space. Our workflow supports predictive hardware engineering for analog implementations of QEC codes.

analysis.summary: 用 Hamiltonian perturbation bounds 与 Lean 证书检查设备低能空间是否保留目标码空间。
analysis.problem: 工程化相互作用含有 unwanted terms，不能仅凭目标 Hamiltonian 假定码成立。
analysis.setting: 八 qubit toric-code array 的 device model；隔离低能态与 subspace overlap。
main_results: 作者比较 strength-sum、anticommuting Pauli grouping 与 diagonalization；grouping bound 更紧。
实例中在 leakage budget 内寻找参数，并验证四个孤立低能态接近 ideal code space。
techniques: spectral/subspace perturbation；Pauli grouping；formal verification。
assumptions: 证书针对定义的 effective device Hamiltonian。
limitations: 仅依据官方摘要；未审阅正文证明和摘要未说明的假设。
未审阅 Lean 公理、代码与模型误差；低能 subspace 保留不是 noisy circuit threshold 或 logical fidelity 的完整保证。
本条分析仅依据论文摘要，未核查正文证明和摘要中未说明的假设。
relevance: 不是纯软件工程，具体针对 QEC 编码空间稳定性。
follow_up: 读者建议：核查未建模耦合与驱动近似误差如何进入证书。

papers.title: Belief Propagation-Informed Tesseract Decoding of Quantum LDPC Codes
papers.abstract: In quantum error correction, the decoder must estimate the errors from the measurement data accurately and fast enough to avoid a backlog. Search-based decoders such as Tesseract achieve high accuracy by finding a minimum-weight set of error events with an A* search, but their search effort grows rapidly with the physical error rate and the code size. To reduce this search effort while maintaining a logical error rate close to that of Tesseract, we propose a belief propagation (BP)-guided modification of the Tesseract decoder for quantum low-density parity-check (LDPC) codes. Damped sum-product BP is applied to the triggered detectors before the Tesseract search. If the detectors triggered by the BP hard decision match the triggered detectors, this hard decision is accepted directly, and the Tesseract search is skipped. Otherwise, the BP marginal probability estimates, weighted by a trust coefficient, modify the search priority, while the path cost keeps the channel-prior weights so that the decoding objective is unchanged. The framework also supports BP-based initialization, in which selected BP decisions form the starting point of a residual search whose signed-cost objective allows incorrect initial decisions to be removed. A node-exploration limit bounds this residual search; if the limit is reached, the decoder falls back to the BP-guided search on the original triggered detector set. The method is evaluated on the [[72,12,6]], [[90,8,10]], and [[144,12,12]] bivariate bicycle codes under circuit-level noise. With BP-based initialization and a global trust coefficient, the number of Tesseract search nodes expanded is reduced by up to more than two orders of magnitude at low physical error rates, while the logical error rate remains close to that of Tesseract.

analysis.summary: 用 BP marginals 引导 Tesseract 的 A* 搜索，降低 qLDPC 解码的搜索努力。
analysis.problem: 高精度搜索解码会随物理错误率和码规模迅速变慢。
analysis.setting: 三个 bivariate-bicycle codes：[[72,12,6]]、[[90,8,10]]、[[144,12,12]]；circuit-level noise。
main_results: BP hard decision 若匹配 detector syndrome 则直接接受，否则用 trust-weighted marginals 改变搜索优先级，但保持 channel-prior path cost。
可用 BP 初始化残余搜索并撤销错误初始化；搜索上限触发时 fallback。
作者报告低物理错误率下 expanded nodes 最多减少超过两个数量级，LER 仍接近 Tesseract。
techniques: damped sum-product BP；A*；residual search。
assumptions: 数值结果针对指定码及噪声；直接接受匹配 syndrome 的候选不自动保证最优恢复。
limitations: 仅依据官方摘要；未审阅正文证明和摘要未说明的假设。
节点数下降不等同 wall-clock latency 或 worst-case complexity；未检查代码和 full noise model。
本条分析仅依据论文摘要，未核查正文证明和摘要中未说明的假设。
relevance: 与 logical decoding 的精度/经典运行资源取舍有明确联系。
follow_up: 读者建议：比较 tail latency、内存和 fallback 频率。

papers.title: Towards Optimal Routing Strategies for qLDPC codes on Silicon Spin Qubits
papers.abstract: One of the major challenges of implementing high-rate quantum error correction codes, like qLDPC codes, is realizing the required long-range interactions. Spin qubit platforms can provide this connectivity by shuttling qubits next to each other whenever they need to interact. When doing this, the performance of the code depends on the shuttling strategy. We study memory experiments of the [[144,12,12]] bivariate bicycle (Gross) code on two shuttling grids for future spin qubit devices: a square grid and a square grid with diagonals. We compare three shuttling strategies, structured and random initial layouts, and a range of shuttling noise models spanning best- and worst-case scenarios. The best strategy minimizes the longest distance travelled rather than the total distance. The initial layout has only a weak effect, whereas adding diagonals to the grid reduces the logical error rate by up to two orders of magnitude which may have implications for future hardware design.

analysis.summary: qLDPC shuttling 的优化目标应考虑最大等待/移动距离，而不只总路程。
analysis.problem: Gross code 的非局域 parity checks 在可移动 spin qubits 上引入移动与闲置噪声。
analysis.setting: v1，[[144,12,12]] memory experiments；square grid 与含双对角线的 octagrid；三种 routing strategies。
main_results: 作者数值发现最小化最大移动距离的策略比最小化总路程更好；起始 layout 的影响较弱。
加入 diagonals 在强调 shuttling noise 的参数范围内可使 LER 改善近两个数量级；不能理解成所有参数都有该收益。
所读方法段把移动/闲置误差按 linear、exponential、Gaussian 三类距离规律扫描，另关联 SPAM、2Q errors 与 base physical error rate。
techniques: tick-wise routing；weighted perfect matching；circuit-level memory simulation。
assumptions: 假设 operation sites 足够实现 theoretical tick；正文给定 shuttling velocity、edge spacing 与 gate time。
limitations: 仅读摘要、引言及部分方法段；未复跑模拟或审阅全部 appendix。
不是一般最优 routing 证明或硬件演示；新增连接的额外噪声未必在各实现中免费。
relevance: 具体连接 locality、syndrome circuit scheduling 和 logical memory performance。
follow_up: 读者建议：检查降低最大路程是否也改善 total cycle duration，以及 diagonal 控制带来的额外错误。

papers.title: Full-Rank Constructions of Explicit Lossless Expanders and Good Small-Set qLTCs
papers.abstract: We construct explicit two-sided lossless expanders whose binary adjacency matrices have full rank, and use them to obtain explicit asymptotically good quantum LDPC codes whose specified X- and Z-check matrices have full row rank and satisfy small-set soundness, or confinement, on a linear range. Our lossless expanders are a variant of those of Hsieh, Lubotzky, Mohanty, Reiner, and Zhang, with a free action of a finite 2-group. Under such an action, injectivity and surjectivity of the adjacency matrix are detected on a fixed-size matrix indexed by vertex orbits. Adding a sparse factor to the gadget at the middle vertices of a single type then enforces full rank, with a controlled loss in expansion. To obtain the 2-group action, we observe that reducing the generators of the Lubotzky-Phillips-Sarnak Ramanujan graphs modulo powers of 2, instead of modulo an odd prime, gives Ramanujan Cayley graphs on finite 2-groups. This construction may be of independent interest. Plugging two such expanders into the balanced product of Lin and Hsieh gives the quantum codes, since full rank of the input graphs is inherited by the check matrices. Our construction supplies the code family sought by Hong, Guo, and Lucas. Applying their analysis, within their framework and under their dynamical assumptions, gives quantum memories whose free-energy density is analytic at every positive temperature and whose guaranteed lifetime is $exp(Ω(N))$ at sufficiently low fixed positive temperature, where N is the blocklength. This improves the previously guaranteed stretched-exponential timescale.

analysis.summary: 显式 full-rank lossless expanders 导出好 qLDPC 与线性范围 small-set confinement。
analysis.problem: 某些 quantum memory 分析还要求具体 X/Z check matrices 满行秩。
analysis.setting: finite 2-group action、binary adjacency matrices、balanced-product codes。
main_results: 作者以 fixed-size orbit matrix 检测 rank，并用 sparse gadget factor 在控制 expansion 损失下补足 rank。
代入 balanced product 得到 asymptotically good qLDPC，指定 check matrices full-row-rank 且满足 small-set soundness。
在所引用 memory framework 及其动力学假设下，充分低固定温度 lifetime guarantee 为 exp(Ω(N))。
techniques: 2-group Cayley/Ramanujan graphs；rank-preserving balanced product。
assumptions: memory lifetime 是带外部 dynamical assumptions 的推论。
limitations: 仅依据官方摘要；未审阅正文证明和摘要未说明的假设。
不能写成任意物理热浴下 self-correcting memory；small-set qLTC 不等于所有错误范围全局 soundness。
本条分析仅依据论文摘要，未核查正文证明和摘要中未说明的假设。
relevance: 直接关联 qLDPC、confinement 与长时量子存储。
follow_up: 读者建议：核查动力学假设及 noisy syndrome 电路是否纳入。

papers.title: Achievability of CSS codes performance limits over Pauli channels under separate ML decoding with bounded graphical complexity
papers.abstract: Capacity-approaching quantum error correction faces a fundamental tension: the required parity-check matrices need to become increasingly dense, while practical decoding and syndrome extraction favor sparse, bounded-degree structures. Reconciling these competing requirements remains an important open problem in quantum code design. We construct Calderbank-Shor-Steane (CSS) code ensembles that approach the CSS rate over memoryless Pauli channels under maximum-likelihood decoding while retaining sparse, bounded-degree graphical representations. The construction separates parity-check density from graphical complexity: although capacity-approaching components may require dense parity-check matrices, they are represented by sparse concatenated factor graphs. We first study a construction combining low-density parity-check (LDPC) and low-density generator-matrix (LDGM) component codes and numerically analyze the average weight distributions of the resulting codes. Motivated by these results, we introduce a second construction based on concatenated LDPC and LDGM codes and generalized irregular repeat-accumulate (GIRA) codes. We derive bounds on the average weight distribution of the resulting sum ensemble and use the Miller-Burshtein framework to prove simultaneous reliability of the two CSS decoding components. Consequently, the proposed ensemble achieves rates arbitrarily close to the CSS hashing bound under separate bit- and phase-error correction, while maintaining bounded graphical complexity, thus providing a foundation for future iterative decoders and indirect syndrome-extraction architectures.

analysis.summary: 用 sparse concatenated factor graphs 表示接近 CSS hashing bound 的码，而不把它们直接等同稀疏物理 checks。
analysis.problem: 接近容量通常要求 dense parity checks，与 bounded-degree 图实现存在张力。
analysis.setting: memoryless Pauli channels；separate bit/phase maximum-likelihood decoding。
main_results: 作者构造 LDPC/LDGM/GIRA components 的 CSS ensembles，证明两解码分量同时可靠。
达到任意接近 CSS hashing rate，并保持 bounded graphical complexity。
techniques: average weight-distribution bounds；Miller–Burshtein analysis。
assumptions: ML decoding 假设与 graphical sparsity 均需保留。
limitations: 仅依据官方摘要；未审阅正文证明和摘要未说明的假设。
只读 HTML 摘要；未审阅参数及证明。bounded graph degree 不自动提供 efficient iterative decoding 或浅层 noisy syndrome extraction。
本条分析仅依据论文摘要，未核查正文证明和摘要中未说明的假设。
relevance: 联系 hashing benchmark、编码结构与实现资源。
follow_up: 读者建议：检查间接 syndrome extraction 是否需要额外 ancillas 和高权重有效 checks。

papers.title: Fault-tolerant quantum error correction for constant-excitation stabilizer codes under coherent noise
papers.abstract: Collective coherent (CC) noise poses challenges for fault-tolerant error correction (FTEC), as it is not captured by conventional stochastic noise models. Constant-excitation (CE) codes are inherently immune to CC errors, but a fault-tolerant framework for operating these codes under circuit-level noise has not yet been established. Here, we develop an FTEC framework for CE CSS codes based on dual-rail concatenation. We show that conventional transversal CNOT gates violate the CE constraint and develop CE-preserving logical CNOT gates together with modified Shor- and Steane-type syndrome extraction schemes using zero-controlled NOT gates and CE-compatible ancilla states. We further develop an extended stabilizer simulation algorithm that tracks both stochastic and CC noise. Using this framework, we identify small distance-3 CE CSS codes demonstrate that the [[14, 1, 3]] code maintains robust performance under coherent noise. Our results establish a fault-tolerant framework for CE codes under circuit-level noise and demonstrate their potential for quantum processors affected by CC noise.

analysis.summary: 论文为 constant-excitation（CE）CSS codes 构造电路层面的容错纠错流程，使编码态对集体相干噪声的保护能延伸到逻辑门与 syndrome 提取。核心问题是操作过程也必须保持编码所依赖的对称性。
analysis.problem: CE 码能抵御 collective coherent noise，但常规容错操作可能破坏 CE 条件。作者要补上从静态保护性质到可运行 FTEC 电路之间的缺口。
analysis.setting: 采用 dual-rail concatenation 的 CE CSS 编码，考虑同时包含随机与集体相干分量的电路层噪声，研究逻辑 CNOT 和 Shor/Steane 型 syndrome extraction。
main_results: 作者指出通常的 transversal CNOT 会违反 CE 约束，并提出 CE-preserving 的逻辑 CNOT。
改造 syndrome 提取线路，使用 zero-controlled NOT 和与 CE 条件相容的辅助态。
扩展 stabilizer simulation 以同时跟踪 stochastic 与 collective coherent noise；给出小规模 distance-3 码，并报告 [[14,1,3]] 码在所研究相干噪声下保持稳健性能。
techniques: 用 dual-rail 拼接组织固定激发数结构；再逐项调整逻辑门、辅助态和 syndrome 电路，使保护机制在操作时仍可使用。
将噪声建模与 stabilizer 跟踪结合，评估电路级而非仅存储级的纠错表现。
assumptions: 保护针对集体相干噪声的特定结构，不能直接推广为对任意相关噪声免疫。
实现依赖 CE-compatible ancilla states 及相应受控门。
limitations: 本条仅依据出版商公开摘要；尚未核查证明、门级故障假设、伪阈值及辅助态准备成本。

papers.title: Shallow data-loading circuits for multivariable functions
papers.abstract: We construct shallow QROM, diagonal block-encoding, and quantum state preparation oracles for analytic functions on the $D$-dimensional hypercube $[0, 1]^D$. On $n$ qubits and with $2^{- Ω(n/D)}$ error, these circuits have depths of $O \left( \sqrt{\frac{n \log_2 (n)}{D}} \right)$ in the Clifford + $T$ gate set, albeit using $2^{O(\sqrt{nD \log_2 (n)})}$ ancilla qubits. This is a near-quadratic depth reduction compared to known linear-depth methods.

analysis.summary: 以大量 ancillas 换取 analytic-function data loading 的近平方深度改善。
analysis.problem: QROM、diagonal block-encoding 和态准备是否能突破既有线性 depth？
analysis.setting: n qubits 离散 D-dimensional hypercube 上 analytic functions，Clifford+T circuits。
main_results: 作者给 error 2^{-Ω(n/D)} 下 depth O(√(n log₂ n/D))。
代价为 2^{O(√(nD log₂ n))} ancillas；常数依赖函数的 analytic properties。
techniques: sparse Walsh–Hadamard transforms；piecewise Taylor approximations。
assumptions: 函数类与变量维数、离散精度应一起核算。
limitations: 仅依据官方摘要；未审阅正文证明和摘要未说明的假设。

papers.title: Interaction order sets the onset cost of steady-state quantum magic
papers.abstract: Maintaining quantum magic under continuous noise requires coherent control and a supply of purity. We determine the cost of local stabilizer replacement resets sustaining any positive stationary magic in autonomous qubit networks with depolarization rate $γ$, interactions on at most $k$ sites, and Hamiltonian strength $J$ per site. An exact global stabilizer decomposition and a matching finite construction give the optimal onset scaling $γ(γ/J)^{1/(k-1)}$, uniformly over network size and noisy ancillas. For two-body interactions, the leading maximal-reset-rate coefficient is $1/(2\sqrt2)$ for every fixed finite size $N\ge2$, allowing mixed reset targets and heterogeneous rates. The same coefficient holds uniformly over growing networks with pure Pauli targets and equal reset rates. The converse combines hafnian stabilizer geometry with a positive random-order forest expansion.

analysis.summary: 物理 interaction order 决定强噪声下维持任意正 steady-state magic 所需的 reset-rate onset。
analysis.problem: 扩大 controller 或加入 noisy ancillas 能否降低从 stabilizer convex hull 外产生稳态的控制成本？
analysis.setting: 全体 qubits 均受 depolarization γ；Hamiltonian 至多 k-body、每 site strength budget J；local stabilizer replacement resets，k≥2。
main_results: 作者以 exact global stabilizer decomposition 给所有有限 controller 的排除界，再用 k-qubit module 匹配 onset exponent。J/γ→0、k 固定时，max reset rate、total rate 和等价 Lindblad budget 的 onset 均为 Θ_k(γ(γ/J)^{1/(k−1)})。
两体 sharp coefficient 1/(2√2) 对每个固定 N≥2 的 mixed-target/heterogeneous 模型成立；对 growing N 的 uniform 结论另有限定为 pure Pauli targets/common rates 等所述情形。
physical two-body couplings 加 noisy mediator 不会因有效高阶 Hamiltonian 就绕开两体 bound。
techniques: positive stabilizer reconstruction；hafnian geometry；random-order forest expansion。
assumptions: onset 仅要求任意大于零的 magic，不固定资源量或密度。
J 与 k 预算针对完整物理装置，包括 auxiliaries。
limitations: 本轮读取摘要及主文模型/结果片段，未核查 Supplemental Material 的证明和数值代码。
一般 growing mixed-target class 的 sharp coefficient 尚未闭合；不能将 fixed-size 常数无条件推广到所有网络。
这是 rate budget，不是离散 T-count、design magic cost 或完整计算优势定理。
relevance: 直接连接 magic、interaction locality、ancillas 与 noise resource bounds。
follow_up: 读者建议：区分 magic onset、固定 magic density 与可用于计算的资源产率。

papers.title: Access Resources and Stability of Error-Correction Capabilities in Continuous Strategic Codes
papers.abstract: Continuous quantum error correction depends on which parts of a measurement record remain available to the controller at recovery. We study this temporal access using continuous strategic codes, formulated as open continuous process tensors contracted with causal instruments and conditional recovery. For monitored stabilizer codes, a common-optimal-correction criterion identifies when records can be merged without loss and yields a factorization for separated CSS inference. Terminal decision labels and causal persistent memory carry different costs: five persistent classical states reach the complete-record optimum in a finite-strength counting model, whereas its two-window diffusive counterpart has nine terminal decision labels and requires unbounded memory for exact causal recovery. Uniform lower and constructive upper bounds establish an optimal fidelity deficit of order $m^{-2}$ for $m$ persistent states in the diffusive model. Counting and diffusive stability bounds translate open-process approximation into guarantees for deployed-controller performance and retained access advantages, quantified by explicit quantizers and model-mismatch curves. The same process--instrument framework connects storage with persistent environments and irreversible noise to spacetime interrogation and record-selected paths for a logical $T$ gate. These results specify which record distinctions recovery needs, the memory cost of approximating them, and the logical protection retained under model error.

analysis.summary: 连续 QEC 中的 terminal decisions 和计算这些 decisions 所需的 causal persistent memory 是不同资源。
analysis.problem: 测量历史的哪些区别必须保留到 recovery，模型误差又会怎样影响收益？
analysis.setting: open continuous process tensors 与 causal instruments、conditional recovery；monitored stabilizer codes。
main_results: common-optimal-correction criterion 判断记录能否无损合并，并给 separated CSS inference 的分解。
指定 finite-strength counting model 中五个 persistent classical states 达完整记录最优；同隐藏错误 schedule 的 two-window diffusive model 虽仅九个 terminal labels，精确 causal recovery 却需无界 memory。
diffusive case 中 m 个 persistent states 的 optimal fidelity deficit 为 Θ(m^-2)；主文还提出在有界 response/control 资源下对同一 controller class 的 uniform stability。
techniques: record-conditioned optimal recovery；finite-state causal compression；quantizers；process–instrument contraction。
assumptions: 五态/九标签/逆平方规律针对所构造模型，不是所有 continuous QEC 的通用常数。
persistent states 是离散 memory cardinality，不是连续 Bayesian statistic 的变量个数。
limitations: 只读摘要、引言及任务边界片段；未审阅 memory theorem、stability inequalities 和逻辑 T 路径的全部证明。
允许的 terminal CPTP recovery、固定 decoder 和中途控制应分别比较，不能把 gate task 的收益都归于最终恢复。
relevance: 直接对应 side-information timing、adaptive resources 与 logical recovery。
follow_up: 读者建议：核查目标固定 noisy gate 模型允许哪些记录和中途干预。
读者建议：比较近似有限 memory 时，process estimation error 与量化误差的合成。

papers.title: Near-Optimal Learning of Quantum Many-Body Systems from Gibbs and Thermal Metastable States via the Stationarity Test
papers.abstract: We study the problem of learning a finite-range quantum Hamiltonian on an $n$-qubit $D$-dimensional lattice from copies of its Gibbs states at a known inverse temperature $β$ or its thermal metastable states. Existing efficient algorithms at arbitrary temperature have sample guarantees with an $e^{\poly(β)}$ dependence, leaving open whether the exponent can be made linear in $β$. We achieve this improvement: for $β\ge1$, our algorithm learns all Hamiltonian coefficients to $\ell_\infty$-error $ε$ with probability at least $1-δ$ using $\tO\bigl(e^{O(β)}ε^{-2}\log(n/δ)\bigr)$ copies and total time $\tO\bigl(n e^{O(β)}ε^{-2}\log(n/δ)\bigr)$. The measurements act on individual copies and are supported on balls of radius $O\bigl(β^2+β\log(1/ε)\bigr)$. Our sample complexity achieves the optimal exponential order in $β$, with optimal $ε^{-2}$ dependence up to logarithmic factors. Building on the stationarity-test framework \citep{Bergamaschi2026Stationarity}, we prove a unified Fisher-information coercivity bound showing that errors in the candidate Hamiltonian produce a detectable signal with only an $e^{-O(β)}$ loss in sensitivity. The key is a smooth frequency filter whose bandwidth remains independent of temperature, together with sharper estimates relating this signal to the Hamiltonian coefficients. For thermal metastable states, the guarantee holds under local drift $ζ\le e^{-Cβ^{2D+1}}$, for a geometry-dependent constant $C>0$, and above an accuracy floor $\tO(e^{O(β)}ζ)$. The argument applies to both Gibbs and thermal metastable states and, combined with local measurements and projected stochastic gradient descent (SGD), yields both learning guarantees.

analysis.summary: stationarity test 将局域 Hamiltonian learning 的温度依赖改善为 e^{O(β)}。
analysis.problem: 既有高温以外学习界中的 e^{poly(β)} 代价是否可降低？
analysis.setting: n-qubit D-dimensional finite-range Hamiltonian；已知 β≥1 的 Gibbs 或受控 thermal-metastable copies。
main_results: 作者给 coefficient ℓ∞ error ε、failure δ 下 copies 为 Õ(e^{O(β)}ε^-2 log(n/δ))，总时间再乘 n。
单拷贝测量支撑半径 O(β²+β log(1/ε))；不是单 qubit product readout。
metastable 版本要求 local drift ζ≤exp(-Cβ^{2D+1})，且目标误差高于 Õ(e^{O(β)}ζ) floor。
techniques: smooth frequency filter；Fisher-information coercivity；projected SGD。
assumptions: 已知温度、有限作用范围与 geometry 条件。
limitations: 仅依据官方摘要；未审阅正文证明和摘要未说明的假设。
仅摘要，未检查 optimality 的比较域及局部测量实施成本；这是 copy access learning，不是固定门 benchmarking。
本条分析仅依据论文摘要，未核查正文证明和摘要中未说明的假设。

follow_up: 读者建议：比较允许的测量球与实验单基 readout 的访问差异。

papers.title: Boson sampling is fragile to loss
papers.abstract: Boson sampling experiments aim to demonstrate quantum computational advantage with increasing numbers of interfering photons. A central question is whether their computational hardness survives under photon loss. We show that even an arbitrarily small nonzero uniform loss rate permits efficient classical sampling in the average case when the rate remains fixed as the system grows. We exploit how loss suppresses correlations involving many photons to approximate the full output distribution using low correlation orders. The resulting samplers run in time polynomial in system size and inverse total variation error, with the error averaged over Haar random interferometers. The results apply to Fock state boson sampling with single-photon states in distinct input modes and arbitrary additional vacuum inputs, and to Gaussian boson sampling with equal squeezing of bounded strength in every input mode. Classical sampling is efficient even when the mean detected photon number grows linearly with system size, showing that large photon counts alone do not ensure computational hardness.

analysis.summary: 任意固定非零 uniform loss 下，特定 boson sampling 模型可在 Haar 平均意义经典高效采样。
analysis.problem: 高 photon counts 是否足以维持 sampling hardness？
analysis.setting: distinct single-photon Fock inputs 加 vacuum；equal bounded squeezing 的 Gaussian boson sampling。
main_results: 作者利用高阶 photon correlations 的损耗抑制，构造对规模和 inverse TV error 多项式的 sampler。
误差对 Haar-random interferometers 平均；线性增长的 detected photons 仍不排除此类模拟。
techniques: low-correlation-order approximation。
assumptions: 固定 loss rate 的渐近极限；限定输入态和平均误差。
limitations: 仅依据官方摘要；未审阅正文证明和摘要未说明的假设。
不覆盖任意 interferometer、vanishing loss 或一般 BQP；TV error 不等于相对误差。
本条分析仅依据论文摘要，未核查正文证明和摘要中未说明的假设。

follow_up: 读者建议：比较平均误差与高概率保证之间是否有额外损失。

papers.title: Logical-Class Diagnostic Layer for Stabilizer Codes and Decoders via Supercharge Structures
papers.abstract: We develop a decoder-agnostic logical-class diagnostic layer for abelian Pauli stabilizer codes, motivated by fault-tolerant quantum computing. An ancilla fermionic register defines a nilpotent supercharge whose clean degree-zero harmonic sector is the code space. Projected-return blocks derived from graded commutators organize the recovery test of whether a decoder-selected correction preserves every encoded input for every error in a declared same-syndrome family; the passing syndromes form the certified faithful window. Demoting the supercharge to an exact binary diagnostic formulation classifies residuals modulo stabilizers, separating a check violation, a harmless stabilizer residual, and a syndrome-silent nontrivial logical action, with a two-sector form for CSS codes. Because the unknown fault cancels, the relative logical class of two record-compatible candidates is computable online. We verify the diagnostic formalisms on the Steane code and specify a static--circuit bridge audit protocol for the Gross bivariate-bicycle quantum low-density parity-check (qLDPC) code. The method supplements existing decoders without additional physical qubits for software use.

analysis.summary: 作者为 abelian Pauli stabilizer codes 提出不依赖具体 decoder 的 logical-class diagnostic layer，检验给定 syndrome family 中的恢复是否对所有编码输入保持作用，避免将 syndrome 消失误当作逻辑正确。
analysis.problem: 同 syndrome 的物理错误可以落入不同逻辑类，decoder 的候选修正可能无 syndrome 却产生逻辑误差。
analysis.setting: 声明的 same-syndrome error family；supercharge 辅助表述及其 exact binary diagnostic 版本。
main_results: 二元形式区分 check violation、无害 stabilizer residual 和 syndrome-silent logical action，CSS 有两 sector 表述。
两个记录相容候选的相对逻辑类可在线计算；在 Steane code 验证，并提出 Gross qLDPC 的 static–circuit bridge audit。
techniques: nilpotent supercharge；graded commutators；残差按 stabilizer 取商。
assumptions: faithful window 的保证依赖已声明错误族；相对类消去未知 fault。
limitations: 仅读取官方摘要，未审阅正文证明及摘要未说明的假设。
并不意味着识别实际发生的未知错误或测出绝对逻辑 fidelity。
软件使用不增加物理 qubits；形式中的 fermionic ancilla register 不能混同于实机必需 ancilla。
正文和电路桥接审计细节未审。

papers.title: All-to-All Connectivity in Superconducting Qubits via Metamaterial-Mediated Interactions
papers.abstract: We show that encoding superconducting qubits as dual-rail or spin-locked transmons lets a metamaterial waveguide couple them all-to-all while suppressing the spurious entanglement that burdens shared-mode architectures, a step toward the non-local connectivity that quantum low-density parity-check codes require. In a bare-transmon architecture, the dispersive coupling between each populated mode and every idle qubit attached to it entangles spectators with the gate, and cancelling it by dynamical decoupling lengthens every gate. The encoding suppresses this coupling at the hardware level, from second to fourth order in the inverse qubit--mode detuning. A two-tone cross-resonance drive then generates a Mølmer-Sørensen interaction between encoded qubits, which we use for an entangling gate and a joint parity measurement, both selective and parallelizable through different modes. Simulating two dual-rail transmons sharing three resonators with a mode lifetime of $30\,μ$s, we find that heralding transmon relaxation as erasure leaves a gate infidelity of $1.4\times10^{-3}$ at $152$~ns, dominated by photon loss. Photon loss and mode crowding together bound the array size. The gate duration must exceed the inverse mode spacing, which shrinks as the array lengthens, while photon loss grows with gate duration. This bound grows linearly with the mode lifetime and with the inter-resonator coupling; at a lifetime of $150\,μ$s, five times the simulated value, and a coupling of $80$~MHz, a $10^{-3}$ error budget admits $13$ qubits on $25$ resonators.

analysis.summary: 论文利用 dual-rail 或 spin-locked transmon 编码，降低 metamaterial 共享模式产生的 spectator 纠缠，并用 two-tone cross-resonance 实现纠缠门与 joint parity measurement，为非局部 QEC 连接提供具体元件。
analysis.problem: 裸 transmon 的 dispersive spectator coupling 需要延长门的 decoupling，限制共享模式扩展。
analysis.setting: 编码 transmons 通过 metamaterial waveguide 相连；两 dual-rail transmons、三 resonators 的模拟。
main_results: 编码使所述耦合在逆 detuning 中由二阶降为四阶。
mode lifetime 30 μs 下，transmon relaxation 被 herald 为 erasure 后，152 ns 门 infidelity 为 1.4×10⁻³，主导残差为 photon loss。
150 μs lifetime 和80 MHz耦合的参数估计，在10⁻³预算下允许13 qubits/25 resonators。
techniques: 编码抑制 dispersive coupling；Mølmer–Sørensen interaction；选择性并行 parity readout。
assumptions: heralded erasure 与未标记误差分开；扩展估算使用比模拟大5倍的 mode lifetime。
limitations: 仅读取官方摘要，未审阅正文证明及摘要未说明的假设。
门时长受 mode spacing 限制；photon loss 随门时长增加。
这是模拟及规模估算，未给出实际 decoder 下的 logical fidelity 或阈值。
本条分析仅依据论文摘要，未核查正文证明和摘要中未说明的假设。
