follow_up: 读者建议：将 erasure rate、残余相干误差与测量误差一起代入固定码恢复评估。

papers.title: Normal Factor Graph Representations of Stabilizer Quantum Codes with Applications
papers.abstract: We develop normal factor graph (NFG) representations of stabilizer quantum error-correcting codes and entanglement-assisted quantum error-correcting codes. We introduce two complementary representations. Quantum-code NFGs describe stabilizer and normalizer label codes and provide a graphical framework for establishing self-orthogonality, constructing codes from component codes, and identifying encoding and decoding circuits. Quantum-probability NFGs represent the quantum-mechanical probabilities associated with encoding, noise, and measurement. We also introduce a doubleedge formulation that makes the relationship between these two representations explicit. We apply the framework to convolutional and tail-biting convolutional stabilizer codes, as well as to two classes of low-density parity-check stabilizer codes. Finally, we extend the quantum-probability representation to entanglementassisted codes.

analysis.summary: 作者建立两类互补 normal factor graphs：quantum-code NFG 描述 stabilizer/normalizer label codes，quantum-probability NFG 描述编码、噪声和测量概率；double-edge formulation 连接两者。
analysis.problem: 把经典 factor graph 方法用于量子码，需要同时处理自正交约束与量子概率结构。
analysis.setting: stabilizer 和 entanglement-assisted codes，应用于 convolutional、tail-biting 与两类 LDPC stabilizer codes。
main_results: 图结构用于建立自正交性、由 component codes 构码，并识别 encoding/decoding circuits。
概率表示扩展到 entanglement-assisted codes。
techniques: normal factor graph；label-code duality；double-edge representation。
assumptions: 两类图表达不同对象，不应把标签约束图等同于全部量子概率。
limitations: 仅读取官方摘要，未审阅正文证明及摘要未说明的假设。
本次读取 HTML 的摘要，正文与附录证明未审。
摘要未报告更优阈值、实际解码速度或样本复杂度，表示框架本身不保证这些优势。

papers.title: Binary Quantum Hypothesis Testing with a Rejection Option: The Exact Error-Exponent Trade-off
papers.abstract: We characterize the exact error-exponent trade-off in binary quantum hypothesis testing with a rejection option for faithful states on a finite-dimensional Hilbert space. The probabilities of rejection under the two hypotheses are required to vanish exponentially, with exponents at least $K$ and $L$. We show that a quadruple $(a,b,K,L)$ of positive error and rejection exponents is achievable if and only if it satisfies three single-letter conditions: two conditions involve Petz--Rényi quantities and coincide with the converse bound conjectured to be tight by Ji and Regula; the third involves the $α$--$z$ Rényi quantities on the triangle $\max\{α,1-α\}\le z\le1$. The proof combines a sector decomposition inside Schur--Weyl blocks, an explicit one-shot measurement construction, and an exact minimax argument.

analysis.summary: 论文确定带拒绝选项的二元量子假设检验的完整误差指数区域。检验有两个决定与拒绝三种输出；拒绝虽可换来更少误判，但在两种真实假设下也都必须按各自指定速率消失。
analysis.problem: 允许 abstention 时，两个误判指数与两个拒绝指数能否同时达到？
analysis.setting: 有限维 faithful states；正指数 (a,b,K,L)，其中 K 与 L 约束两种假设下的拒绝概率。
main_results: 可达性当且仅当满足三个 single-letter 条件。
两个由 Petz–Rényi 量给出，与此前猜想可紧的 converse 一致；额外约束涉及 α–z Rényi 量，参数三角为 max{α,1−α}≤z≤1。
techniques: Schur–Weyl blocks 内部分区、显式 one-shot measurement 与 exact minimax。
assumptions: faithful 及正指数是摘要陈述条件。
limitations: 仅依据正式摘要；未审阅正文证明及摘要未说明的假设。
不把 single-letter 区域当成单副本测量的可达性；公式、边界指数和可实现测量限制待正文核对。
本条分析仅依据论文摘要，未核查正文证明和摘要中未说明的假设。
relevance: 精确区分允许拒绝、测量访问及总误差的操作性目标。
follow_up: 读者建议：在同一测量限制下比较带拒绝与无拒绝的指数区域。

papers.title: Multicopy teleportation and quantum program retrieval on superconducting quantum hardware
papers.abstract: Correction-free teleportation protocols offer a probabilistic route around the limits imposed by the quantum no-programming theorem, but have remained largely theoretical. Here, we experimentally implement and benchmark correction-free multicopy teleportation on noisy superconducting quantum hardware. Key to this is an efficient circuit implementation: by suitably decomposing the unitary that maps the multicopy measurement basis onto the computational basis, we substantially reduce circuit depth and gate count. For one- and two-qubit input states, using $k=2$ and $3$ copies, we observe success probabilities substantially exceeding the single-copy bound with fidelities above 0.85. We further explore applications to probabilistic programmable quantum processors, in particular the storage and retrieval of unitary operations encoded in quantum program states. Our results establish the practical feasibility of multicopy teleportation and highlight its potential for near-term quantum processors and distributed quantum computing.

analysis.summary: 作者在 noisy superconducting hardware 实现 correction-free multicopy teleportation 与 quantum program retrieval。资源是额外输入态副本和集体测量电路，而不是无成本绕过 no-programming theorem。
analysis.problem: 不依赖未知 U 的接收端校正限制了普通 program-state retrieval 的成功率。
analysis.setting: k 个相同未知纯态输入；将集体 measurement basis 映射到计算基，通过 unitary completion 和电路分解实现。
main_results: 正文给出理想最优成功率 p(d,k)=k/[d(k−1+d)]，k=1 时为1/d²，k→∞ 趋于1/d。
摘要报告一、二 qubit 输入、k=2和3的实验 fidelity 高于0.85；正文提示最大测试副本数时硬件噪声会压低优势。
techniques: collective measurement；unitary completion；quantum Shannon/isometry decomposition。
assumptions: 额外输入 copies 是真实资源；program storage 与 retrieval 阶段分开。
limitations: 仅读摘要、引言和协议概要片段；未审完整实验表格、shots、误差条和附录。

papers.title: The exact information cost of randomized measurements in quantum metrology
papers.abstract: Randomized measurements provide state-independent readout for multiparameter quantum sensing. Although 3-designs retain a constant fraction of the quantum Fisher information (QFI) for every pure state, we show that 2-designs need not. In dimension \(d\), complete mutually unbiased bases (MUBs) retain exactly \(1/(d+1)\) of the QFI in the worst state and direction, attaining the universal lower bound for 2-designs built from orthonormal bases; symmetric informationally complete (SIC) measurements retain exactly \((1-1/\sqrt{d+1})/d\). The loss comes from aligned blind spots. Relative to a basis, pure-state changes split into population and phase parts of equal dimension, but probabilities respond only to the former. Mutual unbiasedness turns a population change for one basis into a phase change for every other. The worst case already occurs for a qubit encoded in two levels. Independent random bases instead scatter their blind spots. In sufficiently large dimensions, five Haar-random bases retain, with high probability, a dimension-independent QFI fraction for every pure state and direction. Random Clifford measurements on any number of qubits retain exactly one third. Thus blind-spot geometry, not second-order symmetry alone, controls worst-case metrological performance.

analysis.summary: 论文表明二阶设计并不能保证纯态传感的最坏方向保留常数比例的量子 Fisher 信息。关键不是基的数目或二阶对称性本身，而是各测量基看不到的方向是否重合。对一个基而言，概率直接响应 population 的一阶变化，但对相对 phase 变化没有同样的响应；互无偏基会把一个基能看到的某些方向变成其他基的盲区。
analysis.problem: 选择不依赖未知纯态的测量后，经典 Fisher 矩阵 I 相对 QFI 矩阵 J 的最坏保留比例是多少？能否用少量固定测量基统一覆盖所有态和切向方向？
analysis.setting: d维纯态模型；比较完整 MUB、SIC、独立 Haar 随机基与 n-qubit 全局随机 Clifford 测量。保留比例针对最坏纯态和方向；不能用对态或测量基的简单平均代替。
main_results: 完整 MUB 的最坏保留量为1/(d+1)，达到由正交基组成的2-design 的通用下界；SIC 为(1−1/√(d+1))/d。最坏方向可在两能级子空间出现，显示即使整体测量覆盖整个 Hilbert 空间，少量对齐的盲点也能主导最坏情况。
正文 Result 6：等权混合 K≥5 个独立 Haar 基，在充分大的 d 中，以至少1−2^(−d) 的概率获得与 d 无关的下界 c_K，同时保护所有纯态和方向。概率是对测量基集合的随机抽取而言；并不是对每个样本重抽测量基就自动获得同一结论。作者证明至少需要三个，三或四个是否足够仍未定。
随机 Clifford 测量在任意 qubit 数有 I≽J/3，最坏常数恰为1/3；不表示每个态和方向都等于1/3。正文所指的是所有 stabilizer bases 的均匀混合。
作者还区分了 sensing 与 shadow estimation：少量随机基可有良好的最坏 Fisher 常数，但不保证小的最坏 shadow norm，因而不能从这里直接推断通用可观测量估计的样本优势。
techniques: 将切向方向分解为测量基中的 population 与 phase 成分，比较盲区几何。
随机基部分用独立性压低多基同时近盲的概率，再覆盖态与方向；Clifford 结果利用 stabilizer 和 Pauli 结构。
assumptions: 态模型为纯态；Haar 基独立，等权混合；Clifford 结果使用全局 ensemble，未替换成逐比特 Clifford。
limitations: 只读 arXiv v1 摘要、Result 6、相关讨论及附录中 Clifford 定理的片段；未逐步审查集中界、奇异概率处的 Fisher 约定和数值常数。

papers.title: Early Fault-Tolerant Magic State Synthesis and Spacetime Efficient Analog Rotations with Color Code on a Superconducting Quantum Processor
papers.abstract: With recent improvements to syndrome extraction scheduling and decoding, and the availability of complete transversal Clifford operations and lattice surgery, color code is an especially promising platform for quantum processors with local connectivity. The key ingredient for universal computation is thus generating useful magic states with limited resources. Space-Time Efficient Analog Rotations (STAR) and Fault-tolerant magic state synthesis (MSS) are two such methods for magic state generation, targeted for near-term and long-term quantum computing, respectively. In this work, we perform the first implementations of both magic state paradigms on a superconducting quantum processor. We present a STAR-type injection protocol on the color code, with favorable error rate and spacetime costs versus prior protocols on both the color and surface codes. We then implement a MSS factory by performing multi-patch magic state cultivations, interleaved with transversal Clifford operations, and lattice-surgery magic state teleportation. Under post-selection, we achieve a kickback tomography correct sign probability of $99.9859\%$ on cultivated $T_L$ states, $96\%$ tomographic fidelity on logical analog rotation states, and $91\%$ fidelity on synthesized logical magic states consuming 3 cultivated $T_L$ states, 3 transversal Hadamard operations, and real-time feed-forward $S_L$ corrections during magic state teleportation. We compare the efficacy of post-selection, Most-Likely-Error (MLE) decoding, and concatenated-matching decoding throughout, highlighting the potential of end-to-end color code computation.

后选择下，cultivated T_L 的 kickback tomography 正确符号概率为99.9859%；逻辑 analog rotation 态的层析保真度为96%，合成逻辑 magic state 为91%。

papers.title: Rare-Event Quantum Sensing Using Logical Qubits
authors: Robert Ott, Torsten V. Zache, Soonwon Choi, Adam M. Kaufman, and Hannes Pichler
papers.abstract: We present a novel protocol to detect rare signals in a noisy environment using quantum error correction (QEC). The key feature of our protocol is the discrimination between signal and noise through distinct higher-order correlations, realized by the nonlinear processing that occurs during syndrome extraction in QEC. In this scheme, QEC has two effects. First, it sacrifices part of the signal ε by recording a reduced, stochastic, logical phase ϕ L = O ( ε 3 ) . Second, it corrects the physical noise and extends the (logical) coherence time for signal acquisition. For rare signals occurring at random times in the presence of local Markovian noise, we explicitly demonstrate an improved sensitivity of our approach over more conventional sensing strategies.

analysis.summary: 论文利用 QEC 的 syndrome 提取非线性处理，在噪声背景中辨认稀有信号。它接受逻辑信号变弱，以换取更长的逻辑相干时间和更好的最终灵敏度。

该处理把原信号参数 ε 转为随机逻辑相位 φ_L=O(ε³)，同时纠错延长信号积累时间；在论文指定稀有事件模型中展示灵敏度改进。

limitations: 仅阅读正式发表版本摘要，未核查推导、最优 sensing 时间与纠错循环成本。

papers.title: Certifying Localizable Quantum Properties with Constant Sample Complexity
authors: Zhenyu Du, Jinchang Liu, Elias X. Huber, Zi-Wen Liu, and Xiongfeng Ma
papers.abstract: Characterizing increasingly complex quantum systems is a central task in quantum information science, yet experimental costs often scale prohibitively with system size. Certifying key properties using simple local measurements is highly desirable but challenging. In this work, we introduce a highly general certification framework based on a physical phenomenon that we call localizable quantumness: for generic many-body states, essential quantum properties are robustly preserved within the projected ensembles on small subsystems after performing local projective measurements on the rest of the system. Leveraging this insight, we develop protocols to certify global properties—including multipartite entanglement, circuit complexity, and quantum magic—by witnessing them on a small, accessible subsystem. Remarkably, randomizing the local measurement bases extends this capability to certify state fidelity. Relying solely on local Pauli measurements, these protocols achieve constant sample complexity and robustness for almost all quantum states, including a wide range of physically relevant states. For certifying the fidelity of n -qubit states, this O ( 1 ) scaling dramatically improves upon state-of-the-art protocols requiring O ( n 4 ) samples. Our unified framework provides both a practical toolkit for large-scale quantum certification and a novel lens into complex many-body systems.

analysis.problem: 全局认证通常随系统规模增长而昂贵。
analysis.setting: generic many-body states；只使用 local Pauli measurements。
main_results: 作者将 entanglement、circuit complexity、magic 的全局见证局域化；随机化测量基后可认证 state fidelity。

papers.title: Spreading of Magic Resource under Unitary Clifford Dynamics
authors: Mircea Bejan, Pieter W. Claeys, and Jiangtian Yao
papers.abstract: Nonstabilizerness, or quantum magic resource, presents a valuable resource in quantum error correction and computation. We study the dynamics of locally injected nonstabilizerness in unitary Clifford circuits, where the total nonstabilizerness is conserved. However, the absence of physical observables quantifying nonstabilizerness precludes a direct microscopic or hydrodynamic description of its local distribution and dynamics. Using insights from stabilizer quantum error correcting codes, we rigorously show that the spatial distribution of nonstabilizerness can be inferred from a canonical representation of low-magic states, dubbed the bipartite magic gauge. Moreover, we propose two operationally relevant magic length scales. We numerically establish that, at early times, both length scales grow ballistically at distinct velocities set by the entanglement velocity, after which nonstabilizerness delocalizes. Our Letter sheds light on the spatiotemporal structure of quantum resources and complexity in many-body dynamics, opening up avenues for investigating their transport properties and further connections with quantum error correction.

analysis.summary: 总 magic 守恒的 Clifford dynamics 仍可产生可区分的 magic 空间传播尺度。

analysis.setting: 局部注入 nonstabilizerness 的低 magic 态及 unitary Clifford circuits。
main_results: 作者以 bipartite magic gauge 严格连接 canonical representation 与空间分布。

papers.title: Algorithmic Construction of Gapped Boundaries for Topological Stabilizer Codes: A Route to Low-Overhead Planar qLDPC Codes
authors: Zijian Liang (梁子健), Bowen Yang (杨博闻), Joseph T. Iosue, and Yu-An Chen (陳昱安)
papers.abstract: Quantum low-density parity-check (qLDPC) codes promise low-overhead fault-tolerant quantum memory, but many leading constructions are naturally defined on periodic lattices, whereas scalable quantum hardware favors planar architectures with open boundaries. In this work, we develop a general operator-algebraic framework and computational algorithms for constructing all gapped boundaries and defects of two-dimensional topological Pauli stabilizer codes. Starting from a truncated bulk code, our method identifies boundary gauge operators, boundary anyons, and their string operators, and then constructs microscopic boundary Hamiltonians through anyon condensation and topological-order completion, thereby eliminating local logical operators near the boundary. We establish a one-to-one bulk-boundary correspondence between bulk anyons and excitations of the anomalous boundary subsystem code, enabling fusion rules, topological spins, and braiding statistics to be extracted directly from the boundary operator algebra. For translation-invariant codes, Laurent-polynomial representations reduce these tasks to finite matrix computations based on Hermite and Smith normal forms, enabling automated constructions for Z d qudits of both prime and composite dimension. We demonstrate the framework on toric, color, double-semion, six-semion, and anomalous three-fermion codes, and apply it to bivariate bicycle codes, revealing large logical dimensions and unusually long translation periods for anyon strings. By systematically converting bulk topological data into explicit boundary and defect Hamiltonians, our framework can serve as a foundation for constructing low-overhead planar qLDPC codes with open boundaries and for engineering fault-tolerant logical operations.

analysis.summary: 从 bulk stabilizers 的算符代数系统构造 gapped boundaries 与 defects。
analysis.problem: 周期边界上设计的拓扑码如何转为开放边界的可实现模型？
analysis.setting: 二维 topological Pauli stabilizer codes；素数及合数维 Z_d qudits。
main_results: 识别 boundary gauge/anyon/string operators，再用 condensation 与 completion 消除边界 local logical operators。
建立 bulk-boundary 对应；translation-invariant 情形用 Laurent polynomials 及 Hermite/Smith normal forms 化为有限矩阵任务。

papers.title: Efficiently Learning Global Quantum Channels with Local Tomography
authors: Zidu Liu and Dominik S. Wild
papers.abstract: Scalable characterization of quantum processors is crucial for mitigating noise and imperfections. While randomized measurement protocols enable efficient access to local observables, inferring a globally consistent description of multi-qubit processes remains challenging. Here we introduce a local-to-global reconstruction framework for one-dimensional multi-qubit states and channels. The method is efficient provided that correlations, as quantified by the conditional mutual information, decay exponentially. In particular, we prove that under this assumption, the required number of samples scales polynomially with the system size and the inverse of the desired global reconstruction error, which we quantify by the trace-norm distance between the true and the reconstructed Choi states. Our approach is based on combining local shadow tomography with locally optimal recovery maps obtained by convex optimization. We supplement these rigorous guarantees by studying the performance of the protocol numerically for a system evolving under a local Lindbladian and a noisy, shallow circuit. By employing a tensor network representation, we reconstruct channels acting on up to 50 qubits and accurately recover global diagnostics such as the process fidelity, the Choi state purity, and Pauli-weight-resolved process matrix elements. Our work thus extends the powerful toolbox of local shadow tomography to scalable channel characterization with access to global properties.

papers.title: Heisenberg-Limited Hamiltonian Learning Without Short-Time Control
authors: Myeongjin Shin, Junseo Lee, and Changhun Oh
papers.abstract: Characterizing quantum systems by learning their underlying Hamiltonians is a central task in quantum information science. While recent algorithmic advances have achieved near-optimal efficiency in this task, they critically rely on accessing arbitrarily short-time dynamics. This reliance poses severe experimental challenges due to finite control bandwidth and transient pulse errors. In this work, we demonstrate that Heisenberg-limited Hamiltonian learning can be achieved without short-time control. We introduce a framework in which every query to the unknown dynamics has duration at least a prescribed minimum time T , and show that this restriction does not preclude Heisenberg-limited scaling. The key ingredient is a method for emulating the continuous quantum control required by iterative learning algorithms using only such lower-bounded evolution times. This reduces the learning task to sparse pure-state tomography. Notably, for logarithmically sparse Hamiltonians, our algorithm achieves the information-theoretically optimal 1 / ε scaling in total evolution time for arbitrary constant minimum evolution time T . For many-body (polynomially sparse) systems, we uncover a rigorous quantitative tradeoff, showing that the minimum required evolution time can be significantly relaxed from the standard limit at a polynomial cost in total evolution time. Our results affirmatively resolve a prominent open problem in the field and reveal that high-bandwidth, ultra-short pulses are not fundamentally necessary for optimal quantum learning.

papers.title: Lifting: Quantum State Discrimination Framework for Mid-Circuit Measurements
papers.abstract: Quantum computing promises new capabilities beyond classical computation. Mid-circuit measurements (MCMs) enable error correction and outcome-dependent control, but their reliability is limited by noise on superconducting hardware. These operations depend on accurate quantum state discrimination (QSD), which assigns measured signals to state labels. Neural network-based (NN-based) QSD improves this assignment, yet its error remains bounded below by the Bayes risk of the available readout distributions. A complementary challenge is state deterioration as successive measurements accumulate and circuit execution advances, making static calibration less representative of the workload. We present Lifting, a QSD framework that addresses both challenges through repetition encoding, neural decoding, and in situ calibration. Encoding supplies joint in-phase and quadrature (I-Q) readout signals from the target and auxiliary qubits, while contextual calibration trains the decoder for the conditions encountered during execution. Our theoretical analysis shows that retaining additional channels from a fixed joint distribution cannot increase Bayes risk and establishes sufficient conditions for contraction of an overlap-based upper bound. Experiments across three IBM processors evaluate the framework on repeated stabilizer measurement, parity-check, and teleportation workloads.

analysis.summary: Lifting 把 mid-circuit measurement 的读出判别拆成信息不足与校准失配两个问题，通过 repetition encoding 增加观测通道，并按真实 workload 进行 in situ calibration。

papers.title: Local error correction prolongs time-crystalline memory
papers.abstract: Discrete time crystals are non-equilibrium phases of matter with spatiotemporal order and a response that breaks the time-translation symmetry of a periodic external drive. Interactions, spatial disorder and correlated random driving can in theory stabilize this order. In experiments, however, coupling to the environment limits the time crystal lifetime. Here we use stochastic local bit-flip error correction to prolong the time-crystalline response of a driven, spatially disordered two-dimensional Ising model on a superconducting quantum processor, using a repetition code with distances three and five on a honeycomb lattice with up to 68 physical qubits. Even though ancilla qubits, midcircuit syndrome measurements and decoding increase the required quantum and classical resources, the stochastic drive increases the memory decay time by a factor of up to two. At late times we observe that recovery stabilizes spatial order across the lattice. The spin-configuration distributions explain this separation, as recovery suppresses disagreeing bonds while broadening occupies completely reversed states. Syndrome measurements without correction accelerate the memory decay, demonstrating the importance of conditional correction. Our results show that local bit-flip error correction can preserve time-crystalline memory over more drive cycles than the bare dynamics.

papers.title: Tripartite Haar Random State Has No Bipartite Entanglement
authors: Zhi Li, Takato Mori, and Beni Yoshida
papers.abstract: We show that no Einstein-Podolsky-Rosen (EPR)–like bipartite entanglement can be distilled from a tripartite Haar random state | Ψ ⟩ A B C by local unitaries or local operations when each subsystem A , B , or C has fewer than half of the total qubits. Specifically, we derive an upper bound on the probability of sampling a state with EPR-like entanglement at a given EPR fidelity tolerance, showing a doubly exponential suppression in the number of qubits. Our proof relies on a simple volume argument supplemented by an ε -net argument and concentration of measure. Viewing | Ψ ⟩ A B C as a bipartite quantum error-correcting code C → A B , this implies that neither output subsystem A nor B supports any nontrivial logical operator. We also establish general constraints on the structure of tripartite entanglement in Haar random states, showing that W- or Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger–like entanglement cannot be distilled and that nontrivial global symmetries are absent. Finally, we discuss a physical interpretation in the AdS/CFT correspondence, indicating that a connected entanglement wedge does not necessarily imply bipartite entanglement, contrary to a previous belief.

papers.title: Scalable long-distance quantum fan-out gates with reduced resource overhead
papers.abstract: Scalable long-distance quantum gates are essential for distributed quantum computation and scalable quantum networks. We propose an efficient scheme for implementing an $n$-qubit fan-out gate $C^n$ (also known as a controlled-NOT-$\cdots$-NOT gate) across spatially separated parties. Our protocol requires only a pre-shared $n$-qubit Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger state, $n$ local controlled-NOT (CNOT) gates, and feed-forward operations, thereby reducing both the CNOT and Hadamard gate counts by $(n-2)$ when compared with the standard decomposition-based approach. We further develop two optical architectures to implement the heralded and post-selected $n$-photon fan-out gates, respectively. These schemes require fewer single photons resources and achieve higher success probabilities than their decomposition-based counterparts, representing significant improvements. The results indicate that our approach is experimentally feasible and pave the way toward practical long-distance quantum computation.

analysis.summary: 借助预共享 GHZ state 和 feed-forward，实现分布式 fan-out，并降低相对逐门分解的局域 gate count。
analysis.problem: 远距离多目标控制操作如何在既定纠缠资源下减少局域操作开销？
analysis.setting: 空间分离的 n 方，预共享 n-qubit GHZ state，使用 n 个 local CNOT 和 feed-forward；另讨论光学 heralded 与 post-selected 实现。
main_results: 作者声称，相对指定 decomposition baseline，CNOT 与 Hadamard 数各减少 n−2。
两种光学方案减少单光子资源并提高成功概率，但摘要没有给出其随 n 的完整表达式。
techniques: 把预共享多方纠缠作为非局域资源，以局域 gates 和条件控制完成整体 fan-out。
assumptions: GHZ 分发被当作前置资源；光学 heralding 与 postselection 是不同成功模型，不能混为 deterministic implementation。
limitations: 仅阅读当前唯一的 v1 官方摘要，未核查正文假设和证明；没有把 GHZ 制备、通信延迟或重复尝试算成免费总成本。
页面另列 NJP reference，但本条仅分析排队的 arXiv v1，不声称已审阅正式版本。
本条分析仅依据论文摘要，未核查正文证明和摘要中未说明的假设。
relevance: 具体展示 entanglement、局域门数和 feed-forward 的资源转移，与测量辅助线路研究有直接方法联系。
follow_up: 读者建议：把纠缠分发与失败重试计入总资源，再与相同通信条件的 baseline 比较。

papers.title: Optimal Lower Bound on the Sample Complexity of Coherent Classical Shadows for Mixed States
papers.abstract: We study coherent classical shadows protocols for an unknown $d$-dimensional quantum state of rank at most $r$, allowing an arbitrary joint measurement on all available copies. For observables with operator norm at most one and centered squared Frobenius norm at most $F$, we study the minumum number of copies $T$ needed for the protocol to successed with propbability $1 - δ$. We prove a lower bound on $T$, that depends both on $δ$ and the number $M$ of post-measurement observables. Denoting $\ell=\max\{\log(2M),\log(1/δ)\}$, we show that $T=Ω\left(\min\left\{\frac{\sqrt{rF\ell}}{\varepsilon},\frac{(F\ell)^{2/3}}{\varepsilon^{4/3}}\right\}+\frac{\ell}{\varepsilon^2}\right)$ under the mild assumption $\log(2M)\lesssim d\min\{r,F\}$. The lower bound nearly matches the known upper bound and matches the conjectural strengthening of the known upper bound. The proof is inspired by the framework of the proof of the lower bound for Boolean Hidden Matching. We develop a Gaussian-lift noise kernel that transfers forward and reverse Gaussian hypercontractivity to the Grassmannian, allowing us to bound the distinguishing advantage in an auxiliary game with a revealed query observable. We use Schur--Weyl structure and posterior moment bounds to control arbitrary coherent measurements on the source side.

analysis.summary: 作者给出允许任意多副本 coherent POVM 的 classical shadows 下界，联合追踪 rank、observable Frobenius budget、精度、查询数和失败概率。一般参数下仍有一处对数 gap，不能把标题的 optimal 理解为全部上界已经匹配。
analysis.problem: 测量前未知将来要问哪些 observables，是 shadows 与为指定 observable 定制测量的关键区别。即便允许所有 copies 联合处理，预先压缩成 classical sketch 仍可能丢失与未来查询相关的信息；混态低秩 promise 如何改变这个壁垒此前缺少匹配的下界。
analysis.setting: 未知 d-dimensional state ρ，rank(ρ)≤r；对 ρ 的 T 份做任意 POVM，之后才给出 M 个 Hermitian observables O_i。要求同时以 additive error ε 估计全部 Tr(O_iρ)，成功概率至少 1−δ。约束为 operator norm≤1，且 centered squared Frobenius norm ||O_i−Tr(O_i)I/d||²_F≤F。
main_results: 令 ℓ=max{log(2M),log(1/δ)}。在 d≥2、1≤r≤d、1≤F≤d、δ≤1/3、足够小常数 ε，以及 log(2M)≤c_M d min{r,F} 下，作者证明 T=Ω(min{√(rFℓ)/ε,(Fℓ)^(2/3)/ε^(4/3)}+ℓ/ε²)。
下界包含 geometric term 和 precision term；随 r 增大，前者在 r≈(Fℓ/ε²)^(1/3) 后饱和。单 observable、constant confidence 的已知上界与其匹配。
一般 ℓ 的 saturated branch 仍与已知上界相差 ℓ^(1/3)；把该上界改善到匹配形式是作者的 conjecture，不是已证明算法。
techniques: 把 estimation 化为测量完成后才揭示相关 query 的 distinguishing game。source-side 用 Schur–Weyl 结构与 posterior moment bounds 限制任意 coherent measurement 获取的信息。
query-side 构造 Gaussian-lift kernel，将正向与反向 Gaussian hypercontractivity 转移到 Grassmannian，约束 sketch 与后揭示 observable 的相关性；再用信息论处理多 observable 的 hidden-location 问题。
assumptions: POVM 可依赖 d,r,F,M,ε,δ，但不能依赖未来 observable list；若提前知道查询，任务已经改变。
这是 worst-case copies 下界，不是 gate complexity、量子存储或单次实验深度的界。
limitations: 阅读范围为官方 HTML 的摘要、引言、模型、主结果与比较段落；后续技术证明及附录未逐项核验，公式排版也可能损失信息。
定量结论均按作者声称记录，不构成独立数学验证；超大 M 时 log M dependence 需按文中规则截断。
relevance: 直接回答 measurement order、coherent processing 与 classical information access 的资源问题，可作为受限测量或 data-hiding separation 的强测量 baseline。
follow_up: 读者建议：优先检验 source/query 分离能否适配 Clifford-restricted measurements，并保留原任务的 rank、observable norm 和成功概率约定。

papers.title: Nearly Optimal Quantum Sample Complexity of Learning Fourier-Sparse Boolean Functions
papers.abstract: We study the number of uniform quantum examples needed to exactly learn a Boolean function with at most $k$ nonzero Fourier coefficients. We give a learner with near-optimal $\widetilde{O}(k)$ sample complexity independent of the input length $n$. The learner uses only separate measurements of individual examples. This improves the previous $O(k^{3/2}\log^2 k)$ upper bound (Arunachalam, Chakraborty, Lee, Paraashar, and de Wolf, 2021). The main ingredient is a candidate set formed by symmetric differences of subsets from independent groups of Fourier samples. A multilinear majority polynomial combines unbiased random approximations into an accurate witness whose Fourier support lies in this set. Granularity then forces the set to contain the entire Fourier support, including subsets never directly sampled. For comparison, we derive the tight classical sample complexity $Θ(nk)$ by combining known sparse-recovery and lower-bound results.

analysis.summary: Fourier-sparse Boolean function 的 exact learning，可仅用逐份 quantum example 测量达到与输入长度无关的近线性样本量。
analysis.problem: 若 Fourier support 含极小系数，直接 Fourier sampling 可能漏掉它们；怎样不逐个等待所有 support 被观测到？
analysis.setting: n-bit Boolean function，至多 k 个非零 Fourier coefficients；访问 uniform quantum examples，目标为 exact learning。
main_results: 作者给出 Õ(k) quantum sample complexity，改进摘要所列 O(k^(3/2) log²k)；只需对各 example 分别测量。
给出 classical uniform-example 复杂度 Θ(nk) 的比较；独立于 n 指样本量，不代表输出描述长度或经典计算时间独立于 n。
techniques: 由独立组的 Fourier samples 的 subset symmetric differences 构造候选集；multilinear majority polynomial 形成 witness，再用 granularity 迫使候选包含未直接采到的 support。
assumptions: 稀疏 Boolean promise 与 uniform quantum-example access 是关键资源，不是从任意经典训练集获得同样优势。
limitations: 仅阅读官方摘要，未审阅定理假设和证明；Õ 中的对数、成功概率和计算时间需查正文。
本条分析仅依据论文摘要，未核查正文证明和摘要中未说明的假设。
relevance: 直接关联量子数据访问、单副本测量与学习样本优势，说明 coherent joint readout 并非所有学习优势的必要条件。
follow_up: 读者建议：核查 exactness 对极小 Fourier 系数的处理，并区分 sample、time 与 quantum-example 制备成本。

papers.title: From Syndromes to Computation: A General Framework for Logical Operations in Quantum Error-Correcting Codes
papers.abstract: Fault-tolerant quantum computation requires error-correcting codes that not only protect quantum information but also support useful logical operations with practical physical realizations. Here we develop a general framework in which the stabilizer syndromes of commuting Pauli rotations directly organize logical-gate design. We derive an exact codespace-preservation condition valid at arbitrary rotation angles, providing a common stabilizer-level description for CSS and non-CSS codes and for both Clifford and non-Clifford operations. A particularly useful equal-syndrome specialization reduces Clifford gate design to stabilizer factorization, yields a general generator weight bound of $\lceil d/2\rceil$ for distance-$d$ codes, and systematically extends to logical rotations higher in the Clifford hierarchy. Applied to bivariate-bicycle (BB) and non-CSS Mirror qLDPC codes, the framework gives explicit low-weight Clifford and controlled-phase gates. Our implementations yield new low-weight gates, including an addressed $T$ gate on the $[[16,4,4]]$ BB code, $T$-type rotations on the $[[64,8,8]]$ BB code, and CCZ-, CS-, and $T$-type operations on the $[[36,6,6]]$ Mirror code. We also develop analytic constructions using Clifford algebra bases, which turn the syndrome constraints into explicit algebraic relations and provide a systematic route to logical addressability. We use this approach to analytically construct addressed CNOT, SWAP, controlled, and CCZ-type gates on recursive hypercube codes. An independent construction on middle quantum Reed--Muller codes yields C${}^r$Z gates that saturate the equal-syndrome weight bound. These results establish stabilizer syndromes as a constructive link between the stabilizer structure of a quantum code, the logical computations it can directly support, and the fault-tolerance properties of their physical realizations.

analysis.summary: 用 commuting Pauli rotations 的 syndrome partition 组织 logical-gate 设计，统一 CSS、非 CSS 及 Clifford/non-Clifford 构造。重要的是 codespace preservation 的代数条件；低 rotation depth 并不自动等于物理容错。
analysis.problem: 仅依靠 transversal patterns 或 code automorphisms 会限制可找到的 logical gates。若允许同一码块内的 low-weight Pauli rotations，如何判断所有 rotations 组合后回到 codespace，并实现可寻址的非平凡 logical action？
analysis.setting: [[n,k,d]] stabilizer code，ansatz U=∏_j exp(i ε_j θ_j G_j)，其中 G_j 为两两对易的 Hermitian Pauli strings。用每个 G_j 与各 stabilizer check 的反对易关系定义 syndrome vector；这里 syndrome 用于 gate design，不是在宣称仅凭实验 syndrome 认证 gate fidelity。
main_results: 对每个 stabilizer check，只选与它反对易的 generators，把对应 rotation angles 加倍。这一 check-conditioned operation 在 codespace 上平凡，是作者一般 preservation 判据的核心。
若 generators 有共同非零 syndrome，在 π/4 angle 下可将判据化为含正确相位符号的 stabilizer factorization。非平凡 equal-syndrome ansatz 满足 w_max≥ceil(d/2)；这是下界，不是所有 code 都可达到的通用上界。
构造包括 BB [[16,4,4]] 上 addressed T，以及 BB [[64,8,8]] 和 Mirror [[36,6,6]] 上的高阶 logical operations；后两者不能一概解释为任意单 logical qubit 的 addressed T。
techniques: 把相同 syndrome 的 physical Pauli generators 分组，利用它们的乘积恢复零 syndrome 的 logical Pauli 或 stabilizer；π/4 时检查乘积和符号，较小角度还需 operator-valued cancellation。
用 Clifford algebra bases 将 syndrome 与 Pauli multiplication 转为显式代数关系；再通过 logical square/cube、equal-syndrome pairs 和 lifting 搜索更高 Clifford-hierarchy gates。
assumptions: Pauli rotation weight、相互支持重叠和 rotation layers 是模型资源；在 native one-/two-qubit gates 上实现高权重 rotation 的成本仍须另计。
权重下界源于至少一对 generators 的乘积代表非平凡 logical Pauli，其 weight 至少为 code distance。
limitations: 只审阅官方 HTML 的模型、equal-syndrome 推导和部分构造段落，未全面核验搜索目录、fault-propagation 分析及附录。
作者明确区分 codespace preservation 与 fault tolerance；disjoint support 和少层数只是有利结构，不能单凭它们推出完整 noisy gadget 的容错保证。
relevance: 直接连接 stabilizer 结构、logical primitive、depth 与非 Clifford 资源，适合构造固定 logical gadget 后再提出 fidelity certification 问题。
follow_up: 读者建议：选一个低权重构造，在固定 recovery 与物理噪声模型下分别统计 shots、max sequence length、rotation/native-gate calls 和 ancillas。

papers.title: A three-eighths upper bound on the stabilizer-rank exponent of face-center magic states
papers.abstract: We give an explicit construction proving that the exact stabilizer rank of $m$ copies of the qubit face-center magic state is $O(2^{3m/8})$. Two symmetry-related fifteen-term identities combine into a twenty-four-term decomposition at twelve copies. The balanced structure of this decomposition yields a substitution that adds eight copies at a cost of eight terms per existing term. The resulting bound $γ_T \leq 3/8$ improves the previously published exponent $\log_2(3)/4$.

analysis.summary: 通过明确的 stabilizer decomposition，把 face-center magic-state orbit 的 exact stabilizer-rank exponent 上界改善到 3/8。这里的 T-type 命名不是常见 equatorial T gate state，不能混用。
analysis.problem: 只找到一个较好的有限副本 decomposition 并不一定给出最好的渐近指数；需要可重复扩展而且每步增幅可控的 substitution。
analysis.setting: qubit Bloch vector 为 (1,1,1)/√3 的 face-center state；χ(|ψ⟩) 是用 complex coefficients 表示该 pure state 所需的最少 stabilizer summands 数，研究 m-copy exact rank 的渐近 exponent γ_T。
main_results: 作者声称，对 m=4+8j 构造 3·8^j 个 distinct nonzero stabilizer summands，得到 χ(|T⟩^⊗m)=O(2^(3m/8)) 与 γ_T≤3/8。
相较此前 log₂(3)/4≈0.39624，新的上界指数为 0.375；12-copy 24-term witness 单独 tensor repetition 只给约 0.38208，尚不是最终改善。
techniques: 把两个由字典对称性关联的 15-term identities 拼接，利用六个重合项合并为 12 physical copies 的 24-term witness。
关键在 witness 分成三个各八项且 suffix 不重叠的组，由此定义线性 substitution E，使一个 dictionary slot 替换为五个；每加八个 physical copies，terms 乘八，驱动渐近递推。
assumptions: 讨论 exact complex stabilizer rank，不是 approximate rank、stabilizer extent 或带噪态成本；该 face-center orbit 与 equatorial T-state orbit 必须区分。
limitations: 已读官方 HTML 的定义、构造与递推片段；未逐项独立核对全部坐标恒等式或附录 witness。
结果是显式构造的上界，不是 rank 的匹配下界，也不证明所得 decomposition 最优；实际模拟总耗时仍含求和与采样等成本。
relevance: 给出 magic 资源与 classical simulation 表示成本的定量连接，也示范有限块恒等式如何产生更强的渐近资源界。
follow_up: 读者建议：检查相同 substitution 是否改善带误差容忍的任务，而不要直接把 exact-rank exponent 当作 T-count lower bound。

papers.title: Error-Corrected QRAM Queries with One-Fault-Tolerant \texttt{CSWAP} Gates
papers.abstract: Quantum random-access memory (QRAM) enables coherent queries to classical data. However, the \(O(N)\) qubits required for a memory with \(N=2^n\) addresses make QRAM appear vulnerable to noise. Though bucket-brigade routing provides intrinsic noise resilience to reduce the error in QRAM, improving the fidelity of QRAM queries is still an important and challenging problem. We introduce a low-overhead protection framework for bucket-brigade QRAM with two complementary components. First, we propose a one-fault-tolerant repeat-until-success logical controlled-SWAP gate using the \([[4,2,2]]\) code under erasure noise channel. Interleaved erasure checks and local recovery correct every single erasure, so the leading logical failure probability is second order in the physical erasure error rates. Second, we exploit validity constraints of bucket-brigade routing to define local parity checks directly on the router states, without adding extra data qubits to create code redundancy. Under bit-flip noise, minimum-weight perfect matching with noiseless syndrome measurements corrects single interior faults, while open spatial boundaries retain a first-order contribution in the residual bit-flip rate. Monte Carlo simulations confirm quadratic suppression for the protected controlled-SWAP and improved depth scaling for decoded QRAM router-state snapshots. The two codes admit a concatenated realization in which the inner code supplies erasure protection and the outer code optionally corrects interior logical bit flips. Together, these results show how routing constraints and a protected non-Clifford routing gate can improve QRAM reliability under biased and erasure-dominant noise.

analysis.summary: 利用 erasure-aware logical CSWAP 和路由合法性约束保护 bucket-brigade QRAM；内部单 fault 可纠正，但边界仍留下线性误差项。
analysis.problem: QRAM 含 O(N) 个 qubits、N=2^n 个地址；如何保护路由而不简单添加大规模冗余？
analysis.setting: [[4,2,2]] code 上的 repeat-until-success controlled-SWAP 对付 erasure；router-state parity checks 对付 bit flips，后者假定 noiseless syndrome measurements。
main_results: 交错 erasure checks 与 local recovery 纠正每个 single erasure，使 protected CSWAP 的 leading failure 为物理 erasure rate 的二阶。
利用路由约束构造 checks，不为路由 code redundancy 另加 data qubits；MWPM 纠正内部单 fault，但 open boundaries 保留一阶 residual bit-flip contribution。
techniques: 将内层 erasure protection 与可选的外层 router bit-flip correction 组合，并用 Monte Carlo 检查门与 snapshots 的误差标度。
assumptions: erasure 可识别、特定 biased-noise 模型以及 noiseless syndromes 限定结论。
limitations: 仅阅读官方摘要，未核查正文假设和证明；局部门二阶抑制不能等同于整个 QRAM query 的二阶容错。
本条分析仅依据论文摘要，未核查正文证明和摘要中未说明的假设。
relevance: 展示固定 routing gadget 中噪声假设、syndrome access 和 logical error 的细致关系。
follow_up: 读者建议：在 noisy syndrome 与开放边界下重算完整 query error，同时计入 repeat-until-success 的 target calls。

papers.title: Cyclotomic Structure and Exact Recurrences in Floquet Many-Body Quantum Dynamics
papers.abstract: Periodically driven quantum systems exhibit a wide range of complex dynamics, including chaos. Yet, at special parameter values, their evolution can recur exactly. Several quantum protocols have recently been proposed that exploit exact Floquet recurrences to demonstrate genuine quantum advantage. Such recurrences can be studied through the arithmetic structure of the Floquet unitary. In this work, we establish a necessary and sufficient arithmetic criterion for exact recurrence and determine the minimal recurrence period when one exists. Because recurrence is a global property of the unitary, it holds for every initial state. Applying our framework requires only knowledge of the number field associated with the Hamiltonian parameters. We demonstrate the method using the kicked Ising chain, establishing exact recurrences in both Clifford and non-Clifford regimes. We further show that, in the recurrent non-Clifford regime, magic--a resource for quantum computation--is generated at intermediate times and undergoes exact periodic revivals enforced by the recurrence of the full Floquet unitary. By connecting number theory, quantum many-body dynamics, and quantum information, our work shows that exact recurrence extends beyond Clifford circuits and opens new avenues for magic generation and quantum hardware benchmarking.

analysis.summary: 用 Floquet unitary 的算术结构刻画 exact recurrence，并在 non-Clifford 动力学中展示 magic 的生成与周期性回归。
analysis.problem: 精确回归是否只是 Clifford 可模拟点的特殊现象，还是能由更普遍的数论条件控制？
analysis.setting: 周期驱动多体系统；输入为 Hamiltonian 参数对应的 number field，以 kicked Ising chain 的 Clifford 与 non-Clifford regime 为实例。
main_results: 作者声称给出 exact recurrence 的充要算术条件及存在时的最小周期；因结论针对整体 unitary，对每个初态成立。
non-Clifford recurrent regime 中，magic 可在中间时刻产生，并随整体 recurrence 精确复现。
techniques: 把 Floquet 频谱的 recurrence 问题转为 cyclotomic/number-field 结构，而不只跟踪单个初态的动力学。
assumptions: 精确参数和严格 recurrence，与带噪硬件中的近似 revival 不是同一命题。
limitations: 仅阅读官方摘要，未审阅算术条件、定理假设和证明；摘要未给周期、精度稳定性或 benchmarking 的 shot complexity。
本条分析仅依据论文摘要，未核查正文证明和摘要中未说明的假设。
relevance: 连接 magic 与非 Clifford 动力学，并提供无需把目标编译成 Clifford 的结构化测试思路；目前还不是 SPAM-robust 认证协议。
follow_up: 读者建议：研究参数扰动下 revival 的稳定性，以及序列长度与物理误差的可辨识关系。

papers.title: Photon-stimulated decay of $χ$-matched ancillas causes unheralded bit flips in bosonic codes
papers.abstract: Bosonic codes often read out their syndrome with a transmon ancilla whose computational levels $g$ and $f$ have equal parity and matched dispersive shifts: a decay $f\to e$ is then heralded and leaves the code intact, while the direct $f\to g$ is forbidden by parity. We show that the photons of the code open this decay at first order in the ancilla's decay rate. Dressing by the code mode lets the charge noise that limits the ancilla's $T_1$ drive a photon-stimulated Raman decay $|f,n\rangle\to|g,n+1\rangle$, at $(n+1)(χ_{ge}/2g_{01})^2$ times the $f\to e$ rate for a smooth noise spectrum. When the matching is set by the detuning, the decay costs $\approxΓ_{fe}/α$ per gate and photon, whatever the coupling strength; a deliberate mismatch or matching by a drive lowers this cost, and a qubit ancilla has no such channel. The opened decay is unheralded and flips a cat with probability $\approx 1/2$; being first order, it overtakes the second-order double decay $f\to e\to g$ as the ancilla improves. In a microscopic model of the Ocelot repetition cat code, it makes the bit-flip floor of the gates grow linearly with the cat size, by a factor 1.2-1.7 from four to ten photons, which would limit the noise bias to $\sim 10^3$. The published gate data end at four photons and do not yet test this growth.

analysis.summary: bosonic syndrome ancilla 的理想 parity selection rule 在与 code photons 的 dressing 下可能失效，产生未被 herald 的一阶 bit flips。
analysis.problem: χ-matched transmon ancilla 常把 f→e decay 设计为可识别且不伤 code；改进 ancilla T1 后是否仍存在被忽略的 leading error？
analysis.setting: g、f levels 具有相同 parity 与 matched dispersive shifts 的 bosonic code readout；平滑 charge-noise spectrum 下考察 photon-stimulated Raman decay。
main_results: 作者给出的 |f,n⟩→|g,n+1⟩ rate 为 (n+1)(χ_ge/(2g_01))² 倍的 f→e rate，因而对 ancilla decay rate 是一阶。
该 unheralded channel 以约 1/2 概率翻转 cat；模型预测四到十 photons 时 gate bit-flip floor 增长约 1.2–1.7 倍，noise bias 可能受限在约 10³。
techniques: 从 code-mode dressing 推导噪声诱导跃迁，并与二阶 f→e→g double-decay 通道及 microscopic repetition-cat 模型比较。
assumptions: 具体 ancilla levels、matching 方式和噪声谱很重要；失谐设置 matching 与 drive-assisted matching 不可混同。
limitations: 仅阅读官方摘要，未核查 microscopic 模型、推导和定理假设；作者明确指出既有数据止于四 photons，尚未检验所预测的增长。
本条分析仅依据论文摘要，未核查正文证明和摘要中未说明的假设。
relevance: 提供 syndrome 中不可见错误的物理机制，可用于检验仅凭 syndrome 估计 logical fidelity 所需的噪声假设。
follow_up: 读者建议：比较不同 cat size 的 logical-output 数据，检验 syndrome-only 模型能否识别这一 unheralded channel。

papers.title: Exponential advantage in continuous-variable quantum state learning
papers.abstract: We study how entangled measurements, reflected states, and input-state classicality determine the sample complexity of learning bosonic continuous-variable quantum states through their characteristic function. We first analyze a simple entanglement-free protocol and show that its sample complexity is exponential in the number of modes n for general inputs. We then prove that this exponential scaling is intrinsic through three complementary lower bounds: one excluding entangled measurements, one for reflection-symmetric inputs, and one excluding reflected states even when entangled measurements on finitely many copies are allowed. Next, we show that the classicality parameter s max quantitatively determines when this barrier can be softened: positive classicality can reduce the entanglement-free sample cost, and for fully classical states heterodyne learning matches the ϵ -scaling of a Bell-measurement (BM) scheme. Finally, combining reflected states with a two-copy entangled measurement yields sample complexity independent of n . These results identify when entanglement-free strategies already suffice and when, within the resource models analyzed here, efficient continuous-variable state learning requires the full BM resource combination of entangled measurements and reflected-state access.

analysis.summary: 这篇工作把连续变量态学习的优势拆成三个可区分的资源：跨副本纠缠测量、反射态访问，以及输入态的经典性。关键结果是，特定学习任务中，单副本测量即使自适应也有模式数的指数样本壁垒，而两副本 Bell 测量加反射态可去掉模式数依赖。不过这里学习的是特征函数，允许逐点正负号不确定性，不能直接理解为完整态层析。
analysis.problem: 在无限维玻色系统中，量子学习的样本优势究竟来自纠缠测量、额外态访问，还是输入的非经典性？只给出一个高效协议还不足以回答，需要把这些资源分别拿走并证明相应下界。
analysis.setting: 目标是 n 模未知态的位移特征函数 χρ(α)。所有测量结束后才给出查询 α，范围为 |α|²≤κn；对每个查询，以至少 1−δ 的概率输出加性 ε 近似，允许逐点 ± 号。分别比较单副本自适应测量、至多 K 副本的联合测量，以及是否提供与原态对应的反射态。
main_results: 一般输入下，禁止跨副本纠缠测量导致指数样本复杂度；即使允许反射副本与完全自适应策略，下界仍成立。作者还针对反射对称输入建立独立下界，排除分离仅由额外反射态假设造成的解释。
缺少反射态时，联合测量也未必有效：正文定理的范围为 n≥8、ε<0.245、K≤0.22/ε、κ≥1/0.99，在这个模型内样本仍指数增长。该结论没有覆盖任意多副本联合测量。
两副本 Bell 测量结合反射态的样本成本为 O(ε⁻⁴ log(1/δ))，与 n 无关。完全经典的输入也能通过 heterodyne 测量达到相同 ε 阶数，说明量子资源的优势依赖输入承诺。
techniques: heterodyne 的逆 Fourier 估计要乘上 exp(|α|²/2)，这会放大统计噪声。Bell 测量则通过线性光学与 homodyne 读出，直接构造 χρ(α)² 的无偏估计量，再转成允许正负号的 χρ 近似。
下界把学习归约为随机隐藏查询的假设检验：构造特征函数含三峰或五峰的态族，测量结束后揭示查询位置，再上界任意受限自适应策略的输出分布距离。
经典性参数 smax 用 s-ordered 准概率非负性定义。正经典性给出特征函数的 Gaussian 尾界，较大查询可直接输出零，从而缩小实际需要估计的区域。
assumptions: 反射态是学习模型中另行授予的资源，相关反射变换已知；复杂度没有计入为任意未知输入制造反射副本的成本。
学习保证针对测量后到来的查询，并允许符号歧义；它不同于预先已知单个可观测量的估计，也不承诺同时对连续域全部查询成立的统一误差。
limitations: Bell 数据仅确定 χρ²，逐点符号尚未恢复；因此不能直接推出符号敏感的保真度估计或完整 Wigner 重构。
ε⁻⁴ 上界与一般 ε⁻² 下界还存在精度差距；反射态获取、实验噪声及任意大联合测量的资源代价需要另作分析。
依据为出版社公开的 Article in Press／已接受稿 PDF，正文读取截取前 60000 字符；补充材料和完整证明未核查，最终版本可能继续编辑。
relevance: 直接关联量子数据学习、测量访问与样本复杂度下界。查询在测量后到达的设定也提供了研究经典侧信息时序与受限测量分离的具体连续变量例子。
follow_up: 能否在相同测量后查询模型中以少量额外资源恢复符号，并保留 n 无关的样本成本？
将反射态制备与存储计入总成本后，资源分离是否仍然成立；单副本随机测量能否利用结构承诺降低成本？
publication_significance: 以下为依据论文结果的学术判断，不是对编辑或审稿人实际决定的解释。
新意在于把“量子学习更快”变成资源可分辨的结论：分别证明纠缠测量与反射态的作用，并给出经典性控制的例外；上下界共同支撑一个明确的操作图景。
技术难点是无限维态空间和自适应读出。可实现的线性光学上界与专门构造的假设检验下界相结合，使论证超出单一协议的数值改进，符合 npj Quantum Information 的量子信息研究定位。
可发表价值应理解为特定学习任务的资源分离；符号歧义及反射访问假设限制了更广泛的层析或实验优势主张。

papers.title: Continuous-time noise mitigation in analogue quantum simulation
papers.abstract: Analogue quantum simulators offer a promising route to explore quantum many-body dynamics beyond classical reach in the near term. However, their vulnerability to noise limits the accuracy of simulations. Here, we establish a continuous-time framework for mitigating noise in analogue quantum simulation. Our protocol fully preserves the continuous-time nature by avoiding any active control or measurement of the system during the dynamics, while achieving exact noise cancellation. This requires a small number of ancillary qubits, whose interaction with the system, combined with classical post-processing of joint measurement data, is tailored to cancel the effect of noise. Furthermore, the protocol is Hamiltonian-independent and robust to realistic ancilla noise. This work points to a promising direction for achieving high-fidelity analogue quantum simulation in the presence of noise.

analysis.summary: 作者提出原生连续时间的误差缓解方法：增加辅助比特并工程化系统—辅助的联合耗散，把理想演化保存在联合态的非对角块中，最后通过联合测量和经典重标定恢复无噪声可观测量期望值。方案无需中途脉冲或测量，且不依赖目标 Hamiltonian；代价是噪声模型与耗散控制要求，以及通常随时间和系统大小指数增长的采样开销。
analysis.problem: 模拟量子动力学时，Hamiltonian 与耗散一般不对易，不能简单在演化前后套一个逆噪声通道。数字式误差缓解又会引入离散化或中途控制，问题是能否保持连续演化并精确消除期望值中的噪声偏差。
analysis.setting: 有限维系统按 Lindblad 方程演化，目标是恢复任意系统可观测量 A 的理想期望值。主构造在初始时加入 |+⟩ 辅助比特，持续运行额外联合 dissipators，末态测量 A⊗σx，再作经典处理。原则上一个辅助比特足够，但它必须能与所需系统部分耦合。
main_results: 联合态的非对角块满足理想 Hamiltonian 演化加标量衰减：W01(t)=exp(−2at)U(t)ρ(0)U(t)†/2。因此 exp(2at)⟨A⊗σx⟩ 恢复目标期望值，a 由噪声算符的 ∑k Lk†Lk 决定。
在所需联合耗散实现正确时，构造适用于任意目标 Hamiltonian，也可推广到时间依赖情形。它恢复的是统计量，不是把系统的实际约化态变回理想态。
常见辅助比特 dephasing、amplitude damping 及 Pauli 噪声可并入额外重标定。数值例子包括 Heisenberg 模型磁化、淬火后的 Loschmidt echo，以及 Floquet 动力学的谱特征。
techniques: 直接加入负 dissipator 不构成物理过程；作者改用正的联合 Lindblad 项，其中包含 Lk⊗σz 和由 S=aI−∑kLk†Lk≥0 构造的补偿项。对角块可继续受噪声影响，而非对角块留下理想动力学。
末态辅助 σx 读出提取这两个非对角块，指数重标定取消标量衰减。也可用 A=I 的辅助信号估计衰减，形成期望值比值；有限采样的比值统计需另外处理。
当 ∑kLk†Lk 正比于 I，例如 Pauli jump operators，补偿项简化，联合噪声可通过随机 Hamiltonian 集成；更一般情形需要耗散工程与额外快衰减辅助系统。
assumptions: 主精确结论采用 Markovian Lindblad 模型，要求已学习或物理建模的主要 jump operators，并能正确实现对应联合耗散。Hamiltonian-independent 不等于无需噪声表征。
辅助噪声的鲁棒性针对正文分析的噪声类型与重标定；未知或失配的噪声仍可造成残余偏差，不能直接理解为任意噪声或 SPAM 鲁棒认证。
limitations: 精确去偏会放大方差。正文给出通常的采样开销约 exp(4at)，达到加性 ε 精度的 shots 随 exp(4at)log(2/δ)/ε² 增长；局域噪声的朴素全局方案也会随系统大小指数增长。
单辅助比特虽省数量，却可能需要广泛连接及多体耗散。多辅助方案与局域／分块观测可降低开销，但不能将其理解为任意任务的普遍低成本保证。
依据为出版社公开的 Article in Press／已接受稿 PDF，读取前 60000 字符；未核查补充材料，实验可实现性讨论也不等于真实设备的验证。
relevance: 联系噪声表征、benchmarking 与可靠量子模拟：已学习噪声信息被转换为精度保证。特别值得比较所需控制、辅助比特、shots 与残余偏差，而非只看形式上的噪声抵消。
follow_up: 针对局域观测与可实现联合耗散，能否证明更紧的采样成本，并明确何时优于数字式误差缓解？
能否把噪声表征误差和非重复 SPAM 误差纳入总精度界，避免指数重标定把小校准误差放大？
publication_significance: 以下为基于论文内容的解释性判断，不代表已知的编辑或审稿意见。
主要概念贡献是把非物理的逆耗散嵌入物理联合动力学的非对角块，让原生连续时间模拟获得精确的期望值去偏；它回答了非对易动力学下的具体障碍。
意义超出单个量子算法：方案衔接开放系统、耗散工程与多体动力学观测，并展示对几类物理信号的恢复，因此具有 Nature Communications 所重视的跨领域物理联系。
发表价值主要来自框架与控制思路，而非宣称误差缓解变成廉价的容错计算。指数采样开销、噪声知识和工程条件仍是实际适用范围的核心限制。

papers.title: Scalable Exact Non-Pauli Noise Simulation for Fault-Tolerant Quantum Circuits
papers.abstract: Fault-tolerant quantum design relies on simulating noisy quantum error correction (QEC) circuits with hundreds to thousands of physical qubits and large circuit depths. High-throughput stabilizer simulators, such as Stim, are the de facto tools for this regime. However, these simulators typically support only Clifford gates and stochastic Pauli noise. As a result, more realistic device noise models-such as coherent control errors and thermal relaxation-are often approximated using Pauli Twirling. This replacement offers speed but can introduce inaccuracies. To address this, we propose QuasiStim for scalable exact QEC simulation of realistic noise, with QuasiFold as a compiler frontend and DeltaFrame as a sampling backend. QuasiFold lowers sampling overhead by merging equivalent non-Pauli sites in the quantum circuit. DeltaFrame samples the resulting stabilizer trajectories by reusing precomputed predicted references instead of resimulating the full tableau for each shot. QuasiFold can reduce the number of shots by over $100\times$ on bivariate-bicycle (BB) codes. Compared to a per-shot tableau simulator, DeltaFrame is $166\times$--$1331\times$ faster on rotated surface-code memory under coherent $R_Z$ noise as $d$ grows from 5 to 35. QuasiStim also makes the PTA bias measurable: the gap is non-negligible and varies with noise strength, decoder, and circuit schedule. QuasiStim will be open-sourced upon publication at https://github.com/isaachyw/QuasiStim

analysis.summary: QuasiStim 的价值不仅是加速模拟，还在于直接比较 specified non-Pauli noise 与 Pauli-twirling approximation 对 logical error 的不同预测。
analysis.problem: 把 coherent error 或 thermal relaxation 换成 stochastic Pauli channel 可方便 stabilizer simulation，却可能改变被评估的物理问题。
analysis.setting: 以大量 Clifford QEC operations 夹杂 weak non-Pauli noise sites 为主要对象，借 quasiprobability trajectories 估计 decoded logical error；成本是 classical simulation shots，不是硬件 certification 的测量 shots。
main_results: 作者报告 QuasiFold 在 BB-code 实例中将 shot overhead 降低超过 100 倍；DeltaFrame 相对逐 shot tableau baseline，在 distance 5–35 的 coherent-RZ surface-code memory 中加速 166–1331 倍。
PTA 与原噪声的 logical-error gap 随 decoder、noise strength 和 circuit schedule 改变；性能增益不是所有电路上统一常数。
techniques: QuasiFold 合并可等效传播的 non-Pauli sites，降低 quasiprobability one-norm；DeltaFrame 预计算并复用 reference trajectories。
assumptions: 需要给定物理 noise channel 与 decoder，不是从 syndrome 自动推知真实 channel。
limitations: 阅读官方 HTML 的摘要、引言及 limitations 片段，未核验全部算法和误差分析；DeltaFrame 仍有 reference mispredictions。
高 non-Clifford volume 下 Γ² sampling overhead 仍可不可承受，leakage/loss 不在范围内；exact 表示原 channel 不等于有限样本零误差。
relevance: 收录依据是 PTA 的物理模型偏差与 logical fidelity 的联系，而非一般模拟器 benchmark。
follow_up: 读者建议：用其构造相同或接近 syndrome 统计、但 logical error 不同的 noise-model 对照。

papers.title: Quantum simultaneous decoding via pretty-good measurements of tilted states
papers.abstract: A multiple-access channel transmits messages from several senders to one receiver. For quantum outputs, the receiver must distinguish states depending on all messages, while tests for different decoding errors may not commute. In this paper, we give a self-contained account of simultaneous decoding, in which one joint measurement recovers the messages at the established achievable rates using independent codebooks. The proof combines Sen's tilted-subspace method with Cheng's analysis of the pretty-good measurement, a standard measurement for distinguishing quantum states. Auxiliary labels close to a common reference state separate the geometric directions associated with different errors. A Gram-matrix bound then allows separately chosen binary tests to certify the performance of one measurement. The labels are removed from the completed decoder, leading to a deterministic packing theorem that applies to finite state ensembles, including unequal priors. We develop the two-sender case first, with worked examples and figures, before treating any fixed number of senders. Sharper finite-error guarantees for the same decoder are developed separately, with sharp bounds for two specified steps of the analysis rather than a claim of globally optimal decoding. Applications recover known achievable rates for unassisted and entanglement-assisted classical communication, distributed classical compression with quantum side information, and coherent-state communication through a beamsplitter or passive multiport device. The common proof makes the geometric mechanism and its quantitative consequences available without repeating the construction for each application.

analysis.summary: 以 tilted subspaces 与 pretty-good measurement 统一 quantum simultaneous decoding 的证明；主要价值是把不对易的多种 error tests 组合成同一 decoder，而非宣布新的普遍最优通信率。
analysis.problem: 多发送者输出 quantum states 时，不同 decoding-error hypotheses 的最优 tests 未必对易，分别控制它们不自动产生一个共同 measurement。
analysis.setting: 独立 codebooks 的 multiple-access communication；先处理 two senders，再扩展任意固定发送者数，允许 finite ensembles 和 unequal priors。
main_results: 作者给出 deterministic packing theorem，并恢复无辅助/entanglement-assisted communication、quantum-side-information compression 等已知 achievable rates。
对两处分析步骤给出 sharp finite-error bounds，但摘要明确不主张 globally optimal decoding。
techniques: 辅助 labels 接近共同 reference，几何上分离不同 errors；通过 Gram-matrix bound 与 PGM 汇合 binary tests，完成后移除 labels。
assumptions: 发送者数固定、codebooks 独立；量子输出的 joint measurement 是允许资源。
limitations: 仅阅读官方摘要，未审阅 theorem 假设、证明或 rate/error 表达式；不能据此声称优于既有容量界。
本条分析仅依据论文摘要，未核查正文证明和摘要中未说明的假设。
relevance: tilting 与 PGM 是 state-discrimination 的具体工具，可能帮助统一多个受限信息访问的判别条件。
follow_up: 读者建议：先检验所需 auxiliary labels 与 joint measurement 是否可在目标实验访问模型中实现。

papers.title: Avoiding Defects within Heavy-Hexagon Architecture
papers.abstract: When implementing scalable fault-tolerant quantum computing using superconducting quantum processors, one of the critical challenges to overcome is the presence of defective qubits arising from fabrication and calibration imperfections. A defect on a specific qubit severely restricts the connectivity between adjacent qubits, disrupts stabilizer measurements, induces frequent detection events, and consequently inflates the logical error rate. To mitigate this issue, various strategies have been proposed, such as syndrome extraction circuits based on stabilizer folding and the construction of super-stabilizers via gauge operators. However, these methods have primarily been developed for architectures with relatively high connectivity of 3 to 4. Furthermore, experimental demonstrations showing an actual reduction in logical error rates in the presence of physical hardware defects have been lacking. In this work, we propose a defect-avoidance scheme tailored for the heavy-hexagon architecture, which features a lower connectivity of 2 to 3. While previous approaches required four measurement cycles to measure all gauge operators comprising a super-stabilizer, our proposed scheme completes all gauge measurements within only two cycles. We experimentally validate this approach on IBM quantum hardware by identifying physical defects and implementing the defect-avoidance circuits. As a result, avoiding the defect yields an approximately 10\% reduction in the logical error rate per cycle for both logical $X$ and $Z$ errors. These findings demonstrate that defects in superconducting hardware can be successfully handled even under the constrained connectivity of heavy-hexagon lattices, and that defect avoidance substantially reduces logical errors on real quantum hardware.

analysis.summary: 将 defect avoidance 适配到较低连接度的 heavy-hexagon 架构，通过更短的 gauge-measurement schedule 改善实际 logical error。
analysis.problem: 坏 qubit 会打断 stabilizer extraction；高连接度架构的 super-stabilizer 方法不一定能直接移植到 heavy-hexagon。
analysis.setting: 连接度 2–3 的 heavy-hexagon lattice，在 IBM hardware 上识别 defects 并运行规避电路。
main_results: 作者报告完成 super-stabilizer 所有 gauge measurements 从四个 measurement cycles 降到两个。
实验中 logical X 和 Z 的 per-cycle error 各降低约 10%；这是相对改善，不是 error rate 减少十个百分点。
techniques: 在受限连接图上重排 gauge-operator measurement，构造绕开 defect 的 syndrome-extraction circuit。
assumptions: 需要识别具体 defective qubits，并针对固定 code/gauge schedule 比较。
limitations: 仅阅读官方摘要，未审阅噪声模型、统计误差和正文证明；per-cycle 比较不能直接等同于相同 wall-clock time 的优势。
本条分析仅依据论文摘要，未核查正文证明和摘要中未说明的假设。
relevance: 提供 syndrome gadget 的明确时间资源与 logical error tradeoff，可作为 logical benchmarking 的现实实例。
follow_up: 读者建议：比较相同总时间、相同 shots 下的 logical survival，并报告 decoder 与 drift 的影响。

papers.title: Clifford Invariants and Three-Copy Quantum Tests
papers.abstract: We give an explicit treatment of the third tensor power of the Clifford representation on $n$ qutrits, for $n\geq2$. This representation has five pairwise inequivalent irreducible constituents, with multiplicities $1,1,1,1,2$. The decomposition reduces the Clifford twirl of a tensor cube to four real parameters. Two of them are spectral moments of the input. The other two are cubic invariants expressed as sums of cubes of the Weyl characteristic function and the discrete Wigner function. On trace-one Hermitian matrices, the invariant polynomials of degree at most three are spanned by the constant function and four algebraically independent functions. These functions do not separate Clifford orbits. For pure inputs a single parameter suffices. We recover its range and the characterization of its maximum by stabilizer states. We bound the stabilizer fidelity, determine full separability across the three copies in the symmetric family, and recover the criterion for a complex projective $3$-design. We classify the jointly invariant quantum Boolean functions. For stabilizer testing and for testing unknown observables we give explicit bounds on copies and queries. We also give character formulas for the finite projective Clifford groups and record the complete character table for two qutrits.

analysis.summary: 显式的 qutrit Clifford 三副本表示分解，将低阶不变量转成可观测统计，并揭示少副本 batch 并不自动意味着总样本复杂度低。
analysis.problem: twirl 保留什么信息、这些信息是否足以做 stabilizer testing，以及代数刻画与有效检验之间差多少？
analysis.setting: n≥2 个 qutrits，第三 tensor power 的 Clifford action；共同 Clifford 与 copy-permutation invariance 下的 sector measurements。不是 qubit Clifford 3-design 的直接重述。
main_results: 分解含五个 inequivalent irreducibles，multiplicities 为 1,1,1,1,2；ρ^⊗3 的 twirl 可由四个 real parameters 描述，其中两个为 spectral moments，另两个来自 Weyl/Wigner cubic invariants。
这些不变量不分离全部 Clifford orbits；pure-input 情形可用一个参数。文中部分 pure-state range 与 projective 3-design 条件是对既有结果的恢复。
对独立三副本 batches、每个保留 outcome effect 均 Clifford invariant 的检验，作者得到 N=Ω(3^n log(1/δ)) 的必要 batch 数；不能把此限制外推到全部 measurements 或更多副本联合操作。
techniques: 显式 projectors 与 intertwiner 把 representation decomposition 转成 sector measurement；以 rare sector 的概率区分 stabilizer 与 promised alternative。
assumptions: 上述 testing 下界采用 pure-state promise、独立 batches 和 invariant retained effects；副本数等于每 batch 三份乘 batch 数。
limitations: 阅读官方 HTML 的引言、表示概述与 testing 段落；未核查完整 character tables、证明及所有访问模型。
作者给出的一个 q 参数估计上界自身也标明非最优；不把代数独立性视为完整 tomography。
relevance: 直接连接 group twirling、低阶 designs、magic 与 measurement restrictions，可用于区分 moment identifiability 和统计可认证性。
follow_up: 读者建议：对照四副本或 non-invariant readout，确认复杂度改善究竟来自 batch size 还是允许测量集合。

papers.title: Exponential Quantum Advantage in Stationary Signal Sensing
papers.abstract: Sensing time-varying signals is essential for precision measurement and for characterizing fluctuations in physical systems. In this work, we show that quantum entanglement provides an exponential advantage in the acquisition time required to learn the temporal statistics of a stationary classical signal. The task is to estimate the characteristic function of joint displacements on selected bosonic modes within a fixed-duration window, using continuous measurements of one signal realization. We present an entanglement-assisted scheme based on two-mode squeezed probes and local Bell measurements with protected idlers, and bound its acquisition time accounting for readout noise and correlations between signal windows. For a strictly stationary pulse family, it achieves polynomial acquisition time at inverse-polynomial accuracy with logarithmic squeezing and polynomial photon number. On the other hand, we prove that any local idler-free protocols require acquisition time exponential in the number of selected temporal modes per window. This lower bound holds for both sequentially prepared and arbitrarily temporally entangled probes, allowing non-Gaussian inputs and measurements and causal classical feedback, as long as each output is measured destructively within its time bin. These results establish an exponential quantum learning advantage for a single continuously monitored stationary signal, with the sensing cost measured by total acquisition time.

analysis.summary: 对单次连续观测的 stationary signal，以总 acquisition time 而非独立样本数建立指数优势，资源关键是 protected idler 与 Bell readout。
analysis.problem: i.i.d. displacement learning 的样本优势不自动转为现实观测时间优势：窗口相关、空等待时间及不允许 reset 都必须算入成本。
analysis.setting: 线性 bosonic sensor 将 classical signal 编码为 temporal-mode displacements。固定 window T=nτ_B，从同一连续 record 估计其 characteristic function；每个固定 query 满足 |β|²≤κn。
main_results: Bell readout 产生 Y_j=X_j+Ξ_j，其中 independent Gaussian noise covariance 为 e^(−2r)。补偿 Fourier attenuation 后得到 unbiased estimator。
作者充分时间界为 T_tot=T ceil[(exp(2κn e^(−2r))+τ_dep/T)/(δ ε²)]；r=(log n)/2+O(1) 使 readout penalty 有界，每个 probe/idler 的 photon number 为 O(n)。
在共同严格 stationary pulse family 上，无 protected idler、每个 time bin destructive readout 的协议需 exponential acquisition time；即使 probes 可跨时间纠缠且有 causal feedback，也仍受该限制。
techniques: 将总 variance 分为单窗 readout 项与跨窗 covariance，用 summable mixing coefficient 控制后者，再构造相同 signal family 的资源受限 lower bound。
assumptions: 上界要求 dependence time、精度逆数及相关时间尺度可多项式控制；严格 stationarity 本身不足以保证快速学习。
limitations: 只阅读官方 HTML 的动机、模型、estimator 与时间界片段，未逐项验证后续 lower-bound proof 和附录。
保证为每个固定 query，不等于无代价地同时学习整个 continuum；protected idler、squeezing energy 和局部破坏性读出限制都属于比较模型。
relevance: 直接关联量子数据学习、信息存取时序和受限 measurement 的 exponential separation，同时把 sample resource 转成物理观测时间。
follow_up: 读者建议：固定 loss 与 idler storage noise 后，检查指数 separation 能保留到什么 n 和 query resolution。

papers.title: Bicycle Race: small two-block codes on the Pareto frontier
papers.abstract: Two-block group-algebra codes are among the simplest quantum LDPC codes, and many of them are translation invariant on a twisted torus, which suits neutral-atom arrays and other platforms with movable qubits. We ask how far they go at small sizes when searched systematically across all groups. To tackle this question, we use a series of algebraic constraints and screens to design a search pipeline capable of enumerating broad and complete swathes of two-block codes on a laptop. With it we census about $10^8$ two-block codes with up to $320$ qubits at check weights five to nine. Several of these censuses are exhaustive, and support complete statements; for instance, the Gross code is, up to equivalence, the only abelian weight-six two-block code with $n \le 200$ to reach $kd^2/n=12$, and the known $[[64,18,8]]$ is the best two-block code by $kd^2/n$ across weights five to nine with $n \le 94$. The censuses are also large enough to give insights into where good codes live - they concentrate in a handful of groups; abelian groups give the best codes at small $n$ and non-abelian groups at large $n$, with the crossover appearing to move out as the check weight grows; and high quality codes become $100$ to $1000$ times rarer per draw from weight six to weights eight and nine. Using the group algebra and the census data to steer a statistical search finds four to fifteen times as many good codes as uniform draws in equal time. Among the codes found are $[[102,20,10]]$ and $[[120,24,10]]$ at check weight nine, which we simulate in noisy syndrome-extraction circuits, and $[[288,16,16]]$, the best weight-six two-block code with $n \le 300$. At check weights seven to nine, our best codes exceed the best published $kd^2/n$ with exact distance at the same check weight in most length bands up to $320$ qubits. All codes are available in a public database.

analysis.summary: 这篇工作重新评估一种结构很简单的量子 LDPC 码：two-block 群代数码。作者没有提出新的渐近构造，而是把代数约束、码等价约化和距离验证组合成可在笔记本上运行的搜索流程，普查约一亿个小码。在限定物理比特数和检查权重后，这些简单码仍能占据许多资源比较的 Pareto 前沿。论文最有价值的产物是可核查的有限尺寸码数据库，以及解释如何把昂贵的找码问题拆成一系列廉价筛选的技术路线。
analysis.problem: 对近期硬件而言，渐近常数编码率并不足以判断一个码是否划算。真正的问题是：在 n≤320、稳定子检查权重 5 至 9 的规模中，最简单的两块 CSS 结构可以同时提供多少逻辑比特 k 和多大距离 d？过去许多结论来自分散的随机搜索，既可能漏掉好码，也容易把找到的低权重逻辑算符误当作精确距离。作者希望同时改善搜索覆盖、文献比较和距离证据。
analysis.setting: 取有限群 G 和群代数元素 a,b∈F₂[G]，令 n=2|G|。两块检查矩阵为 H_X=(L(a)|R(b))、H_Z=(R(b)^T|L(a)^T)；左、右正则作用互相交换，因此 CSS 对易条件自动满足。检查权重由 a、b 的支持决定。主要指标 Q=kd²/n 强调距离，并按相同检查权重和长度区间比较；作者另外给出 kd/n、n/k 对 d 和完整 Pareto 前沿，避免单一分数掩盖编码率差异。
main_results: 普查覆盖约 10⁸ 个候选码，其中若干参数区域为穷尽枚举，可给出明确的有限类最优性。例如，n≤200 的阿贝尔、权重六 two-block 码中，Gross 码是达到 Q=12 的唯一等价类；已知 [[64,18,8]] 码在 n≤94、权重五至九的 two-block 范围内具有最大 Q。
搜索得到权重九的 [[102,20,10]]、[[120,24,10]]，以及权重六的 [[288,16,16]] 等实例。前两个码约以五个物理比特保护一个逻辑比特，作者还模拟其含噪 syndrome 提取电路。在权重七至九、多个 n≤320 的长度区间，新码改善了相同检查权重下已有精确距离码的 Q 前沿。
好码高度集中于少数群；阿贝尔和非阿贝尔群的相对优势随码长与权重改变。利用初始普查及群代数结构引导后续采样，在所测试的固定时间比较中，好码产出提高约 4 至 15 倍。这是搜索效率的实测提升，不是对所有群或参数的普适复杂度定理。
techniques: 先以群自同构、平移和块交换等关系压缩重复候选，再用群代数的维数约束剔除 k=0 或不可能达到目标参数的码；这样把计算预算集中到真正可能改进文献基准的候选上。
距离计算采用双向夹逼：随机算法寻找低权重非平凡逻辑算符，提供可立即拒绝候选的距离上界；没有找到见证并不意味着距离已被证明，因此幸存者还必须经过逐权重的精确搜索来建立下界。精确阶段利用连通支持、未满足检查的剪枝界和对称根减少分支。
最终用 Tanner 图的规范形式再次去重，保留逻辑算符见证，并借独立距离程序核对重要小码。对不同长度、权重分别设置文献锚点，使搜索目标和比较对象清晰。
assumptions: 最优性陈述只覆盖论文明确穷尽的群、码长、检查权重和 two-block 结构；较大非阿贝尔或高权重区域仍含统计采样。平移不变或可嵌入扭曲环面，也不等于每个检查在严格二维近邻硬件上都局域。
Q 只使用码参数，未直接计入辅助比特、原子移动、检查电路深度、译码延迟和逻辑门成本。权重更大可能得到更好 Q，也可能扩大单轮 syndrome 电路的故障传播。
limitations: 已阅读 v1 正文的定义、搜索流程、主要结果与距离算法说明；没有独立重跑完整普查或逐个复算公开数据库。低距离的重要实例可由外部精确程序交叉验证，更高距离部分仍依赖作者的搜索实现及见证。
论文展示的是有限尺寸搜索和若干噪声模拟，不能据此推出渐近好码、统一硬件阈值或所有码都有高效逻辑操作。数据库给出了比较起点，真正的架构优势还需要电路与噪声模型。
relevance: 适合研究 qLDPC 有限资源、群代数结构及纠错架构的读者。它具体展示了如何把理论筛选转化为搜索算法，也为比较不同逻辑认证或容错方案提供可重复使用的固定码实例。
可借此区分三个不同问题：码参数优良、存储电路优良、逻辑计算优良；论文主要解决第一个，并对少数实例触及第二个。
follow_up: 在同一连接和噪声预算下，把 Q 前沿换成每个逻辑比特所需的辅助比特数、门数及移动距离，权重九实例是否仍占优？
高质量码为何集中于特定群：已有代数约束主要解释 k，能否进一步预测大 d，而减少对距离枚举的依赖？

papers.title: Locality-Preparation Time Tradeoffs in Dissipative Quantum Systems
papers.abstract: Dissipative state preparation engineers quantum many-body states as steady states of an open-system dynamics. The spatial range of the required dissipation sets both the feasibility of analog implementations and the connectivity and control complexity of digital ones. Yet how this locality quantitatively constrains preparation times remains largely unknown. Here, we establish an exact locality-preparation time relation for quadratic fermionic systems and develop a construction that optimizes the locality of the dissipative dynamics while preserving the target state. Applied to the Kitaev chain, our framework reveals sharply different locality-preparation time tradeoffs in critical and gapped regimes. At criticality, suppressing the algebraic tails of the jump operators necessarily forces the preparation time to grow algebraically with system size. By contrast, both trivial and topological gapped phases admit exponentially localized dissipation with a finite preparation time in the thermodynamic limit. Our results identify when fast dissipative preparation is compatible with local control and when criticality imposes an unavoidable dynamical cost.

analysis.summary: 论文研究一个具体的状态制备资源问题：如果只允许空间范围更短的耗散操作，达到同一目标态是否一定更慢？作者在二次费米 Hamiltonian、线性 Markovian 跳跃算符的框架内建立了可以精确计算的关系。关键不是直接截断原有非局域操作，而是先重新混合准粒子湮灭算符，在保持目标暗态的同时优化实空间尾部。Kitaev 链中的结论把临界性与拓扑区分开：临界奇点使局域性改善伴随多项式减速，有隙拓扑态则仍能兼容指数局域的快速耗散。
analysis.problem: 直接耗散每个 Bogoliubov 模式可以去掉激发、制备基态，但这些模式通常分布在整个系统。实验需要控制跳跃算符的空间范围；单纯切断远程系数可能改变稳态。论文希望找到一族目标态完全相同的耗散器，明确其空间衰减与最慢弛豫率之间的关系，再考察有限范围截断后的误差。
analysis.setting: 将二次 Hamiltonian 写成 H=Σ_k ε_k a_k†a_k，目标 |Ω⟩ 是所选 Bogoliubov 真空。采用 L_j=√κ Σ_k B_jk a_k，B 满秩且 ||B||op=1；满秩保证所有准粒子方向都受到耗散，范数归一固定总体强度，避免用任意放大耦合伪造速度优势。周期、平移不变时 B_jk=e^(-ikj)β_k/√N，实空间跳跃系数是 β_k u_k、β_k v_k 的 Fourier 系数。
main_results: 平移不变模型的 Liouvillian gap 为 Δ_L=(κ/2) min_k |β_k|²。物理费米密度矩阵受到宇称超选择约束，不包含实现这一 gap 的奇宇称相干模式；论文使用可访问的最慢速率 Γ=2Δ_L，定义渐近弛豫时间 τ=1/Γ。这个定义需要和给定全局精度的混合时间区分。
临界处，Bogoliubov 系数的动量奇点产生实空间代数尾。让 β_k 在奇点附近具有 m 阶零点，可把尾部压到约 r^(-m-1)，但有限系统最邻近动量相距约 1/N，使最小 |β_k| 约为 N^(-m)，因而 τ∼N^(2m)/κ。改善局域性的同一动作也削弱了最慢模式的耗散。
Kitaev 链的平庸和拓扑有隙相都可选择指数局域跳跃算符，同时保持不随 N 发散的 τ。拓扑区的特殊曲线 Δ²+(μ/2)²=t² 上还能构造只涉及相邻两个格点的严格有限范围跳跃算符。拓扑绕数本身并不强迫制备减速。
有限范围实验的数值例子显示：在截断前先压低临界尾部，能明显改善相关函数和稳态重叠；但抑制指数并非越大越好。慢模式的系数过小会放大相对截断误差，因此出现最佳中间参数。
techniques: 从共同暗态出发利用混合矩阵 B 的自由度，把保持目标态与优化操作局域性分开处理；这是比直接删除远程耦合更有结构的设计办法。
通过 Fourier 正则性分析，将动量函数的连续性、零点阶数和复平面解析性转换成实空间代数或指数衰减；再用 third quantization 计算二次 Lindbladian 的弛豫谱。
对临界与有隙参数分别构造 β_k，并在相同空间截断下比较相关函数。图中的全局误差采用归一化 Hilbert–Schmidt 重叠，不宜直接改称任意操作任务的保真度保证。
assumptions: 精确关系建立在二次费米系统、线性准粒子损耗和 Markovian Lindblad 动力学上；明确的 β_k 公式还使用周期边界与平移不变性。若存在零模，必须先指定目标基态流形中的态，再选择相应创建或湮灭方向。
临界零点的讨论要求有限系统采样动量上的 B 仍保持满秩。若某个实际动量恰好被置为零，会出现未被耗散的方向，不能照搬唯一目标稳态的陈述。
limitations: 已阅读 v1 正文构造、局域性公式、Kitaev 相图和截断比较，并核对补充材料中满秩暗态条件的论证；未逐步独立验证全部补充证明。
τ 描述渐近最慢弛豫，不能单凭 gap 宣称常数时间达到固定全局 trace distance；维数、初态重叠和误差精度还可能带来额外代价。反馈、非 Markovian 浴和相互作用体系均超出当前定理的适用范围。
relevance: 该工作把空间控制范围变成可定量的状态制备资源，适合研究费米量子信息、储备池工程及局域性限制。其启发是同时追踪目标态、耦合归一和慢模式，不能只看操作的空间支持。
follow_up: 把 τ 换成制备精度 ε 的全局混合时间后，系统大小与 ε 如何共同进入资源界？
增加局域测量、反馈或有限记忆的环境，能否绕开临界尾部与慢模式之间的同一约束，代价转移到哪种资源？

papers.title: Genuine multipartite nonlocality detection in graph states
papers.abstract: Experimental detection of multipartite Bell nonlocality faces many challenges. The increase in the size of the system demands a higher fidelity of state preparation, a higher detection efficiency, and a larger number of correlators that need to be estimated. These issues are even more pronounced if one wishes to detect a more restrictive variant of Bell nonlocality called genuine multipartite nonlocality (GMNL). In this work, we introduce two classes of multipartite Bell inequalities that are capable of detecting GMNL correlations and address different experimental hurdles in GMNL detection. The first class consists of the number of correlators that scales linearly with the number of parties. The second class increases the number of correlators and, in return, provides higher noise robustness of GMNL detection. Both classes of inequalities are constructed to detect GMNL in graph states, and in fact both can be used for self-testing of graph states and the performed measurements.

analysis.summary: 论文为图态构造真正多体非局域性（GMNL）的 Bell 见证，并在测量资源与噪声耐受之间提供两种选择。第一族保留随参与方数线性增长的相关量，第二族加入更多稳定子乘积、形成 Svetlichny 型核心来提高违反余量。技术重点是重新设计 Bell 表达式，使它超过所有双局域模型的上界，同时仍能从最大违反推断图态和测量。它解决的是比普通 Bell 非局域性更强的认证目标，而不仅是给原有图态不等式换一个阈值。
analysis.problem: 在多方实验中，违反普通 Bell 不等式并不排除系统只在某些子群内非局域：不同双划分上的局域模型及其概率混合也可能产生强相关。原来的 BASTA 图态不等式具有较少相关量和 self-testing 优点，却不足以检出 GMNL。论文的问题是，怎样保留这些实验友好性质，又能排除每个双划分上局域的无信号模型？
analysis.setting: 考虑连通图 G 的 n 比特图态，其生成元为 g_i=X_i∏_{j∈N_i}Z_j；每方拥有两种二值测量。选一个旋转方 r，用 A_r,0±A_r,1 替换该方的 X、Z，其他方用各自两种测量替换。双局域集合允许各分组内部存在无信号相关，因而认证目标比仅排除完全局域隐藏变量模型更严格。
main_results: 第一族表达式以 r 及其邻居组成核心，对其他生成元加权为 2。其双局域上界为 β_BL=2(n−1)，量子最大值为 β_Q=2√(1+|N_r|²)+2(n−|N_r|−1)。理想图态配合适当旋转角能达到量子界；所需相关量随 n 线性增加，每方仍只需两种设置。
与原 BASTA 的优化方向不同，第一族选择度数较小的旋转顶点可提高 β_Q/β_BL。还可以在图态的局域补等价类中寻找更有利的图，改变各方测量基而保持目标态的局域等价关系。完整最优化可能昂贵，因此这一自由度不等于高效全局最优算法。
最大违反满足论文的有限维与约化态满秩条件时，可 self-test 图态及测量：结论是在局域变换和额外辅助系统意义下确定目标，而非知道实验内部的绝对基。作者进一步为 3 至 6 方 GHZ 示例数值给出噪声下的可提取保真度下界。
第二族用团结构内的稳定子奇数乘积替换或扩充核心，获得 Svetlichny 型噪声优势。代价是相关量数可随核心大小指数增加；也不是每个连通图都直接适用。作者检查至 8 顶点的局域补类别，显示绝大多数可使用该构造。
techniques: 证明分成核心和扩展两部分：核心确保跨越核心的双划分不能达到量子值，扩展用无信号相关的不等式把其余参与方连接进证书，防止漏掉核心之外的双划分。
量子上界利用平方和分解；达到上界会强制出现相应的局域代数关系，再由这些关系推出图态稳定子和 self-testing 结构。有限噪声下的保真度则另外使用局域提取通道与算符不等式方法。
白噪声可见度提供直观比较：若完全混合态的 Bell 值为零，ρ=p|G⟩⟨G|+(1−p)I/2ⁿ 的违反要求 p 超过 β_BL/β_Q。因此增加量子界与双局域界的比例会改善此特定噪声模型的耐受性。
assumptions: GMNL 判据依赖论文采用的无信号双局域模型及连通图结构；与其他多体非局域性定义比较时，必须先确认允许的组内相关模型一致。
理想最大违反的 self-testing 定理与有噪声的鲁棒保真度界是不同结果。后者在文中针对具体小型实例计算，不能把理想定理自动当作所有大图的统一噪声界。
limitations: 已阅读 v1 定义、两族构造、界值、自测试与局域补优化章节；没有独立核查所有附录或重算数值证书。第一族的线性相关量数只说明需要估计的量较少，不保证总实验 shots 线性。
要以给定置信度证明违反，还需考虑相关量方差、系数权重、违反余量和测量分配。白噪声阈值改善也不能直接等同对任意局域噪声、漏检或实验漂移的鲁棒性。
relevance: 适合图态、稳定子、非局域游戏及器件无关认证研究。两族构造具体展示：更强认证目标会压缩违反余量，增加测量项则可能换回噪声耐受；资源评价应同时报告两者。
follow_up: 固定置信度和噪声水平后，如何为这些带权相关量分配 shots，使总样本复杂度最小？
能否在局域补搜索中直接优化可提取保真度或有限样本认证成本，而不仅最大化理想界值比例？

papers.title: Hamiltonian-Dependent Compressibility and Physical Preservation in Approximate Quantum Compilation using Tensor Networks
papers.abstract: Approximate quantum compilation (AQC) using tensor networks provides a promising route to reducing the circuit resources required for quantum simulation. However, the factors governing the compressibility of many-body dynamics and the extent to which compressed circuits retain physically relevant information on quantum hardware remain poorly understood. We investigate these questions using AQCtensor for an 80-qubit one-dimensional anisotropic XYZ Heisenberg chain initialized in a Néel state. By varying the exchange anisotropy and external magnetic field, we find that compression performance changes systematically with the anisotropic coupling configuration and field orientation. These variations are strongly associated with a nested-commutator measure related to second-order Trotter error, with corresponding directional trends also reflected in the target-state MPS bond dimension. For an 80-qubit quantum-hardware evaluation, AQCtensor compresses a 10-repetition target evolution to 5 repetitions while retaining a target-state fidelity of 0.995474, reducing the total circuit depth by 45.9% and the two-qubit gate count by 47.6%. The compressed circuit exhibits comparable behavior across magnetization, nearest-neighbor correlation, and Hamiltonian expectation measurements, while process-level diagnostics and local reduced-state tomography provide complementary characterization beyond these observables. Together, these results link AQCtensor compressibility to Hamiltonian commutator structure and target-state complexity and demonstrate substantial circuit reduction while retaining physically relevant features in an 80-qubit quantum-hardware experiment.

analysis.summary: 研究 approximate compilation 的可压缩性如何依赖 Hamiltonian 结构，并在 80-qubit 演化中比较门资源与可观测物的保真程度。
analysis.problem: 压缩电路较短不代表保留全部 process 信息；哪些 Hamiltonian 更易压缩，哪些实验指标能发现未被局部 observables 暴露的偏差？
analysis.setting: Néel 初态的 1D anisotropic XYZ Heisenberg chain，使用 tensor-network AQCtensor，并改变 anisotropy 与 field orientation。
main_results: 作者报告将 10-repetition target evolution 压成 5 repetitions，target-state fidelity 为 0.995474，depth 与 two-qubit count 分别下降 45.9% 和 47.6%。
压缩表现与 nested-commutator measure 和 MPS bond dimension 的趋势相关，并比较 magnetization、correlations、energy、process diagnostics 和 local tomography。
techniques: 把近似编译的经验表现与 second-order Trotter commutator structure 联系，并交叉检查多个物理 observables。
assumptions: 固定 initial state、Hamiltonian family 与 target evolution；state-specific compression 不能自动推广到所有输入。
limitations: 仅阅读官方摘要，未审阅正文假设和证明；0.995474 的具体评估方法与硬件噪声贡献未在摘要交代，不能称为已认证的 hardware process fidelity。
本条分析仅依据论文摘要，未核查正文证明和摘要中未说明的假设。
relevance: 与 depth/gate-resource reduction 及 certification 指标的充分性有具体联系；收录为模型与诊断案例，而非普遍最优编译结论。
follow_up: 读者建议：区分 target-state overlap、average/process fidelity 与 observable errors，比较相同精度标准下的资源。

papers.title: Coset Lifted Product Codes: Constructing Quantum LDPC Codes from Non-Normal Subgroup Actions
papers.abstract: We introduce coset lifted product (CLP) codes, a family of quantum LDPC codes that combine the protograph structure of lifted product codes with the coset action of Aydin, Tamo, and Barg \cite{AydinTamoBarg2026}. Given a finite group $G$, a subgroup $H \le G$ that need not be normal, a protograph $A$ over $\mathbb F_2[G]$, and a protograph $B$ over $\mathbb F_2[N_G(H)]$, the two protographs act on the cosets $G/H$ from the left and from the right to produce quantum CSS codes. Further, for groups of odd order, we give an explicit formula for the dimension as a sum over the irreducible representations $ρ$ of $G$ of hypergraph product dimensions. A search over $14,843$ pairs $(G,H)$ with $H$ restricted to be non-normal and $120 \le n \le 400$ yields certified codes that exceed the best published value of $Q=kd^2/n$ at check weights $6,7$ and $9$, i.e., we obtain $[[360,20,20]]$ at $w=6$, a $[[360,24,20]]$ code at $w=7$, and codes $[[252,16,18]]$ and $[[288,16,20]]$ at $w=9$. Our search also produce high-distance codes with parameters $[[168,10,14]], [[240,8,20]]$ at $w=6$ and $[[216,8,18]]$ at $w=7$.

analysis.summary: 作者提出 coset lifted product（CLP）量子 LDPC 码，把 lifted-product 的原型图结构与非正规子群的陪集作用结合起来。核心创新是改变提升时所作用的空间：不再让群只作用在自身，而是在 G/H 上组合左作用与合法的右作用。论文证明 CSS 对易性，给出奇数阶群的表示论维数公式，并搜索有限规模的非正规实例，得到若干精确认证距离的新码。这是一条扩大代数找码空间的路线，贡献同时包含构造、维数计算和可核查的小码参数。
analysis.problem: 常见 two-block 和 lifted-product 码常采用群的正则表示；这样结构清楚，却可能把有效候选限制在较小的设计空间。若子群 H 不正规，G/H 不能简单作为商群使用，左右作用又必须满足 CSS 对易要求。论文要解决的正是：怎样在这种更一般的陪集空间上定义合法的两套作用，保留原型图扩展能力，并计算由此产生的逻辑比特数？
